description:
**About the company**### **Tomorrow University: A Next\-Generation University for Impactful Careers**


Education is the most powerful lever for driving the transition to a sustainable society. That’s why we’ve built a university dedicated to educating and empowering the change\-makers of tomorrow. We offer accredited degree programs designed to equip learners with 21st\-century competencies while providing access to a world\-class network of experts to maximize their impact.


As a remote\-first institution, we use technology and AI to enable flexible, personalized learning \- accessible from anywhere in the world.


We are proud to be the first EdTech startup in Europe with a fully state\-recognized university license and to be ranked among the **Top 20 EdTech startups globally**.

### **Our Inspiration**


We believe that transforming education requires rethinking how we teach. At Tomorrow University, we move beyond the traditional, teacher\-centered approach and embrace **a student\-centric learning model**. Our goal is to equip learners with the essential skills and mindset needed to create global impact, supported by a vast network of change\-makers.

### **Our Mission**


At Tomorrow University, we leverage **science and technology** to enhance learning while fostering a global community for continuous growth and impact. Our students learn by **applying their knowledge to real\-world challenges** and engaging with world\-class educators, mentors, and partners from around the globe.

**Be aware that all of our positions are completely Remote but our working hours are Central European Time (\+/\- 2h)**

**About the role**
The marketing team works across three growth levers: **create demand, acquire demand, convert demand.** Four people own that work between them. **You own create demand.**


Your job is to make more of the right people want a Tomorrow University degree.


Choosing a degree is a slow, expensive, high\-trust decision. People discover us, come back weeks later, attend an event, compare options, worry about cost, and take time to decide. Your work gives them a reason to pay attention and helps build the confidence to take the next step.


You set the content strategy and produce much of the work yourself. You decide what we say, who we say it to, which formats and channels we use, and what is worth testing. Most weeks, that also means writing, filming, editing, or building the asset.


You have support. Part\-time creators help increase output once we know what works, and our designer supports the work that needs stronger craft or brand treatment.


We are looking for someone who likes making things, putting them in market, and learning from the response. The goal is consistent demand creation, with a clear view of which ideas, messages, and formats are actually working.


What You'll Own


Make people want this degree

* Develop the content strategy across programs, markets, paid, organic, and social. You decide the ideas, the messages, the proof points behind them, and which audiences they are for.
* Turn our positioning into creative that people understand and remember. That means knowing how to express an idea through copy, design, photography, video, or a combination of them.
* Lead the creative for program launches and seasonal campaigns from first idea to execution.

  

Work at strategy level and make the work yourself


This is a small startup, so the role moves between strategy and execution all the time.

* You write exceptionally well and can take an idea from rough concept to finished asset yourself.
* You are comfortable designing in Figma or Canva, shooting photography, filming and editing video, and producing short\-form content for social and paid. You also know when a stronger piece needs a specialist.
* Freelancers and creators are there to support and scale the work, but you need enough creative range and judgement to direct them well.
* Use AI image and video tools where they are genuinely useful, alongside more traditional production.

  

Own social content strategy and creation


You own what we say on social and what we make for it.

* Set the social content strategy, generate the ideas, write the posts, develop recurring formats, and brief UGC creators.
* Produce the core content yourself and work with freelancers or creators where additional production is needed.
* Work closely with our part\-time Social Media Coordinator, who manages scheduling, publishing, engagement, commenting, and the day\-to\-day running of the channels.
* Build content with both organic and paid use in mind where it makes sense.

  

Test ideas and build on what works

* Work with Performance Marketing on a regular creative testing rhythm across messages, concepts, formats, and audiences.
* Keep a clear record of which angles work by program and market so future campaigns start with evidence.
* Decide what to test next, stop producing ideas that are not working, and develop the ones that are.
* Bring the useful learnings into the weekly review, including both the strong performers and the ideas that did not land.

  

What You Bring

* 7\+ years in performance creative, growth marketing, content, or social. You have spent a meaningful part of that time making the work yourself.
* You are an excellent writer across hooks, scripts, ad copy, captions, and campaign messaging, and you know how to change the writing when the format changes.
* Comfortable shooting and editing yourself, whether that is on a phone, a camera, or whatever else the idea needs.
* You can design well enough in Figma or Canva to make strong static assets without waiting on a designer for every piece.
* **Creative testing is part of how you work.** You can isolate a variable, read the result properly, and decide what to change next.
* You know how to direct creators, freelancers, coordinators, and designers once an idea is working. Clear briefs and useful feedback matter more than process.
* AI image and video tools are already part of your production workflow, and you have a good sense of when they help and when they do not.
* You are comfortable being measured on outcomes beyond reach or engagement, including applications and enrolled students.

You believe education can change lives.  
* 

  

Nice to have, not required:

* You speak German.
* You have worked in higher education, edtech, or another category with a long purchase decision.
* You have run creator or UGC programs.
* You can do motion design or advanced video editing.
* You are a strong photographer.
* You have worked on performance creative in a regulated category.

 **What Matters to Us**


We’re looking for people who thrive in a dynamic, mission\-driven environment. These traits are especially important to us:

* **Ownership \& Independence** – You take initiative and get things done
* **Collaborative Mindset** – You enjoy working across teams and disciplines
* **Clear \& Thoughtful Communication** – You know how to adapt your message to different audiences
* **Integrity, Curiosity \& Growth** – You’re honest, open\-minded, and always looking to learn
* **Proactivity \& Drive** – You bring energy and momentum to your work
* **Commitment to Execution** – You don’t just dream big—you make things happen
* **Passion for Sustainability, Entrepreneurship \& Technology** – You care deeply about building a better future

 **Perks \& Benefits**


**Grow with us**


At Tomorrow University, we foster lifelong learning. You’ll have access to our innovative programs and be part of a culture that encourages continuous growth, personally and professionally.


**Travel the world together**


Twice a year, we bring the whole team together for a week\-long Workation somewhere in Europe, think bonding, brainstorming, and big ideas in beautiful places.


**Time to recharge**


You’ll get **25 vacation days** per year, plus public holidays based on your location.

**Ready to shape the future of education and make an impact? Join us and help reimagine how we learn, grow, and build a better tomorrow.**


At Tomorrow University, we believe in your potential, not your paperwork. Degrees are great, but your *drive* matters even more

title: Creative Lead (Social & UGC)
description:
**Who we are**
==============


Creative Milkshake is a remote\-first performance creative agency. We make scroll\-stopping short\-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok \- high\-volume, fast\-moving, and built to convert.


We’re a close\-knit team of \~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing \- in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with.


Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC\-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale.

**The role**
============


We make a lot of content. Across a portfolio of DTC clients, our studio shoots and edits dozens of UGC ads every week. Most of it is good. Some of it is great. And the difference between good and great is specific: the hook that actually stops the scroll, the edit that holds attention, the subtle thing that makes a piece of content feel native rather than forced. That's what this role is about.


We’re looking for a Creative Lead (Social \& UGC) to be the final creative eye before work reaches clients. You'll review raw footage, storyboards, and final edits, and give the kind of specific, hands\-on feedback that actually improves the work rather than just flags problems.


You’ve made content yourself. You’ve been on set, you’ve been in the edit, you know what it takes to make a 15\-second video that does something to the person watching it. You bring that maker's instinct to a quality and creative leadership role, and you use it to raise the bar across a whole studio.

**Timezone preference**
=======================


For this role, we're only considering candidates based in \+/ 3 hrs CET time zone.

  

**What you’ll do**
==================

**Hold the creative quality bar**
---------------------------------

* Review storyboards, raw footage when necessary, and final edits before they go to clients
* Be the quality gate: if something isn’t ready, you say so clearly, and you explain exactly what needs to change and why
* Build and maintain the ad example library, creative checklists, and “what good looks like” guides that codify your instinct into something the whole team can learn from
* Spot recurring patterns: editing habits that aren't working, storyboard mistakes that keep appearing, hooks that aren't landing. Address them at the root, not ad by ad

**Give hands\-on creative direction in post**
---------------------------------------------

* Review raw footage after shoots and provide clear direction on what’s usable, what’s not, and what to do differently next time
* Give precise editing feedback to our video editors: pacing, cut points, text overlays, sound design, the craft layer that turns a decent edit into something that performs
* Understand design fundamentals well enough to give direction on static assets, thumbnail frames, and text treatments: what reads on a phone screen and what doesn't
* Know what a 9:16 UGC ad needs to do in the first 2 seconds, and be able to articulate it in a way an editor can act on immediately

**Support production with a creative eye**
------------------------------------------

* Review storyboards before shoots and flag what isn’t shootable as written, what talent or set requirements are missing, and where the brief and the concept have drifted
* Give production the creative context they need to go into a shoot prepared: what angles matter, what the edit is going to need, what “good” looks like for this format and this brand
* Periodically join shoots at the Amsterdam studio (\+\-3 times a year) when creative stakes are high or a new format is being tested
* Over time, help build a visual reference library for the studio: what set styles, lighting setups, and shooting approaches produce the most versatile footage

**Drive platform and content intelligence**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain a genuine, current relationship with TikTok, Meta, and emerging short\-form platforms: scrolling with a critical eye, not just awareness
* Curate a regular inspiration feed for the team: specific content examples with notes on why they work, what the craft decisions are, and how we could produce something similar in our studio
* Know the difference between a format worth adopting and a trend worth skipping, and be able to make the case either way
* Bring fresh creative references when the team’s output starts feeling formulaic or dated

**Build the team’s creative instinct**
--------------------------------------

* Give Creative Strategists feedback on CSPs and scripts that builds their creative eye over time, not just fixes the brief in front of them
* Run regular creative review sessions and inspiration shares that create a shared language for what “good” means at Creative Milkshake
* Be the person the team brings work to when they're not sure if it's there yet, and give them an answer they can trust

**Own CM’s creative identity externally**
-----------------------------------------

* Approve CM's own social content and website portfolio: what we put out about ourselves should reflect the standard we hold for clients
* Help define and document CM’s creative POV over time: the format instincts, the aesthetic signatures, the things that make our content recognizably ours

  

**Who you are**
===============


We’re not filtering on titles. We're looking for a specific type of person: someone with a sharp creative eye for what works on social, who wants to use that experience to raise the quality of an entire studio's output.

* 3–7 years of hands\-on experience in video production, editing, content creation, or a creative role at a social\-first agency or DTC brand. You've made things, not just briefed them
* A genuine, current feel for short\-form social content: you scroll TikTok and Meta with a critical eye, you notice what’s working before it’s obvious, and you can describe the craft decisions behind it in specific terms
* Ability to understand paid media and performance marketing reports to inform creative decisions
* Real editing experience, or close enough collaboration with editors, that you speak the language of the edit
* Enough on\-set or production experience to spot when a storyboard isn’t going to translate, and know what to do about it
* The ability to tell a good ad from a great one in seconds, and explain why in a way the person who made it can actually use
* Feedback that is specific, timestamped, and producible, not vague creative notes that leave people guessing
* High EQ: you can give honest creative feedback without damaging the confidence or the relationship of the person on the other end
* Comfortable with ambiguity and pace: we're building systems while operating at volume
* Fluent in English, confident presenting creative rationale to clients when needed

  

**Backgrounds that tend to produce this person**
================================================


There’s no single path. People who are great at this role often come from one of these places:

* A video editor or post\-production lead who has developed a strong creative eye for social, and wants to work upstream on quality rather than just executing edits
* A UGC creator or content creator who has built a real, granular understanding of what performs and why, and wants to bring that instinct to a studio environment at scale
* A creative producer who sits between strategy and production, has strong taste, and wants to formalise that into a quality leadership role
* A social content lead or in\-house creative at a DTC brand who has been hands\-on with short\-form video and wants to take their creative judgement further

**What they all share: they’ve made things, they have taste, and they can teach it.**

  

**You’ll thrive here if…**
==========================

* You get genuinely excited about the craft of short\-form video: the hook, the cut, the text timing, the sound. You find it hard to watch a mediocre ad without knowing what you'd fix
* You want a role where your creative instinct directly improves what goes out the door every week
* You’re energised by the challenge of holding a high standard at volume: lots of content, lots of clients, fast turnarounds
* You want to shape creative culture from the inside: setting a standard, building the resources that make a team better, defining what “good” means at a growing studio
* The idea of helping a UGC studio move toward elevated social\-first content over the next couple of years sounds like exactly the right moment to join

**This role isn’t for you if…**
===============================

* You’ve only worked in creative strategy or performance marketing and haven’t been hands\-on with video production or editing
* Your creative background is in brand identity or traditional advertising rather than short\-form, social\-first content
* You prefer to stay in the strategic or conceptual space and find production and editing detail less interesting
* You’re primarily looking for a people\-management role. Your influence here comes through creative expertise, not team size

  

**What we offer**
=================

* Creative Milkshake Stipends (mental health, healthcare \& internet)
* Time Off: 21 days PTO \+ 7 Paid Sick Days; company closure: 2 weeks at year\-end (estimated: December 22 – January 5\)
* Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Yearly Salary Review
* Long Service Incentives (starting from 2 years)

title: Performance Creative Strategist
description:
ABOUT US
  
  

Reach Digital is an AI\-first performance marketing agency helping eCommerce and digital product brands scale through creative, paid media, and landing pages. We are a true growth partner \- going deep with brands to become integrated into their marketing team. We drive real growth by combining data, testing, and new ideas.
  
  

We're a fully remote team of creatives, editors, and growth strategists. We care about the work, and care about being the best at what we do.
  
  

THE ROLE
  
  

As a Creative Strategist at Reach, you own the creative end\-to\-end. You'll do the research, develop ad angles, write hooks, and build creative briefs that our editors execute, working directly with our brand partners and growth/design teams.
  
  

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
  
  

You have 2\+ years of digital marketing experience
  
  

You understand paid media and the types of content that converts
  
  

You enjoy brainstorming ad angles and concepts, then bringing them to life
  
  

You are detail\-orientated, organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  
  

You're willing to learn and get better even when that means giving and receiving feedback
  
  

You are comfortable communicating learnings with both team members and clients
  
  

You're genuinely passionate about creative strategy and staying on top of what's working \- you do this because you want to, not because you have to
  
  

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  
  

Analyzing performance, brainstorming ad angles and hook variations, and writing new briefs weekly for the editing team to produce
  
  

Owning the creative strategy for your brand partners, including a living strategy doc that tracks angles, performance, and what to test next
  
  

Staying current on platform trends, winning ad formats, and policy changes, and translating that into testable concepts for your accounts
  
  

Working with 3\-5 brand partners at a time, with a focus on going deep into their creative and building new winning ads
  
  

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM US
  
  

**Growth:** We invest in the people who invest in the work. Expect regular creative reviews, direct feedback, and room to grow into senior roles as Reach scales.
  
  

**Weekly Calls \& Creative Training:** Weekly team check\-ins, creative reviews and training sessions. Calls are typically held between 12pm–6pm EST on weekdays.
  
  

Generous PTO and benefits policy
  
  

Fully remote role (working US hours)
  
  

Competitive compensation in USD
  
  

The Hiring Process
  
  

All candidates will go through a 15\-minute questionnaire. Following this, top candidates will be given a culture fit interview before being given a paid, take\-home assignment.

title: Creative Producer
description:
**TheSoul Group** is a leading creator business platform positioned at the heart of the creator economy. Our original videos, animations, and editorial stories inspire audiences in **21 languages**, across **60 platforms** and **20 websites**.


Together with our network of talented creators, we reach over **5 billion followers** and generate more than **100 billion monthly views** on social media.


As a global powerhouse in digital media, we drive viral success for creators and brands worldwide through a wide range of services, leveraging our expertise in content production, distribution, localization, and social media management. We’re the creators behind global phenomena such as **5\-Minute Crafts** and **Bright Side**.


We’re a dynamic, remote\-first global team, fostering award\-winning creativity, a no\-red\-tape approach, and great vibes!


We are looking to connect with experienced **Creative Producers** to lead creative content production for external clients and brands.


In these projects, you may manage the creative production process from brief to delivery, working directly with clients to understand their objectives, brand guidelines, and audience needs and translating them into effective social media content.


You will collaborate closely with creative and production teams, oversee the quality and consistency of deliverables, and help ensure that projects meet both client expectations and creative standards across a variety of formats and social platforms.

**Responsibilities:**
Depending on the scope and requirements of individual projects, responsibilities may include:

* Manage end\-to\-end production of video, static, and other social media content for external clients.
* Work directly with clients to understand their business objectives, creative needs, brand positioning, guidelines, and expectations.
* Translate client requirements into clear creative briefs and production plans.
* Guide designers, video editors, creators, and other production team members throughout the creative process.
* Develop and refine creative concepts that support clients’ brands and social media objectives.
* Oversee quality control across creative deliverables, ensuring that visuals, videos, and copy meet both client requirements and internal creative standards.
* Manage production timelines, priorities, workloads, and resource allocation across projects.
* Maintain consistent quality while supporting a high volume of creative output.
* Present creative solutions, communicate project updates, and incorporate client feedback throughout the production process.
* Supervise and support creative teams, helping them deliver against project requirements and creative expectations.
* Support the hiring, onboarding, and mentoring of production and creative team members when required.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Track production budgets, estimate costs, and support efficient use of project resources.
* Identify opportunities to improve production workflows, creative processes, and overall team efficiency.

  

**Requirements**  

  

**Strong Requirements:*** **2\+ years of experience in creative production for external clients as a Producer.** Experience working with major international brands is a strong advantage.
* **Hands\-on video production experience**, with a background in filming, editing, motion design, design, or another relevant production discipline.
* **2\+ years of experience leading creative teams**, with a track record of scaling creative output and improving creative performance.

**Requirements:*** Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end creative production process, from client brief and concept development through production and final delivery.
* Experience translating client objectives, brand guidelines, and feedback into clear creative direction and actionable briefs.
* Strong understanding of social media content and the ability to adapt creative approaches to different platforms, audiences, and formats.
* Experience managing multiple creative deliverables, timelines, and priorities in a fast\-paced production environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, including confidence working directly with clients.
* Strong creative judgment and attention to quality and detail.
* Experience producing content for international brands or multi\-market audiences is highly desirable.

  

**Benefits**  

* **Flexible, Project\-Based Engagement:** This is a talent\-pool opportunity for potential future projects rather than a full\-time position. Engagements will be offered under an independent service\-provider agreement based on project needs and your relevant experience. You define your own working methods, organise your schedule independently, and contribute your expertise to clearly scoped projects. Compensation will be agreed individually based on the scope of each engagement, your experience, capabilities, and the value you bring.
* **Location Freedom:** You can deliver services from any suitable location that supports high\-quality outcomes, whether that’s your home office, a co\-working space, or wherever you feel most productive and inspired. What matters most is the impact you create and the reliability of your delivery.
* **Global Network and Inspiring Projects:** You’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse international network of professionals across 85\+ countries on projects reaching audiences around the world.
* **Smooth Collaboration and Project Support:** We provide modern collaboration platforms, clear project coordination, and streamlined processes so you can focus on producing high\-impact work and bringing creative solutions to life.
* **Make a Global Impact:** Your expertise may contribute to initiatives that influence audiences worldwide and help build the next generation of digital experiences.

description:

We are an international Alkemy a digital consulting firm specialized in driving the evolution of the business models of large and mid\-sized companies. We help our clients improve their competitiveness by connecting strategy, communication, design, technology, and data always with a practical, impact\-oriented approach.


With more than 2,000 people across different countries, we work on end\-to\-end projects: from strategic definition to implementation, measurement, and continuous optimization. Our focus is on turning data into real business decisions, not just producing reports.

### **About the role**


We are looking to hire a **Senior Client Partner** at Alkemy, with a strong commercial mindset and proven experience in advertising, digital media, creativity, and digital transformation.


The main mission of this role will be to **generate new business among large advertisers and brands**, building trusted relationships with Marketing Directors, CMOs, Digital Directors, Media Directors, eCommerce Directors, and other key decision\-makers. The goal will be to identify their needs and turn them into business opportunities across Alkemy’s different capabilities.


We are looking for someone who is **strongly sales\-oriented**, with the ability to open doors, develop long\-term relationships, and take a consultative approach to selling solutions that combine Media, Paid Media, creativity, content, social media, eCommerce, web, mobile, and digital transformation.


We are not simply looking for an account manager: we are looking for a profile with a **proven ability to create opportunities, develop compelling proposals, and close business**.

### **What will you do?**

##### **Build new business**


You'll own the commercial growth of your portfolio and be responsible for creating opportunities from the ground up.

* Identify and target high\-value brands and advertisers.
* Build your own network of prospects and strategic relationships.
* Open doors with senior decision\-makers across Marketing, Digital, Media and eCommerce.

* Uncover business challenges, marketing priorities and investment opportunities.
* Lead the complete sales journey: **prospecting discovery strategy proposal negotiation close**.
* Lead pitches, presentations, RFPs and commercial negotiations.
* Build and manage a healthy pipeline and accurate sales forecast.
* Develop relationships that generate long\-term **upselling and cross\-selling opportunities**.

##### **Sell solutions, not services**


At Alkemy, clients don't come to us simply looking for a media plan, a website or a campaign.


They come with **business challenges**.


You'll be expected to understand those challenges and bring together the right capabilities to solve them.


Depending on the opportunity, this could mean combining:

**Media \+ Paid Media \+ Creativity \+ Social \+ Content \+ eCommerce \+ Technology \+ Data \+ AI \+ CX**


You'll work closely with our specialists to turn complex client needs into **compelling, integrated propositions that create real business value**.

##### **Lead strategic client conversations**


You'll operate comfortably at senior level, moving beyond tactical conversations to discuss:

* Business and growth objectives.
* Marketing and digital transformation.
* Customer acquisition and retention.
* Media investment and performance.
* Brand and customer experience.
* Data and AI opportunities.
* eCommerce and digital platforms.
* New ways of engaging consumers.


You'll understand what matters to the client and translate it into opportunities for Alkemy.

##### **Build partnerships that last**


Winning the first project is only the beginning.


You'll build relationships designed to grow over time, identifying new challenges, new stakeholders and new opportunities across the organisation.


You'll develop strategic account plans and continuously look for opportunities to expand our relationship through **upselling, cross\-selling and new business**.

### **Your ecosystem at Alkemy**


You won't be selling alone. You'll work with multidisciplinary teams across:

**Media · Creative / Cosmic · Brand Experience · Social Media · Technology · eCommerce · Data \& AI · CRO / CXO · Engagement \& Loyalty**


Your role is to connect the dots: **bring the client challenge, bring the right people together and lead the commercial opportunity.**

We're looking for a senior commercial profile with **6–10\+ years of experience** in business development, sales, Client Partner, Business Director, Account Director or similar roles within the digital ecosystem.


More than a specific job title, we're interested in your track record:

* You have **successfully opened new accounts and won new business**.
* You have an established network across Marketing, Digital, Media and/or eCommerce.
* You know how to get a conversation with senior decision\-makers.
* You have experience selling **digital advertising, media, creative, content, technology or digital transformation services**.

* You're comfortable negotiating significant budgets and managing multiple opportunities simultaneously.

* You are fluent in **Spanish and professionally proficient in English**.

**Background:** AdTech\&Platforms, Media Agencies, Digital \& Creative Agencies, Consulting \& Digital Experience

### **We’re looking for someone who is**

* **Highly commercial and results\-oriented**, with a strong focus on achieving business objectives.
* A true **hunter**, with the ability and motivation to open new accounts and create opportunities from scratch.
* **Consultative**, able to understand the client’s business rather than simply sell individual services.

### **What do we offer you?**


At Alkemy, we work to help people develop their talent in a collaborative, demanding, and stimulating environment where ideas become reality.

We look forward to meeting you at Alkemy.

**About rapt** 





 rapt is a multimedia studio making immersive and interactive experiences. A Projection show on a landmark building, LED at stage scale, real\-time visuals. One month a campaign launch in London, the next live visuals for an arena tour, the next an installation in a disused power station or the Nevada desert.
 




  






 We work with global brands, artists and cultural institutions. Previous names include BOSS, Nike, Valentino, McLaren, New Balance, TAG Heuer, Audemars Piguet, Netflix and Diageo. And the work doesn't stop with brands. We have an artistic practice of our own, and the self\-initiated work feeds back into everything else. The last thing we want an audience to feel is nothing.
 




  






 We're a small team working on big projects all over the world, and the studio is growing. This role plays a real part in shaping what it becomes next.
 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a Creative Director to lead creative across pitches and live projects. Sharp conceptual thinking, a strong visual sensibility, and the ability to take an idea from first response through to what the audience actually experiences. Projects range from arena tours and festival main stages to building\-scale projection and gallery installations.
 



  





 This is a creative director with a producer's hat on. You need to know what it takes to make the idea real. Which people, how many days, what budget, what pipeline, and whether it lands on time. Not just the creative, but how realistic the creative is to deliver. You'll lead teams made up of internal people and external specialists, built per project from our freelance roster. You brief them, run them and sign off their work.
 



  





 You'll be running several pitches and several projects at the same time. Being highly organised isn't a nice\-to\-have here.
 



  





 You'll need to be fluent in immersive formats and creative technology, confident communicating ideas to clients and internal teams, and hands\-on enough to sketch, write or visualise ideas yourself when needed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





*Pitches* 



* Lead creative direction on pitch responses. Approach every brief strategically: what the objective is, who the audience is, and what the angle is that wins it.
* Translate briefs into clear creative strategy and strong, original ideas.
* Shape visual concepts, narratives and deck content.
* Scope the content side: team, days and cost, working with the project manager. If the idea can't be built for the number, say so early.



  





*Projects* 



* Own creative quality from concept through production to delivery on site.
* Build, brief and manage freelance content teams from our roster: 2D, 3D, real\-time, interactive, sound.
* Plan the content production: schedule it, resource it, track it, keep it on budget with the help of our internal team.
* Review and sign off content before it goes to the client or hits the media server.
* Present work to clients and collaborators with clarity and confidence.



  





*Studio* 



* Uphold creative standards across everything that leaves the studio.
* Motivate and guide creative teams across disciplines, from concept to delivery.
* Feed into internal R\&D and help shape the future creative direction of rapt.



  





**Key Skills \& Experience** 



* Proven experience making work for big spaces and big crowds, arena screens, building facades, one\-off sites, not just standard agency\-format content.
* A hands\-on tools background. You've come up through making, whether design, 3D, motion or real\-time, and grown into creative direction. You know roughly how a thing gets built and can navigate a project through it. Time spent agency side and a track record of winning pitches are both a plus.
* Strong creative strategy skills and an ability to frame ideas clearly for clients.
* Producer's instincts. You've scoped and costed content production before and know what a team of artists actually takes, in people, days and money.
* A clear eye for design, narrative and spatial storytelling.
* You can illustrate your own ideas. Sketch, storyboard, style frame, mock up. When you show an idea, people see it.
* Working knowledge of 2D, 3D, real\-time (Unreal, Notch, TouchDesigner) and Gen AI workflows.
* Experience working across immersive, spatial, digital or experiential formats.

* Comfort collaborating with technical and production teams across disciplines.

 Location:
   

  

 London, GB
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue, GQ, Glamour, CN Traveller, Vanity Fair, Wired, The World of Interiors, House \& Garden and Tatler, among many others.
   

  

 We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.
   

  

 Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday \- Thursday).
   

  

 We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.
   

  

 Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.
   

  

 Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross\-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high\-stakes, multi\-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi\-market event sponsorships.
   

  

 You excel at guiding cross\-functional teams through complex, fast\-paced workflows, bringing executive\-level problem\-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.
   

  

 Individual \& Team Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop bold multi\-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi\-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.
* Serve as the primary creative client liaison on campaigns—presenting work, managing feedback, and guiding creative integrity across production.
* Drive brainstorms and work hands\-on when crafting proposals and presentations.
* Propose creative solutions that fit within the provided budgets.
* Ensure all commercial ideas authentically balance the voices and perspectives of our editorial brands with those of our advertising partners.
* Help build a thriving creative department; nurture talent, establish workflow efficiencies, and champion inclusive, forward\-thinking creative culture.
* Deputise for the Executive Creative Director across key business forums, internal leadership meetings, and executive client pitches.


**Essential Skills \& Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience as a creative lead in premium media or agency environments.
* A demonstrated appreciation for the subject matter and creativity of the brands you’ll represent at Condé Nast.
* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing work across print, digital, video and events.
* Passion for brand marketing, with a sharp cultural perspective that informs consumer\-facing campaigns.
* Skilled storyteller with excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation abilities.
* Extensive on\-set experience and deep knowledge of video and photography production, from pre\- to post\-production (for digital and print).
* Demonstrated success managing creative teams and working within established systems to improve output and efficiency.
* A creative aesthetic emphasizing current standards in entertainment, fashion, luxury and design.
* Highly organized, adaptable and adept at prioritizing workloads in fast\-paced environments.
* Ability to work fluently with collaborators in production \- writers, DPs, photographers, editors, animators, and designers.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and treatment deck creation. Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and editing software.


**Desired Qualities**
* Culturally informed \- Current on music and entertainment, luxury and fashion, as well as knowledgeable about Condé Nast brands and culture. Additionally, have awareness of relevant artists, and creative vendors.
* Highly imaginative \- You’re a conceptual creative with innovative ideas that challenge outdated approaches to content and the definition of “experiential.”
* Detail\-oriented \- Equally obsessed with creating memorable work and impactful campaigns that solve our client’s challenges.
* Agile and adaptable \- Open to taking input from others and willing to take on essential tasks needed to get the job done.
* Think critically \- You strive to come up with ideas that solve brand challenges, can manage multiple projects at once, and know when to pivot if something isn’t working.
* Have an ego\-less attitude \- You give credit where credit is due, bring a positive attitude to work and support your teammates in gaining visibility and opportunities.
* A natural mentor \- You prioritize diversity, inclusivity, and representation in every stage of the creative process and empathy in team collaboration.


 What benefits do we offer?
   

  

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.
* You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme, Bupa Private Healthcare, Season ticket loans and eye tests.
* We offer a range of tools to support your wellbeing, including core hours, 10 remote days (from home or a country with a Condé Nast office location), access to our Employee Assistance Programme, corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
* We’re a dog\-friendly office, plus you’ll enjoy discounts and magazine subscriptions, keeping you up to date with all things Condé Nast.
* We encourage personal and professional growth through the Condé Nast Learning Hub, where you’ll find an extensive portfolio of learning courses and training available in local languages.
* Our Employee Resource Groups provide a platform for employees to identify shared objectives, exchange ideas, and work on community priorities for our global workforce.


**What happens next?**
 If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.
   

  

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 Experience Design Director \- EA SPORTS Network

***available for this role.***
 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and
   

  

 fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that
   

  

 connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are

 EA SPORTS is one of the leading sports entertainment brands in the world, with top\-
   

  

 selling videogame franchises, award\-winning interactive technology, fan programs,
   

  

 and cross\-platform digital experiences. EA SPORTS creates connected experiences
   

  

 that ignite the emotion of sport through industry\-leading sports video games,
   

  

 including Madden NFL and College Football , FC soccer, NHL hockey, and
   

  

 EA SPORTS UFC .
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Experience Design Lead (Creative Director) is the vision\-holder for how fans interact with the future of EA SPORTS, reporting to the Sr. Director of EA SPORTS Network. Serving as the design and user\-experience anchor of the Network leadership team, this leader is responsible for transforming complex, shared platform and network capabilities into intuitive, memorable, and high\-fidelity consumer experiences.
   

  

 Rather than focusing on a single franchise or product, this role defines the design principles, reusable experience systems, and connected fan journeys that weave individual games (such as Madden NFL, FC, and College Football) into a cohesive, immersive EA SPORTS ecosystem. This role will be a visionary design leader who can establish and scale the Experience Design function for SPORTS Network, instill a design\-centric culture across the team, and champion design innovation in partnership with studios and design partners within EA SPORTS.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 Experience Strategy:
   

  

* Ecosystem Experience Vision: Define the long\-term, multi\-platform vision for a connected EA SPORTS experiences, spanning console, mobile, web, and companion applications.
* Consumer\-First Design Principles: Translate strategic growth objectives into high\-caliber consumer experience principles that put the fan journey at the center.
* Ecosystem Roadmaps: Author and drive long\-term experience design roadmaps that anticipate and support future portfolio growth and platform capabilities.


**Connected Fan Experiences**
* Unified Journeys: Map and refine end\-to\-end fan journeys that connect multiple EA SPORTS experiences, standardizing how identity, personalization, recognition, commerce, and community are experienced.
* Scalable Design Systems: Establish, govern, and continuously evolve scalable design systems, UI/UX toolkits, and reusable interaction models across the portfolio.
* Preserve Franchise Identity: Balance the need for network\-wide experience consistency with the unique, highly branded visual identity of individual sports franchises.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* The Leadership Triad: Partner directly with the Sr. Director of Product Management and Technical Director to build a user\-centered development lifecycle where design, technology, and business goals align.
* Experience Workshops: Lead collaborative experience workshops and build alignment around shared consumer experiences across different team boundaries.
* Influence without Authority: Guide design direction and build consensus across disparate teams, studios, and brand partners through collaboration rather than direct authority.


**Experience Innovation \& Data Informed Design**
* Emerging Interactions: Explore and prototype next\-generation interaction models, including AI\-enabled personalization, spatial design, and real\-time sports feed integrations.
* Data\-Informed Iteration: leverage user research, player data, and run experience design workflows to continuously iterate and elevate experiences.


**Your Qualifications**
* Experience: 10\+ years of experience leading UX, Product Design, Experience Design, or Creative Direction for world\-class, large\-scale digital consumer ecosystems or entertainment products.
* Ecosystem Design: A strong portfolio demonstrating the creation of unified, multi\-platform design systems and seamless consumer journeys across web, mobile, and console.
* Experience leveraging AI in prototyping and creative or design concepting.
* Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance high\-level creative strategy with operational execution and governance.
* Tooling \& Workflows: Mastery of Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, advanced prototyping tools, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Storytelling: Exceptional executive storytelling, visual communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of building alignment through influence.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent experience.


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well\-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

description:
**Job Requisition ID \#**
 26WD100658
   

  

**Creative Director, Product \& Experiences — Flow Studio (Remote)**
 Location: Remote US or Canada \| Los Angeles area preferred
   

  

 Organization: Flow Studio Product
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **Creative Director** 
 to help define what AI filmmaking can become with Autodesk Flow Studio. This is a rare opportunity to shape both the creative direction of the product itself and the films, experiments, demos, and cultural moments that show the world what it can do.
   

  

 This is an AI\-first, hands\-on creative leadership role embedded within the Flow Studio Product organization. You’ll have significant creative freedom, lead a dedicated content team, work closely with Product leadership, and get hands\-on with emerging AI filmmaking tools and workflows. The work can range from ambitious cinematic showcases and AI films to fast\-moving social experiments designed to earn attention organically.
   

  

 You’ll own the creative bar for everything that lives in or represents the product: the creative look and feel of key product surfaces, cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, templates and examples, demos, launch storytelling, and other content that helps creators understand what Flow Studio can make possible.
   

  

 You’ll also be the primary product\-side creative partner to Flow Studio Marketing, helping shape concepts, promos, launch videos, campaigns, social content, and other external storytelling. Marketing leads audience, campaign, channel, and brand strategy; this role brings the product’s creative vision, AI filmmaking expertise, cinematic taste, and product truth into the work.
   

  

 The ideal person is already deeply engaged in AI filmmaking, has exceptional visual taste and a strong cinematic eye, understands internet culture and social trends, and wants the freedom and resources to make ambitious work that people actually want to watch.
   

  

**Please submit a portfolio or reel with your application.**
 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Own the creative vision and quality bar for Flow Studio across in\-product creative experiences, cinematic content, libraries, demos, showcases, and product storytelling.
* Lead and develop the Flow Studio content team, setting creative priorities, directing execution, mentoring contributors, and building a team capable of producing exceptional work quickly.
* Create and direct ambitious AI filmmaking work—from cinematic showcases and product films to reference\-quality experiments that push the creative possibilities of Flow Studio.
* Work hands\-on with emerging AI image, video, performance, animation, and filmmaking tools; prototype new ideas, test new models and techniques, and turn experimentation into finished creative work.
* Shape the creative layer of the product itself, including cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, examples, templates, onboarding content, reusable scene elements, and other creator\-facing experiences.
* Bring strong filmmaking judgment to camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, visual treatment, and storytelling across the work.
* Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering from early feature development through launch, translating new capabilities into compelling creative experiences and demonstrations.
* Act as the primary product\-side creative partner to Marketing for launches, campaigns, promotional films, social, web, events, and other external storytelling—helping shape concepts, scripts, storyboards, visuals, and execution.
* Identify opportunities around emerging AI, filmmaking, and social trends, and create culturally relevant, internet\-native work that is distinctive, timely, highly shareable, and capable of earning meaningful organic reach.
* Build lightweight creative standards, reusable assets, and production practices that help the team maintain a very high bar without slowing down experimentation.


**Qualifications**
* Exceptional portfolio or reel demonstrating outstanding cinematic taste, storytelling, and creative direction.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with AI filmmaking and modern generative creative tools, with a strong understanding of the rapidly evolving image, video, performance, animation, and AI production landscape.
* Strong filmmaking instincts across camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, and visual storytelling. Cinematography or directing experience is a major plus.
* Proven ability to originate and create ambitious cinematic work—not only manage or review the work of others.
* Strong understanding of viral, social, and internet\-native content, with sharp awareness of emerging social media trends, formats, platforms, and online culture. Demonstrated experience creating or directing work that has earned meaningful organic reach, audience engagement, or cultural traction.
* Experience leading creative teams, giving direct and constructive feedback, and maintaining a consistently high creative bar.
* Comfort working closely with Product and Engineering teams and turning emerging technology and complex product capabilities into compelling creative ideas, demonstrations, and experiences.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Flow Studio develops a recognizable creative voice and a consistently exceptional quality bar across the product, its content, and the work shown publicly.
* New product capabilities become films, demos, experiments, and creative experiences that make people immediately understand—and want to try—what Flow Studio can do.
* The content team becomes a fast, ambitious creative engine that can produce both high\-end cinematic work and culturally relevant, internet\-native experiments.

**JOIN US ON OUR MISSION TO BECOME THE \#1 RETAIL TRADING PLATFORM IN THE WORLD** 




 Welcome to the dynamic world of NinjaTrader! As an industry\-leading trading platform and futures broker, we're empowering traders to take control of their financial destiny. How do we do it? We provide cutting\-edge products and services that enhance the trading journey. Whether a seasoned pro or just starting out, NinjaTrader equips traders with award\-winning software and brokerage services to navigate the world's leading financial markets with confidence.
 



  





 Our growth story is nothing short of exhilarating. Since 2003, NinjaTrader has been dedicated to understanding and supporting traders on their journey toward trading triumph. Through those efforts, our user base has grown to over 2 million users and we have become the number one rated futures brokerage worldwide.
 



  





 But we're not stopping there. We're constantly evolving, pushing boundaries, and modernizing the futures industry. Our commitment to innovation means users will always have access to dynamic tools, real\-time support, and a community of like\-minded traders.
 



  





 So, why work at NinjaTrader? Here, you're not just part of a team; you're part of a movement. We empower employees to reach new heights in their careers by providing a dynamic culture focused on social connection, professional development, and employee recognition initiatives. Sounds too good to be true? Take it from our employees.
 



  





 Join us as we redefine what's possible in trading, advocate for our customers, and continue our journey toward becoming the world's top retail\-focused trading platform in the world.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 NinjaTrader is hiring a Creative Director to own how the company looks, sounds and feels across every marketing surface a consumer encounters. This is the senior\-most creative role in the marketing organization, reporting directly to the CMO.
 



  





 Our brand strategy and positioning are sharp, but the visual expression lags behind.. This is an opportunity to level up our visual identity to reflect the dynamic and growing nature of the brands we have in market. Then your job is to make it real — operationalize it, extend it into the places it doesn't yet reach, and defend it as volume scales. After that, you own the creative standard for the group.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will set direction, and you will still be in the file. We are not hiring someone to run a review calendar.
 



  





 Trading is a category of noise: identical charts, identical claims, identical stock photography of men in headsets. The mandate is to make NinjaTrader unmistakable.
 



  





**In this role you will:** 




 The marketing identity system
 


* Operationalize the incoming brand identity system — typography, color, photography and illustration direction, motion language, iconography, layout systems — and extend it into the surfaces it does not yet cover
* Own the marketing design system: build it to scale across campaign, web, lifecycle and partner surfaces, and to hold up when other hands use it
* Establish the governance that keeps the system intact — standards, documentation, review, and the authority to say no
* Act as the final quality gate on brand expression across marketing



  





 Creative output and storytelling
 


* Concept and direct integrated campaigns from brief to launch — video, social, paid, OOH, sponsorship, events
* Develop the narrative, not just the look. You will shape the story a piece of video tells, then art\-direct the production that delivers it
* Own marketing web and landing page design, including the pages that carry acquisition and conversion volume
* Direct lifecycle and product marketing creative so the experience stays coherent from first impression to funded account
* Stay personally in the work on hero projects — concepting, designing, writing direction, cutting with the editor



  





 Team and partners
 


* Hire, manage and develop a small in\-house design team; set the critique culture and the standard
* Brief, direct and evaluate agencies, production partners and freelancers; own creative quality of outsourced work
* Build the operating rhythm — briefs, reviews, handoffs — that lets a small team ship at volume
* Grow into broader creative ownership over time, including copy and video production



  





 Cross\-functional leadership
 


* Partner with Product Design on shared brand guidelines so marketing and platform surfaces stay recognizably the same brand. Product Design owns the product design system; you own the marketing one. The two are deliberately scoped differently and should stay that way
* Work with performance marketing to build creative that is testable, iterable and measured against funnel outcomes
* Operate fluently inside a regulated marketing environment, partnering with compliance early rather than treating review as a downstream tax



  





**What you'll need:** 



* 8\+ years of brand and creative experience, with 2\+ years leading a team as an ACD, CD or design lead
* A portfolio built on systems, not one\-offs
* Storytelling range — able to develop narrative, not only art\-direct someone else's script
* Range across brand campaign work and performance creative
* A desire to remain hands\-on — actively driven to stay in the work, not just direct it
* Fluency with AI tooling in the creative process
* A track record of managing designers and directing external agencies
* Comfort with performance data



  





**Bonus Points for:** 



* Fintech, brokerage, trading, crypto or exchange experience, or genuine curiosity about markets and retail traders
* Experience operationalizing an inherited identity system rather than only building from scratch
* Experience running a marketing design system alongside a separately owned product design system
* Experience in a constrained or regulated environment — finance, healthcare, insurance, pharma or gaming
* Practicing a craft outside the day job — photography, film, writing or illustration
* Agency background plus in\-house leadership experience



  





**Compensation:** 




 The salary range for this role will be $166,000\.00 \- $216,000\.00 USD. In addition, this position will also receive an annual target bonus of 15%. Bonus pay at NinjaTrader is based on individual performance (50%) as well as company/team performance (50%).
 



  





 Salary and bonus earnings are only two components of the total compensation package offered by NinjaTrader. NinjaTrader offers a 401K plan through ADP under which the company will match up to 3\.5% of employee contributions. Annual paid time off allowance accrues at a rate of 23 days per year plus seven paid holidays.
 



  





**Location:** 




 This role is based in Chicago, IL. \*There may be remote flexibility for exceptional candidates in the following states: California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Washington DC, Wisconsin.
 



  





**Hybrid:** 




 For Chicago\-based employees, we follow a hybrid work schedule: In\-office Tuesday through Thursday, with remote work on Mondays and Fridays. In addition to these weekly remote days, we offer:
 


* 20 additional flex remote days annually
* 5 Company Wide Office\-Optional weeks tied to major holidays



  





**Our Core Benefits Include:**

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Thesis**
 Thesis is an independent agency working at the intersection of creativity, strategy, and technology. We partner with ambitious brands to solve complex business and marketing challenges and create ideas, experiences, and systems built to scale. We’re evolving how we work to bring thinking and making closer together, build more accountable teams, and use technology and AI to expand what’s creatively possible.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Creative Director at Thesis, you’ll establish the creative vision for the clients, teams, and opportunities you lead. You’ll turn business and audience challenges into ideas worth pursuing, build belief around those ideas, and lead multidisciplinary teams to make them real. You’re a thinker and a maker with strong taste, strategic instincts, and the ability to move between ideas and execution. You know when to get into the work and when to create space for others to lead. You’ll be accountable for the idea, the people, the client relationship, and the creative outcome, while managing, mentoring, and developing the next generation of creative leaders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**Creative Vision \& Ideas**
* Establish the creative vision for assigned clients, accounts, and opportunities.
* Turn business, audience, and cultural insights into strong ideas and creative opportunities.
* Lead concept development and ensure ideas maintain their integrity as they scale across channels, experiences, and content.


**Strategic Thinking**
* Partner with Strategy and clients to define the problem and opportunity before defining the deliverable.
* Connect creative decisions to audience needs, brand ambition, culture, and business objectives.
* Look beyond the immediate ask to identify opportunities for greater client and creative impact.


**Creative \& People Leadership**
* Lead multidisciplinary teams across design, writing, motion, experience, content, and emerging disciplines.
* Set a high creative standard while staying close enough to the work to meaningfully shape and elevate it.
* Manage, mentor, and develop creative talent and emerging leaders through clear expectations, feedback, and meaningful opportunities for growth.
* Build teams that can increasingly operate with ownership and autonomy.


**Client Leadership \& Storytelling**
* Serve as a trusted creative partner to senior clients.
* Build belief in ideas through clear, compelling storytelling and presentations.
* Navigate feedback and business constraints while protecting the creative ambition.

title: Creative Strategist, Mexico
description:
**Job Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
 Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Where And How You Can Work**
 Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote\-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Mexico City so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
   

  

 This role is a 12 month engagement, working full time hours per week.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Creative Strategist for Mexico, you’ll be the creative performance engine behind Canva’s paid marketing in the region.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Growth, and Data \- combining cultural insight, analytical depth, and creative instinct to continuously improve our performance marketing output. You won’t be running bids day\-to\-day \- you’ll be driving the creative strategy that makes those campaigns win.
   

  

 If you love decoding what makes a hook scroll\-stopping, turning insights into structured testing, and raising the creative bar sprint after sprint, this role is for you.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Leading the full creative cycle \- research, briefing, production, and performance review — running weekly sprint cycles that balance quick\-win iterations with bigger creative swings, and feeding learnings back to the broader team after every sprint
* Digging into performance dashboards to spot winning patterns, diagnose underperformance, and translate insights into clear, actionable creative direction that drives the next round of concepts
* Directing and collaborating with video editors, designers, writers, and local creators to produce high\-quality work across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels \- briefing and reviewing content to keep it on\-brand, culturally relevant, and platform\-optimised
* Bringing deep cultural fluency to every brief \- identifying Mexican audience behaviours, regional trends, and platform dynamics that shape compelling, locally resonant storytelling
* Working closely with media buyers, data science, and the LatAm Growth Marketing Lead to make sure creative insights translate into measurable business outcomes
* Driving CRO initiatives that improve acquisition journeys and lift conversion efficiency across key touchpoints
* Using AI tools to accelerate ideation, research, asset generation, and analysis \- and staying across emerging formats and creative tech that give the team an edge


**You’re Probably a Match If**
* You have solid experience in growth or performance marketing with a strong focus on creative strategy \- and you've worked hands\-on across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube
* You can lead structured creative testing and sprint frameworks, analyse what's working, and turn those learnings into clear briefs for the next cycle
* You have strong creative instinct \- you know what makes a hook scroll\-stopping, a format compelling, and a concept scalable across channels
* You're fluent in Spanish and English, with a sharp eye for tone, nuance, and cultural resonance for Mexican audiences
* You have experience briefing, directing, and iterating with creative talent — video editors, designers, writers, and creators \- coaching them to produce performance\-driven work
* You're confident using dashboards and analytics tools to inform decisions and optimise creative at scale
* You use AI tools to accelerate your workflow and improve output quality


**Meet the team**
 We're Canva's LatAm Marketing group, and our mission is to make Canva the most loved brand in the region. We build culturally resonant, high\-impact marketing across Latin America \- combining bold creative storytelling with sharp performance thinking to drive visibility and growth, market by market. Mexico is a key focus for us right now, and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition.

 We make decisions to engage contractors based on your experience, skills and passion.

 Dubai, UAE \| Full\-time \| Office\-based (WFH Fridays)

 As Creative Director, you'll set the creative standard for every concept, deck and experience the agency delivers. title: Creative Director

================

* Able to take a complex B2B business and find the idea that makes it land with real people, then sell it in the room.
* A developer of people, giving direct feedback, creating real opportunities, and taking your team's growth personally.
* Commercially sharp, running creative on your accounts profitably and building client relationships that grow.
* Ahead of the problem, whether that's work drifting off strategy, a team stretched too thin, or a client losing confidence.

Creative Direction \& Craft* Execute at a senior level on a subset of client work, from concept through production\-ready files, taking on the projects that most need your hands.

Account \& Agency Partnership* Serve as a core team member on your accounts alongside account, strategy, and channel leads.

* Experience presenting and selling creative work to client leadership.
* Digital and content fluency, including how creative performs across channels.
* Experience running creative profitably, including scope, resourcing, and timelines.
* Experience evaluating or rolling out tools and workflows across a team, including AI.
* Portfolio showing range, craft, and ideas that moved client businesses.
  

At Godfrey, we are guided by 5 core values that all team members are expected to embrace: Fascination, Drive, Partnership, Transparency and Community. By following these principles, we have become the driving force behind many B2B brands’ success stories.

* The ability to work independently and meet deadlines
* Excellent communication and organizational skills
* A genuine interest in creative collaboration

**Magazine, editorial, publishing or print experience is a major plus.**

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is **creative, enthusiastic and excited by the opportunity to make something distinctive.**

**THE PROJECT**

This is a **project\-based position** for the 50th Anniversary print issue of Head Magazine.

**Compensation: $5,000 project fee**

The Art Director will work directly with the publisher/editor throughout the project. The exact production schedule will be discussed with the selected candidate.

This is an opportunity to have your work associated with a **historic publication and a significant anniversary issue** — and to have substantial creative input into how that history is presented to a new generation.
