You will challenge incomplete requirements, ensure work is ready before commitment, and make risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs transparent.


This is a technically credible leadership role rather than a full\-time coding position. You must be able to review designs, challenge architectural decisions, guide engineers and the Technical Lead, and enter the code or production diagnostics when necessary.


This role requires a change\-oriented leader who can improve the operating model while maintaining delivery and production continuity across a complex product landscape.

**What We're Looking For:**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


Team Leadership and Development

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing multidisciplinary team of approximately eight people, including internal engineers and external contributors.
* Conduct regular one\-to\-one meetings, provide timely feedback, manage performance, and create career\-development plans.
* Own hiring, onboarding, capability planning, career development, continuity planning for critical roles, and recommendations related to progression.
* Strengthen the Technical Lead role and clarify accountability across Engineering, Product, and QA.
* Foster ownership, collaboration, psychological safety, continuous learning, and constructive challenge.
**Delivery Ownership and Predictability**

* Be accountable for engineering execution and delivery predictability across the Remarketing scope.
* Translate roadmap priorities into realistic delivery plans based on capacity, dependencies, risks, technical constraints, and operational workload.
* Provide high\-level estimates and estimated delivery dates, revising them transparently as scope or evidence changes.
* Own sprint planning, execution control, reviews, retrospectives, refinement facilitation, capacity planning, and continuous improvement.
* Protect the team from uncontrolled scope changes and ad hoc requests, ensuring accepted work is visible, prioritized, and traceable in Jira.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies, release readiness, and scope\-versus\-timeline trade\-offs.
* Use engineering and delivery metrics to reduce carry\-over, improve flow, and communicate progress and risk.
**Product and Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Operate under a clear model: Product defines the what and why; Engineering owns feasible execution of the when and how.
* Challenge unclear requirements and ensure initiatives meet agreed Definition of Ready standards before commitment.
* Contribute engineering input to discovery, functional analyses, RFCs, roadmap feasibility, non\-functional requirements, and sequencing.
* Partner with Product to ensure that roadmap items are translated into delivery\-ready epics, with clear scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and intended outcomes, before Engineering commits to execution.
* Work with Customer Success, Professional Services, PMO, Sales, and Support through agreed channels and explicit ownership boundaries.
* Participate in customer interactions only exceptionally, primarily for critical technical escalations.
**Quality, SDLC and Operational Excellence**

* Drive a disciplined and traceable SDLC, with Jira as the source of truth for engineering execution.
* Establish and enforce Definitions of Ready and Done, release criteria, quality gates, and consistent issue\-type usage.
* Ensure that the team implements an appropriate automated\-testing strategy across the relevant test levels, in partnership with the Technical Lead and QA.
* Be accountable for integrating security, reliability, observability, performance, and operability into engineering planning and execution, in collaboration with the relevant specialist teams.
* Own engineering participation in incident response, root\-cause analysis, bug triage, corrective actions, and post\-release monitoring.
* Balance roadmap delivery, defects, operational support, technical debt, and modernization.
**Technical Leadership and Modernization**

* Review solution designs, challenge architectural choices, and guide decisions with the Technical Lead and Architecture.
* Provide organizational leadership for modernization initiatives, partnering with the Technical Lead and Architecture on technical direction and execution.
* Ensure that technical decisions across distributed systems, APIs, mobile and web applications, data stores, integrations, and asynchronous workflows are appropriately reviewed and owned.
* Champion SOLID principles, clean and modular architectures, pragmatic domain\-driven design, secure engineering, and useful documentation.
* Ensure technical debt is understood, connected to business impact, and transparently discussed with Product.
* Support the responsible integration of AI\-enabled capabilities and external AI services without requiring specialist model\-development expertise.
**Cloud, DevOps and Production Operations**

* Lead the team in operating cloud workloads, preferably on AWS, with sound decisions on scalability, resilience, security, cost, and service ownership.
* Drive effective CI/CD, infrastructure automation, release management, environment strategy, and rollback practices.
* Use logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service\-level indicators to improve system health.
* Ensure services and integrations meet the availability, resilience, recovery, security, and documentation requirements appropriate to their business criticality.
**SKILLS**

**Leadership and Delivery**

* Strong people management, coaching, hiring, performance management, conflict resolution, and stakeholder communication.
* Proven ability to develop senior engineers and Technical Leads and manage mixed internal and external teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery, capacity planning, dependencies, release planning, and risk management.
* Ability to create clarity and make difficult scope, capacity, and priority trade\-offs.
* Strong command of Agile and lean principles without treating ceremonies as a substitute for outcomes.
* Business\-oriented mindset connecting technical decisions to customer value, quality, cost, and operational impact.
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong software\-engineering foundation and recent experience leading distributed, customer\-facing cloud systems.
* Experience with architecture and modernization across APIs, backend services, web and mobile applications, databases, and integrations.
* Strong experience operating cloud workloads, preferably on AWS, combined with practical knowledge of containers, CI/CD, observability, security, reliability, and production operations.
* Technology\-stack agnostic, with the ability to lead environments that may include .NET, React/Next.js, Flutter, and legacy technologies.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, quality gates, secure SDLC practices, and maintainable software design.
* Ability to lead a team integrating AI\-enabled capabilities and external AI services, without requiring specialist model\-development expertise.
**Language and Soft Skills**

* Fluent English is mandatory; French is a plus.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities.
* High ownership, sound judgement, and effectiveness under ambiguity.
* Constructive assertiveness and confidence to challenge unrealistic commitments or incomplete inputs.
* Collaborative leadership with strong negotiation and cross\-functional skills.
**EXPERIENCE**

* A minimum of 8 years in software engineering, including at least 3 years in engineering management or an equivalent leadership role.
* Proven experience managing and developing multidisciplinary software\-engineering teams.
* Demonstrated success delivering and operating complex SaaS or cloud\-based products in production.
* Experience leading modernization, legacy reduction, or platform evolution while continuing to deliver customer value.
* Experience improving software quality, SDLC discipline, automated testing, release governance, and operational reliability.
* Strong cloud and modern DevOps experience; AWS experience is preferred.
* Experience managing customer\-impacting incidents, cross\-team dependencies, and critical technical escalations.
* Experience in automotive software, digital marketplaces, image processing, mobile products, or AI\-enabled products is advantageous but not required.
**COLLABORATION AND LEADERSHIP**


You will operate as the engineering owner for the Remarketing domain, partnering with Product on roadmap execution while maintaining clear accountability for engineering capacity, delivery, quality, technical sustainability, and team development. Success requires a builder and change\-agent mindset: creating clarity, strengthening ownership, improving the operating model, and helping the team deliver valuable outcomes with greater predictability and confidence.

**Our Recruitment Process:**

* Interview with Product Director.

**What We Offer:**


We understand that **flexibility and trust** are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* **Remote Work:** Up to 3 days a week!

**Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging**


At Nextlane, we are committed to creating a space where **everyone feels valued and respected**. We firmly believe that diversity in experiences and backgrounds strengthens our culture and drives innovation.

* **Support for people with disabilities.** If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, let us know so we can provide the best possible experience.

Join **Nextlane** and become part of the technological revolution in the automotive industry.


Discover why we are a great place to develop your talent!

title: Director, Clinical FSP Go to Market/Therapeutic Strategy Lead
description:
Madrid, Spain \| Full time \| Home\-based \| R1550402  
Join us on our exciting journey!  


IQVIA™ is The Human Data Science Company™, focused on using data and science to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. Formed through the merger of IMS Health and Quintiles, IQVIA offers a broad range of solutions that harness advances in healthcare information, technology, analytics, and human ingenuity to drive healthcare forward.  


Director, Clinical FSP Go to Market/Therapeutic Strategy Lead  


The Director, Clinical FSP Go to Market/TSL is the link between key customers and IQVIA, with a primary focus on supporting and leading the design of FSP Solutions and cFSP NNB growth from early engagement, client discussions, to RFI, RFP and bid defense meetings.  


He/she is in charge to work closely with Sales, BD, account teams and operations, by providing insights and strategy for customer solutions based on understood requirements across functions.  


Responsibilities  


Lead Clinical FSP go\-to\-market activity by translating IQVIA’s FSP strategy, value proposition and differentiated capabilities into compelling customer\-facing positioning, messaging and solution narratives.  
Partner with Sales, Business Development, account teams and CFSP leadership to identify, shape and progress priority FSP opportunities from early engagement through RFI, RFP, proposal development and bid defense.  
Support active and potential sales opportunities by providing FSP subject matter expertise, customer insight, competitive positioning, win themes and practical guidance on the most appropriate FSP, hybrid or flexible delivery model.  
Enable regional Sales and Business Development teams to act as confident FSP ambassadors by creating and maintaining reusable materials, capability decks, battle cards, case studies, solution examples and client\-ready messaging.  
Drive structured early engagement with customers through discovery discussions, workshops, capability presentations and proactive account planning, with a focus on expanding the customer base and increasing FSP new business growth.  
Collaborate across CFSP, Operations, Therapeutic Centers of Excellence, Strategic Sites, Technology, Pricing, Talent Acquisition, Marketing and Sales Enablement to build integrated, feasible and differentiated customer solutions.  
Shape FSP solution design best practices to support increasingly complex customer demands, including multi\-functional FSPs, blended FSP/FSO models, flexible resourcing constructs, hub\-based delivery and technology\-enabled solutions.  
Lead or contribute to proposal strategy, response development and review, ensuring the final customer response clearly reflects the client need, IQVIA’s FSP value proposition, operational feasibility, commercial logic and competitive differentiation.  
Develop and refine opportunity\-specific narratives, executive summaries, client presentations and bid defense materials that articulate IQVIA’s FSP strengths in a clear, credible and outcome\-focused manner.  
Support pricing and commercial strategy discussions by aligning the proposed FSP model, resource assumptions, role mapping, locations and delivery approach with customer expectations and contribution margin requirements.  
Coordinate internal alignment across opportunity teams by clarifying roles, responsibilities, ownership, review timelines, open questions and leadership decisions required to advance high\-quality submissions.  
Represent Clinical FSP in customer meetings, internal strategy discussions and bid defenses, presenting the FSP value proposition, solution rationale, flexible delivery options and key differentiators as required.  
Maintain awareness of FSP market trends, customer outsourcing priorities, competitive dynamics, innovation themes and IQVIA capability developments to continuously strengthen the GTM narrative and sales materials.  
Capture lessons learned from opportunities, client discussions and implemented models to improve future FSP positioning, repeatability, scalability and quality of go\-to\-market execution.  
Support long\-term enterprise growth by expanding IQVIA’s FSP services and value, increasing Business Development fluency, strengthening competitive edge and helping the organisation “see more, win more” in Clinical FSP.  


Our Ideal Candidate  


12\+ years of clinical research, clinical operations, FSP, outsourcing or drug development experience; equivalent education/training accepted.  
Strong understanding of Clinical FSP delivery models, including functional outsourcing, hybrid FSP/FSO, flexible resourcing, hub\-based delivery and multi\-functional FSP constructs.  
Commercially minded, with the ability to translate IQVIA capabilities into clear customer value propositions, differentiated messaging and practical solution narratives.  
Experience supporting RFIs, RFPs, proposals, customer presentations, workshops and bid defenses.  
Strong ability to partner with Sales, Business Development, account teams and Operations to shape early engagement, qualify customer needs and progress priority opportunities.  
Confident developing or contributing to sales enablement materials, capability decks, proposal content, case studies, battle cards and reusable client\-ready messaging.  
Strong cross\-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align Operations, Pricing, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Marketing and leadership around feasible and competitive customer solutions.  
Solid understanding of clinical trial delivery, drug development, customer outsourcing priorities and key FSP market trends.  
Financial and commercial confidence, including comfort with resource assumptions, pricing logic, contribution margin, role mapping and delivery model trade\-offs.  
Excellent communication, presentation and executive storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex operational topics into clear, outcome\-focused messages.  
Strong influencing and negotiation skills, with the confidence to manage challenging discussions and drive alignment across matrix teams.  
Technologically confident, with the ability to use data, business intelligence, competitive insights and digital tools to support opportunity strategy and GTM execution.  
Able to work effectively under pressure, manage competing priorities and maintain momentum across multiple opportunities.  
Collaborative, constructive and growth\-oriented, with the ability to coach others, share lessons learned and strengthen FSP fluency across the organisation.  


Why Join?  


You can drive your career at IQVIA and choose the path that best defines your development and success. With exposure across diverse geographies, capabilities, and vast therapeutic and information and technology areas, you can seek opportunities to change and grow without boundaries.  


We know that meaningful results require not only the right approach but also the fitting personality. Regardless of your role, we invite you to reimagine healthcare with us. You will have the opportunity to play an important part in helping our clients drive healthcare forward and ultimately improve human health outcomes.  


It is an exciting time to join and reimagine what's possible in healthcare.  


Moving healthcare forward. Together.  


IQVIA is a strong advocate of diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We believe that a work environment that embraces diversity will give us a competitive advantage in the global marketplace and enhance our success. We believe that an inclusive and respectful workplace culture fosters a sense of belonging among our employees, builds a stronger team, and allows individual employees the opportunity to maximize their personal potential.  


IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com  


IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.  


Where you'll work  
Home\-based  


You’ll work remotely, with the flexibility to do your best work from home. Supported by collaborative tools and a global team, you’ll stay connected while enjoying the autonomy and balance that comes with a fully remote role.  
Culture  


Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

title: Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Copy & Content
description:
**About Darkroom**
==================

**Darkroom** is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**Location:** Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only \- supporting a team in the EST time zone.

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand\-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high\-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.


You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first\-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.


This is a copy\-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

**You should apply if this sounds like you**
============================================


You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

* 3–5\+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.
* You write excellent short\-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.
* You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected\-device brand is a strong plus.
* You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt\-in copy, welcome series, first\-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.
* You have written loyalty, rewards, and win\-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long\-term value is a core outcome of this role.
* You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.
* You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.
* You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.
* You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high\-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.
* You are detail\-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.
* Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

**A day in the life**
=====================

* Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.
* Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.
* Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.
* Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.
* Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.
* Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.
* Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.
* Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
======================================


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

 **Equal Opportunity Statement**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Senior Manager / Procurement Strategy Consulting / Sourcing & Procurement
description:
**About the Firm**
------------------


We are the \#1 global consulting firm specialized in Sourcing \& Procurement. Our practice partners with CPOs, CFOs, COOs and CSCOs at the world's leading organizations to transform procurement functions into insight\-driven engines for growth, efficiency, resilience, and sustainability. Through our AI\-driven platform SynOps, proprietary market intelligence, and deep category expertise, we deliver end\-to\-end value across direct, indirect, and capex spend at scale. Our two flagship offerings — Spend Optimization and Procurement Reinvention — combine strategic advisory, managed services, and cutting\-edge agentic AI to generate measurable ROI for our clients.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


We are seeking a Senior Manager to join our Sourcing \& Procurement practice. This is a senior client\-facing role that combines deep functional procurement expertise with a strong business development mindset. The successful candidate will lead complex client engagements across Spend Optimization and Procurement Reinvention, develop relationships at C\-level, and actively contribute to the growth of the practice — ideally bringing an existing network in the Resources sector (Utilities, Oil \& Gas).


  

**What You Will Do**


Client Delivery \& Functional Leadership

* Lead end\-to\-end procurement transformation engagements, covering spend analysis, sourcing strategy, category management, supplier performance, and operating model design.
* Deploy Spend Optimization solutions (SG\&A and COGS) and Procurement Reinvention programs, including AI\-first operating model design, process redesign, and ecosystem integration (SAP/Ariba, Coupa, iValua, iCertis).
* Oversee the design and implementation of Supplier 360 and procurement analytics dashboards to enable client visibility and insight\-driven decision\-making.
* Drive value realization through outcome\-based commercial models, with a track record of delivering measurable results (cost savings, supplier reduction, compliance improvement).

 **Business Development \& Client Relationships**

* Build and nurture C\-level relationships (CPO, CFO, COO, CSCO) at existing and target accounts, acting as a trusted advisor and thought partner.
* Proactively identify and qualify new business opportunities, contributing to proposals, RFP responses, and executive presentations.
* Leverage an existing network — particularly in the Resources sector (Utilities, Oil \& Gas) — to generate pipeline and accelerate commercial conversations.
* Develop compelling points of view and credentials that differentiate the firm's offering in the market.

 **People \& Practice Development**

* Manage and mentor multi\-disciplinary project teams, fostering a high\-performance culture and developing junior talent.
* Contribute to internal capability building, including knowledge management, methodology development, and training programs.
* Collaborate with ecosystem partners (SAP, Coupa, iValua, and others) and cross\-functional teams to design integrated solutions.

 **What We Are Looking For**

 **Experience**

* 8–15 years of experience in procurement consulting, with a minimum of 4 years at a top\-tier management consulting or specialist procurement advisory firm.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale procurement transformation programs: spend optimization, category management, operating model redesign, and/or technology\-enabled procurement.
* Strong industry exposure in Resources (Utilities and/or Oil \& Gas) as a primary focus; additional experience in Consumer Goods, Life Sciences, Industrials, or High Tech is a plus.
* Experience working with C\-level stakeholders and managing complex client relationships across multi\-country or global engagements.
* Demonstrable contribution to business development: pipeline generation, proposal leadership, or client network development.

 **Functional \& Technical Knowledge**

* Deep expertise across the procurement value chain: strategic sourcing, category management, supplier performance, contract management, and procure\-to\-pay.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled procurement tools and platforms (e.g., SynOps, SAP Ariba, Coupa, iValua, iCertis, Spend HQ) and the ability to articulate their ROI to clients.
* Understanding of agentic AI applications in procurement (benchmarking agents, negotiation assistance, intelligent buying channels) and the emerging landscape of AI\-first operating models.
* Knowledge of commercial models: outcome/value\-based deals, fixed fee, hybrid, and FTE\-based structures.
* Proficiency in procurement analytics and data\-driven decision\-making; experience with spend data analysis and dashboarding is a plus.

 **Leadership \& Commercial Attributes**

* Entrepreneurial mindset with a genuine ambition to grow a client portfolio and build lasting relationships — you think like an owner.
* Exceptional executive communication and storytelling skills; able to engage confidently in the boardroom and translate complexity into actionable insight.
* Structured problem\-solving and analytical rigor, with the ability to frame ambiguous situations and drive decisions.
* Strong team leadership: proven ability to inspire, develop, and retain talent in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Fluency in English required; additional European languages (Spanish, German, French) are a strong asset.

 **Ideal Candidate Profile**


The ideal candidate has built their career at the intersection of functional procurement excellence and strategic consulting — ideally with a background at a Big 4, top\-tier management consulting firm, or specialist procurement advisory (e.g., Efficio, Proxima, Accenture, McKinsey, BCG, Kearney). They have operated at Senior Manager or equivalent level, led multi\-million\-dollar engagements, and are now ready to take on increased commercial responsibility.


Equally important is a strong client network — particularly among CPOs, CFOs, and operations leaders in Utilities, Oil \& Gas, or adjacent sectors — and the demonstrated ambition and capability to convert that network into business.

 **What We Offer**

* Market\-leading compensation package: competitive base salary \+ performance bonus \+ long\-term incentives.
* Global platform and international exposure across the firm's priority industries and geographies.
* Access to proprietary AI tools, platforms, and a world\-class ecosystem of technology partners.
* A clear and accelerated path to Director and Managing Director, supported by structured career development.
* A collaborative, high\-performance culture where entrepreneurial drive is actively recognized and rewarded.

title: Director Técnico de Integración, hibrido
description:
Director Técnico de Integración
  
**Descripción de Puesto:** Director Técnico de Integración (España)
  
**Ubicación:** España (Modelo Híbrido / Remoto)
  
**Sector:** Consultoría Tecnológica / Middleware Integration Services
  
**Reporta a:** CTO / CEO
  
1\. Resumen del Puesto
  
Buscamos un Director Técnico de Integración para liderar y consolidar la práctica técnica en España. El candidato asumirá un rol estratégico, posicionándose como el nexo clave entre el negocio, las cuentas estratégicas y la entrega técnica.
  
**Su labor abarcará el ciclo de vida completo de las soluciones:** desde la fase de preventa y consultoría ejecutiva con perfiles C\-Level, pasando por la definición de arquitectura de integración y la supervisión del delivery de múltiples proyectos simultáneos, hasta el liderazgo directo de los equipos técnicos.
  
2\. Responsabilidades Principales
  
Estrategia y Dirección Técnica
  
Definir la visión y los estándares tecnológicos de la práctica de integración en España.
  
**Diseñar e impulsar arquitecturas avanzadas:** orientadas a servicios (SOA), APIs, microservicios, Event\-Driven Architectures y mensajería en entornos híbridos y multi\-cloud.
  
Establecer e implementar modelos de gobierno de APIs, marcos de calidad (ej. CMMI), buenas prácticas y metodologías de diseño.
  
Preventa y Desarrollo de Negocio (Pre\-Sales Consulting)
  
Colaborar directamente con el área comercial en la detección de oportunidades, elaboración de propuestas técnicas y económicas (RFP/RFI) y su defensa ante grandes clientes.
  
Liderar sesiones de consultoría de descubrimiento e interlocución con CIOs, CTOs y directores de IT para transformar necesidades de negocio en arquitecturas viables.
  
Diseñar Pruebas de Concepto (PoC) y arquitecturas de alto nivel (High\-Level Design) para demostrar el valor técnico de las soluciones.
  
Gestión de Proyectos, Clientes y Delivery
  
Supervisar la ejecución y entrega de múltiples proyectos de integración en paralelo, asegurando cumplimiento de tiempos, calidad y rentabilidad.
  
Mantener la relación ejecutiva con stakeholders clave y grandes cuentas, actuando como referente y punto de escalado.
  
Gestionar riesgos, desbloquear desviaciones críticas y coordinar la resolución de incidencias en entornos productivos.
  
  

Liderazgo y Desarrollo de Equipos
  
Dirigir, inspirar y mentorizar a un equipo multidisciplinar formado por Arquitectos de Integración, Devops y Developers.
  
Fomentar planes de desarrollo profesional, la capacitación técnica continua y la asignación eficiente de recursos a las distintas iniciativas.
  
3\. Requisitos del Perfil
  
Experiencia Requerida
  
Más de 15 años de trayectoria en el sector IT, con al menos 8 años en posiciones de dirección técnica, Delivery Manager, Technical Product Owner o Integration Lead en grandes consultoras o clientes corporativos.
  
Sólida experiencia demostrada en preventa tecnológica, licitaciones de gran envergadura y consultoría de valor.

title: Director of User Experience, Core Commerce team - Spain, Remote
Lead Product Manager - RPG
description:
**Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love.** We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top\-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.  

  

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built\-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass\-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.  

  

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.  

  

What powers the loop is talent density. 220\+ people from 30\+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.  

  

At Homa, we are building the next billion\-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**Mission**As a **Lead Product Manager** on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end\-to\-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.


Your main responsibilities will include:

* **Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles:** core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in\-game economy.
* **Own LiveOps end\-to\-end.** You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
* **Lead your team.** You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
* **Oversee the monetization model.** Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
* **Drive growth, in partnership with UA.** You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand\-in\-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
* **Cross\-functional excellence.** You'll work hand\-in\-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end\-to\-end, from concept to launch.
* **Set the bar.** Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
* **Stay hands\-on when it counts.** This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.


This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

 **Requirements**  

We are looking for someone with **several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG,** with genuine end\-to\-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

**Product \& RPG expertise**

* P**roduct experience on live F2P mobile games**, ideally RPG/midcore, with end\-to\-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
* Strong fluency in **RPG mechanics and meta systems:** progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
* Ideally, you’ve taken a title **from concept/pre\-launch through launch and LiveOps**, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

**LiveOps \& Execution**

* Deep **LiveOps experience**, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
* Strong track record **owning features end\-to\-end**: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of **what a live team can realistically ship and maintain**, balancing ambition with feasibility.

**Leadership \& Ways of working**

* Strong **cross\-functional leadership**, able to align Design, Publishing, Data, Economy, UA, Growth and external studios around the product direction.
* A **strategist and builder**: able to set direction and lead others, while remaining highly hands\-on with the game, systems and data.
* Thrives in **lean, fast\-moving, high\-autonomy teams** with quick tests, short feedback loops and high ownership

**Our Culture**
At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

* **Ambition**: We strive for the best \- we don’t settle for “good enough.”
* **Humility**: We recognize that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
* **Curiosity**: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what”.
* **Focus**: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider \- we dive deep into the details.

  

**Benefits**  

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
* **Paris HQ Access:** Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well\-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
* **Coworking Access:** You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
* **Global Team:** Collaborate in English with top\-tier talent from 35\+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
* ✈️ **Team Gatherings:** We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off\-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
* **Performance Reviews:** We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
* **Equipment Support:** From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.


Where We Hire
Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after\-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy \- all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).


We also have incredible team members across Europe \- from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC\+3\). If you're based there \- or planning to be \- we’d love to hear from you!

*Please note: this is one remote position open to multiple countries, not multiple openings.*

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
We have a demand generation and expansion engine that's already running. What we need now is someone who can design the campaign strategies behind it, make the commercial trade\-off decisions that determine where we invest, and take ownership of the outcomes across the full customer lifecycle.



This is a strategic digital marketing role for someone who doesn't just run campaigns — you design them. You decide what we run, why we run it, where we spend, and what we stop doing. You will own the strategic planning and optimization of global digital campaigns — from paid media and nurture programs to ABM plays and customer expansion campaigns — making the calls on channel mix, audience strategy, and budget allocation that determine whether our marketing investment converts into pipeline and revenue.



You will sit within the Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, and working closely with Digital Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Content and Creative. This role strengthens the strategic engine of our demand generation and expansion motion — you're the person who decides what campaigns we build, how we structure them, and where we make trade\-offs to maximize commercial impact across acquisition and growth.



If you're a digital strategist who designs campaign architectures rather than just executing them, makes data\-informed trade\-off decisions with confidence, understands that marketing's job doesn't stop at the closed deal, and wants to be a key contributor in a high\-performing growth team — this is your role.


**What you'll work on**


**Campaign strategy and design**


* Design the strategic framework for global multi\-channel digital campaigns — defining audience strategy, channel mix, sequencing, and budget allocation across paid search, paid social, display, email, and content syndication to hit pipeline and expansion targets
* Make commercial trade\-off decisions on where to invest and where to pull back — you're expected to analyze performance, identify diminishing returns, and reallocate spend and effort based on what's actually driving outcomes
* Define campaign architectures across the full bow\-tie — designing how campaigns work together from awareness and lead generation through to nurture, conversion, and customer expansion, not just launching them one at a time
* Brief the Content and Creative team on what's needed and why — setting clear strategic direction for campaign assets based on audience insight, channel requirements, and commercial goals


**Account\-based marketing strategy and execution**


* Design and execute digital ABM campaign strategies targeting named accounts and account segments — defining the engagement model, channel approach, and success criteria in collaboration with the enterprise and sales teams
* Architect multi\-touch ABM plays that blend paid media, personalized content, email sequences, and retargeting — making deliberate decisions about where to invest across new logo and expansion opportunities
* Stay current on the latest ABM tactics, platforms, and approaches — from intent data providers and programmatic ABM to personalization at scale — and make recommendations on what Duetto should adopt, test, or stop doing
* Define ABM measurement frameworks at the account level — tracking engagement, pipeline influence, and progression rather than just lead volume, and using those insights to reshape strategy


**Nurture, conversion, and expansion strategy**


* Design and optimize nurture strategies across both acquisition and expansion — deciding what workflows we run, how they're structured, and where we need to fix friction across the full bow\-tie
* Define the campaign strategy for customer expansion — designing upsell, cross\-sell, and adoption campaigns that support the commercial goals of the customer success and sales teams, not just repeating acquisition tactics
* Make data\-informed decisions on where to focus conversion optimization effort — prioritizing the stages and segments where improvements will have the greatest commercial impact
* Own the analysis of campaign and channel performance — turning data into strategic recommendations on what to change, scale, or retire across the full lifecycle


**Regional strategy and localization**


* Define how global campaign strategies should be adapted for local markets — making decisions on where to localize messaging, creative, and channel strategy versus where to maintain global consistency
* Provide strategic performance analysis by territory that helps regional teams and leadership understand what digital marketing is delivering — and what needs to change — across both demand generation and expansion


**MarTech and data operations**


* Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the marketing technology stack — making recommendations on how to improve integration between campaign platforms, CRM, and lead routing systems
* Ensure campaign infrastructure supports the strategic ambitions of the growth team — you're the person who sees where the tech is limiting execution and makes the case for fixing it
* Champion clean data practices and campaign hygiene — because the quality of strategic decisions depends on a database you can trust


**AI\-first campaign operations**


* Use AI as a core part of how you design, plan, and optimize campaign strategies — from audience research and competitive analysis to performance modeling and scenario planning
* Bring an AI\-native mindset to campaign strategy — always asking how automation, smarter tooling, and agentic workflows can raise the quality and speed of strategic decision\-making, not just execution
* Contribute to how the Growth Marketing team adopts AI in day\-to\-day work — testing new approaches, sharing what works, and helping build practices that make the whole team faster and sharper
* Treat AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut — the bar for strategic quality, targeting precision, and commercial impact stays high regardless of the tools used


**What we're looking for**


**Experience**


* 5\+ years in digital marketing, growth marketing, or marketing operations — with demonstrable experience designing campaign strategies that have driven measurable pipeline and expansion revenue, not just executing plans built by others
* Demonstrable experience designing and owning digital ABM campaign strategies — defining targeting, engagement models, and measurement frameworks for named accounts or account segments
* Proven ability to make commercial trade\-off decisions across paid media, email, nurture, and content syndication — you know how to read performance data and decide where to invest, scale, or cut
* Experience designing marketing campaigns across both acquisition and customer expansion — you understand the bow\-tie and know how to architect campaigns that drive growth on both sides of it
* Experience with marketing technology platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, and programmatic/ABM tools — you understand the strategic possibilities and limitations of the stack, not just how to operate it
* Background in B2B SaaS preferred — but strong strategic thinking and commercial instinct matter more than sector match


**Skills and capabilities**


* Strong campaign strategist — you design campaign architectures, define audience and channel strategies, and make the decisions that shape what gets built and launched
* Data\-informed decision maker — you don't just report on performance, you interpret it, draw conclusions, and make strategic recommendations that change what the team does next
* Commercially minded — you understand that every campaign decision is a trade\-off and you make those trade\-offs with pipeline and revenue outcomes in mind
* Clear communicator — able to present strategic recommendations, brief creative teams with precision, and articulate the rationale behind campaign decisions to senior stakeholders
* Curious and proactive — you stay ahead of what's changing in digital marketing and bring strategic recommendations to the team without being asked


**How you operate**


* You think about campaigns in terms of pipeline contribution and expansion revenue, not just clicks and impressions
* You're a strategist who ships — you design campaigns with commercial intent and then make sure they get executed at the standard you set
* You're comfortable with complexity — balancing multiple campaign strategies across multiple channels, regions, and commercial objectives at the same time
* You understand the bow\-tie — you see acquisition and expansion as two halves of the same commercial motion and design campaign strategies accordingly
* You embrace AI as part of how you work — using it to think faster and make better strategic decisions, not as a replacement for judgment


**What success looks like in year one**


* Campaign strategies in place across acquisition and expansion that are clearly driving measurable pipeline contribution and revenue
* ABM campaign strategies running against named accounts with defined engagement models and account\-level progression metrics — not just awareness impressions
* Nurture and expansion strategies optimized with measurable improvements in conversion rates across both sides of the bow\-tie — based on trade\-off decisions you made and can evidence
* Clean, strategic campaign reporting that gives leadership and regional teams confidence in where digital marketing is delivering and where investment should shift
* You are a key strategic contributor the Growth Marketing team relies on — trusted by the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, the wider growth team, and the sales function as someone who designs what we do and owns the outcomes


**About Duetto**



Duetto is the Revenue and Profit Operating System for the global hospitality industry — a PE\-backed SaaS business with customers across hotels, casinos, and hospitality groups worldwide. We're building a marketing function that matches our ambition: world\-class, commercially driven, and genuinely category\-defining.

title: AI Search Innovation Lead - Madrid based
description:
Hey there!
  

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.



Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  

  

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.



Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award\-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?



To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar\-raisers with a hands\-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  

  

Ready to be part of the experience?



Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

**Meet The Team**



At Fever's SEO team, we capture and influence demand when millions search for what to do next. We engineer visibility across the entire discovery ecosystem: traditional search engines, LLMs, local listings, third party integrations and beyond. Our diverse portfolio of ecosystems and operating companies gives us the scale and complexity to master every SEO specialization—from technical infrastructure and content architecture, to AI search optimization, local market dominance, and brand authority building. We operate globally, automating and optimizing processes to drive efficiency at scale.  

  

We combine data, technical excellence, and strategic thinking to drive organic growth revenue. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Operational teams, we shape how users discover experiences across our global platforms.  

  

Join us to redefine how the world finds experiences, together.


**The Role**



At Fever, we're building something exceptional—combining strategy, creativity, and the power of advanced technology to redefine what's possible in organic search. By partnering with world\-class Product, Engineering, Data and Marketing teams, we leverage cutting\-edge tools and data\-driven insights to deliver exceptional performance and measurable impact across major search engines and dynamic digital ecosystems.



As an AI Search Innovation Lead, you will drive the evolution of our brand's authority in the next era of search, focusing entirely on impact over traditional acronyms. You will lead the testing and measurement of how LLMs construct answers, designing the analytical frameworks to track our visibility across major AI models and emerging platforms like MCPs. Collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and PR teams, you will optimize our architecture for seamless AI ingestion and execute strategies to actively shape and accelerate LLM perception.

* Own the strategic evolution of core SEO practices by integrating methods to secure our brand's authoritative presence across all major LLMs and AI search results.
* Lead testing and measurement: Design and execute testing to decipher how established SEO signals influence LLM citations and generative presence.

title: Técnico en Protección de datos e IA
description:
¡Dale un cambio a tu vida y sigue desarrollando tu carrera profesional en Mapfre! Formarás parte de un entorno internacional donde podrás innovar participando en proyectos globales y enfocados en las últimas tendencias tecnológicas. Todo esto en un entorno flexible y ágil rodeado de excelentes profesionales de todo el mundo… ¿estás list@?



Desde el área de **Privacidad, Protección de Datos e IA** de la Dirección Corporativa de Seguridad, estamos buscando a una persona que nos ayude a definir las medidas y controles necesarios para garantizar la protección de los datos y el uso responsable de nuevas tecnologías como la IA, así como definir las buenas prácticas y políticas necesarias para cumplir con la regulación vigente en materia de Seguridad y Privacidad.

**¿Dónde estamos?**
-------------------



Las Tablas, Madrid.

**¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?**
--------------------------------


* Identificar y analizar los **riesgos de Seguridad y Privacidad** derivados de la legislación y normativa en materia de **Inteligencia Artificial**.
* Colaborar en la definición e implantación de la **estrategia de Seguridad y Privacidad**, así como en garantizar el **uso responsable de la Inteligencia Artificial** y la protección de los datos.
* Ajustar y actualizar dinámicamente la **gobernanza y el uso responsable de la IA**, así como los **controles y guardarraíles**, incluida su integración en herramientas, sistemas y plataformas.
* Evaluar y mitigar los **riesgos de la IA**, como sesgo, discriminación o explicabilidad, en algoritmos y modelos de IA, incluidas soluciones basadas en **LLM/GenAI y agentes autónomos**, a lo largo de todo su ciclo de vida.
* Promover la incorporación de **requisitos y controles de protección de datos y uso responsable de la IA** en los proyectos dentro de su ámbito de responsabilidad.
* Evaluar **nuevas herramientas y capacidades** para su incorporación segura en la organización, determinando la postura de Seguridad y Privacidad ante los riesgos de IA y proponiendo medidas para su mitigación y priorización.
* Participar en proyectos que requieran la **aplicación de la IA a problemas de ciberseguridad**.
* Proponer, elaborar y revisar **normas y procedimientos** alineados con el Plan Director de Seguridad de Mapfre y con la legislación y normativa aplicable en materia de **Protección de Datos e Inteligencia Artificial**.
* Participar en la implantación y evolución del **marco corporativo de IA Responsable**, alineado con el Reglamento Europeo de IA, GDPR y demás normativa aplicable.
* Realizar **evaluaciones de impacto y análisis de riesgo**s relacionados con soluciones de **IA, IA Generativa, plataformas agénticas y agentes autónomos**.
* Mantener **inventarios de casos de uso de IA** y colaborar en los procesos de **clasificación y supervisión de riesgos**.
* Realizar un **seguimiento continuo de tecnologías emergentes** relacionadas con IA Generativa, IA Agéntica, seguridad de IA, gobierno y protección de datos.
* Colaborar con las áreas de **Data e IA, Tecnología, Operaciones e Innovación** para asegurar que los requisitos y controles de Seguridad y Privacidad se diseñan, implantan y actúan con efectividad, impulsando la IA responsable de forma coherente en toda la organización.
* Trabajar en un **entorno global y multidisciplinar**, en contacto con las distintas geografías y áreas globales, para garantizar el **cumplimiento de la legislación y el marco regulatorio vigente**, conforme a los criterios y principios establecidos por la Dirección Corporativa de Seguridad.
* Proponer, implantar, mejorar y coordinar la **medición de indicadores de Protección de Datos e Inteligencia Artificial** con las distintas entidades y países de Mapfre.
**¿Qué necesitamos que sepas?**
-------------------------------


* Más de 4 años de experiencia en **Seguridad y Privacidad, frameworks, políticas, estándares, regulaciones y prácticas/disciplinas de riesgo tecnológico**.
* Más de 1 año de experiencia en **securización de arquitecturas con tecnologías de IA/ML y análisis de datos, gobernanza de datos e IA y gobernanza de tecnologías digitales emergentes**.
* Experiencia de al menos 1 año en **despliegues de proyectos IA en entornos cloud** (Azure, Amazon, Google).
* Conocimientos de **arquitecturas RAG, vector databases y sistemas agénticos**.
* Conocimientos sobre **configuración segura de plataformas unificadas de IA de AWS** (Bedrock) **Microsoft** (Azure OpenAI) y **Google** (Vertex AI).
* Se valorarán conocimientos, experiencia y certificaciones específicas en materia de **seguridad de la información y ciberseguridad** (CISM, CISSP, CCSP, CGEIT, CDPSE, CISA, CDPP.....)

**Why choose AstraZeneca Spain?**

AstraZeneca Spain is a rising force in our global business. Boasting vibrant universities and business schools, the Barcelona ecosystem is a place where scientists can thrive. Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. With our international team composition and the need for fast\-paced collaboration, you’ll always be building new connections with colleagues.


### **Cutting\-edge innovators**


When you join us, you’ll be part of a team that embraces digital technology and data to transform the way we work and the work we do. Every day, you’ll help make history, empowered to ignite your creativity and build something enduring.


### **Resilient trailblazers**


Here, the answers aren’t always available. So, you’ll need to bring a fearless, self\-starter mindset to navigate uncharted territories. You’ll harness your ceaseless energy to discover and make the necessary connections with colleagues to shape the future and achieve maximum impact.


### **Agile movers**


Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-260452 **Date posted** 09/22/2026
As a Global Development Medical Director, you will support the clinical project team and assist the Global Clinical Project Leader and Global Clinical Head with the design \& interpretation process, establishing clear design objectives for clinical programs and studies. You will provide medical input into the content of core labelling texts and medical support for commercial activities, support for medical monitoring of clinical studies. And, you will also provide medical and scientific expertise as well as tactical and strategic medical input to the development of AstraZeneca’s compounds; primarily from Phase IIb to Phase IV. This includes the design, delivery and interpretation of pivotal clinical trials and of studies that further characterize the overall benefit and risk and value of Respiratory and Immunology products in late\-stage development.


In the BioPharmaceuticals Research \& Development, Late\-stage Development, Respiratory \& Immunology function you will work in a truly international working environment, with opportunities to meet and discuss with key external experts, other medical colleagues and experts in basic science, as well as commercial and regulatory functions.


Our therapy area aligned groups of physicians and scientists provide clinical guidance and scientific leadership for clinical development programs within AstraZeneca's global organization.


The Global Development Medical Director will work in a wide range of aspects in pharmaceutical medicine, and due to the global responsibilities, there will be a multitude of contacts with health authorities, colleagues and marketing companies within AstraZeneca. This is an opportunity to take on the challenges of clinical development in a group of positive, focused and highly motivated colleagues.


**What you will do:**


* Be involved in providing medical and scientific leadership in the global development of new medicines targeted at indications in the field of respiratory diseases and wider range of immunological disorders
* Have an important role providing medical and scientific leadership in the innovative design, execution and interpretation of clinical trials in one or more development programs.
* Build strong relationships with a network of external scientific experts.
* Work closely with colleagues in other functions including Patient Safety, Regulatory Affairs, and Clinical Operations.
* Be involved primarily in late stage (Ph2b and later) clinical programs while also collaborating with clinical colleagues supporting Early (R\&I) stage programs and medical affairs.
* Lead and contribute to medical monitoring of trials
* Provide expert medical input into the preparation of regulatory documents and interactions with regulatory authorities.
* Provide expert medical and scientific analysis and interpretation of data from ongoing studies and in the literature.
* Develop and review protocols, informed consent, investigator’s brochure and other clinical development documents.
* Participate in the preparation of scientific publications and presentations at scientific meetings and congresses.

**For this role, you will need:**


* MD or MD/PhD Degree
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical industry experience, 3\+ years of clinical research experience in the academic or clinical practice setting
* Demonstrated partnership and collaboration skills, including acting as the leader and clearly communicating across countries and cultures
* Fluent in oral and written English, with good presentation skills and effective communication
* Ideal candidate has a background in: Pulmonary medicine, Immunology, Rheumatology, Allergy, or Dermatology .

In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility.
