title: Senior Retention Specialist, Copy & Content
description:
**About Darkroom**
==================

**Darkroom** is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**Location:** Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only \- supporting a team in the EST time zone.

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand\-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high\-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.


You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first\-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.


This is a copy\-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

**You should apply if this sounds like you**
============================================


You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

* 3–5\+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.
* You write excellent short\-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.
* You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected\-device brand is a strong plus.
* You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt\-in copy, welcome series, first\-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.
* You have written loyalty, rewards, and win\-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long\-term value is a core outcome of this role.
* You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.
* You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.
* You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.
* You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high\-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.
* You are detail\-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.
* Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

**A day in the life**
=====================

* Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.
* Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.
* Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.
* Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.
* Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.
* Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.
* Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.
* Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
======================================


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

 **Equal Opportunity Statement**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Podcast Producer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for an organized, creative and hands\-on **Podcast** **Producer** to lead the end\-to\-end production and delivery of Alea’s two podcasts.


The Podcast Producer will be responsible for the complete operational process, from initial planning and pre\-production through recording, post\-production, approval and final publication. The role will ensure that every episode is produced on time, meets Alea’s quality standards and supports the company’s communications and brand objectives.


Working closely with the **Head of PR \& Communications**, the **Podcast** **Producer** will help define the strategy, positioning, editorial direction and distribution approach for both podcasts. This person will then translate that strategy into a structured production plan and manage its day\-to\-day execution.


This role is ideal for someone who combines editorial judgement, project management and technical production skills and who is comfortable coordinating guests, managing recordings, reviewing edits and overseeing publication across multiple platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\.** **Podcast** **Strategy and Editorial Planning**

* Define the strategy, positioning, objectives and target audience for both podcasts in collaboration with the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Contribute ideas for themes, episode topics, formats, guests and editorial series.
* Develop and manage an editorial calendar and release schedule for both podcasts.
* Ensure podcast topics and guests are aligned with Alea’s brand positioning, communications priorities and business objectives.
* Research relevant industry topics, trends and conversations to identify new editorial opportunities.
* Prepare episode concepts and proposals for review and approval by the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Regularly review the performance and direction of both podcasts and recommend strategic improvements.

### **2\. Pre\-production**

* Manage the complete pre\-production process for every episode.
* Research topics, guests and relevant background information.
* Identify and coordinate potential guests in collaboration with the Head of PR \& Communications and other stakeholders.
* Manage guest invitations, confirmations, calendars and all pre\-recording communications.
* Prepare episode briefs, scripts, interview structures, talking points and run\-of\-show documents.
* Organize recording schedules, locations and required resources.
* Coordinate studios, external production partners or technical suppliers when needed.
* Confirm that recording equipment, software, lighting, sound and other technical requirements are ready before each session.
* Brief hosts, guests and relevant stakeholders before recording.
* Ensure all necessary permissions, consent forms and content approvals are obtained.

### **3\. Recording and Live Production**

* Lead and coordinate each recording session, ensuring the process runs smoothly from start to finish.
* Set up or supervise cameras, microphones, lighting and recording software.
* Perform technical checks before every recording.
* Direct hosts and guests during the session when required.
* Monitor audio and video quality throughout the recording.
* Follow the agreed episode structure while allowing space for natural and engaging conversations.
* Identify strong moments, quotes and potential promotional clips during the recording.
* Resolve operational or technical issues quickly and efficiently.
* Ensure all recorded material is correctly saved, backed up and organized after each session.

### **4\. Post\-production and Quality Control**

* Manage the full post\-production process for every episode.
* Edit or coordinate the editing of audio and video content.
* Review all edits and provide clear feedback to internal or external editors.
* Ensure the final episode has strong pacing, narrative flow and consistent audio and video quality.
* Coordinate the addition of intros, outros, music, graphics, subtitles and other branded elements.
* Identify and prepare the strongest moments for trailers, teasers and promotional clips.
* Ensure every episode follows Alea’s brand guidelines and editorial standards.
* Manage the internal review and approval process with the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Complete a final quality check before publication, including audio, video, titles, descriptions, links, subtitles and visual assets.
* Maintain an organized archive of raw recordings, project files, final episodes and supporting materials.

### **5\. Publication and Distribution**

* Manage the publication of each episode across the relevant podcast and video platforms.
* Upload and publish episodes on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, Audible, YouTube and any other selected distribution channels.
* Prepare accurate and engaging episode titles, descriptions, show notes, timestamps and supporting copy.
* Coordinate thumbnails, cover images and other visual assets with the Design team.
* Ensure episodes are correctly categorized, tagged and optimized for discoverability.
* Coordinate publication dates and promotional activity with the Head of PR \& Communications and Social Media \& Content Manager.
* Verify that every episode is published correctly and is accessible across all relevant platforms.
* Update or correct published content when necessary.
* Ensure podcast information and episodes are properly featured on alea.com when relevant.

### **6\. Promotional Content Coordination**

* Identify the strongest quotes, insights and moments from each episode for promotional use.
* Create or coordinate trailers, teasers, audiograms and short\-form video clips.
* Provide the Social Media \& Content Manager with the materials, context and key messages needed to promote each episode.
* Collaborate on the preparation of an episode\-specific promotional plan.
* Ensure all promotional assets are delivered before the agreed publication date.
* Coordinate with the Design team on thumbnails, templates, graphics and other branded materials.
* Support the repurposing of podcast episodes into articles, social media posts and other communication formats.

### **7\. Production and Stakeholder Management**

* Own and maintain the production workflow for both podcasts.
* Coordinate hosts, guests, internal teams, studios and external suppliers.
* Create clear timelines and ensure all milestones and publication deadlines are met.
* Keep the Head of PR \& Communications informed about progress, risks, delays and required decisions.
* Manage feedback and approvals efficiently to avoid production bottlenecks.
* Maintain production documentation, episode trackers, guest information and content archives.
* Monitor external production costs and resources when applicable.
* Identify opportunities to make the production process more efficient, scalable and consistent.

### **8\. Performance Analysis and Optimization**

* Track podcast performance across the relevant distribution and video platforms.
* Monitor metrics such as downloads, plays, views, watch time, audience retention, completion rate and subscriber growth.
* Analyse performance by podcast, episode, topic, guest and content format.
* Prepare regular performance reports with key findings and actionable recommendations.
* Report results and insights to the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Use audience and performance data to improve topics, formats, episode duration, production and distribution.
* Monitor podcast trends, competitors and industry benchmarks to identify opportunities for growth.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At least **2–3 years of experience** in podcast, audio, video, broadcast or digital content production.
* Demonstrable experience managing the complete podcast production process, from pre\-production to publication.
* Experience recording and editing professional audio and video content.
* Hands\-on knowledge of microphones, cameras, lighting, recording software and editing tools.
* Experience with podcast hosting and distribution platforms, as well as YouTube Studio.
* Strong editorial judgement and storytelling skills.
* Ability to prepare briefs, scripts, interview structures and production documents.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to manage multiple episodes, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Confident working with senior leadership, hosts, guests and external suppliers.
* Proactive, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership of the full production process.
* Full professional proficiency in English.
* Spanish proficiency is considered an advantage.
* Previous experience in B2B, technology, media or iGaming is desirable.

**What We Offer**
=================

* A competitive salary package based on your experience.
* An impressive benefits package, focused on our culture of integral health that includes medical insurance, gym with personal trainer, sauna and hyperbaric chamber, and fresh fruit every day.
* Tax\-advantageous wage benefit: Meal card, transport package and other measures such as childcare allowance.
* Discount on Veg it (vegan meals) to order your lunch at the office.
* Flexible start and finish times.
* Reduced working hours in August.
* 23 holidays plus 3 extra days at disposal
* Hybrid Work Model.
* English classes
* Parking benefit for those who live outside of Barcelona.
* And what we are very proud of, you will join a young, motivated and powerful team with a great team culture. As it’s not all work, we maintain the team spirit with team building events, parties and workshops where you can enjoy our achievements. When you leave in the afternoon, you can join our paddle tennis games near the office.

Accenture, recognized as a Great Place To Work®, is a leading global professional services company that helps major businesses, public administrations, and other organizations around the world develop their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and improve services for citizens, creating tangible value at speed and scale.

 **About the Program**


Role is for a multi\-year banking modernization program delivering a complex systems integration solution for a European Banking Customer. The platform landscape spans ServiceNow, Blue Prism (RPA), Sisense (reporting), Optimus (bot orchestration), and a bespoke Task/Facade API layer. Active workstreams include Know your Customer “KYC”, Estates, Core Efficiency Package “CEP”, Foundations, BOTs Activation, and cross\-platform integration. Delivery combines onshore client\-facing governance with an offshore factory model executing from India.

 **Role Purpose**


The E2E Technical Architect owns the full technical solution from integration layer to platform delivery — ensuring architectural coherence across all workstreams, platforms, and geographies. This is not a single\-platform role. The architect is the technical authority that connects the dots: API design, platform constraints, integration patterns, data flows, and non\-functional requirements all sit within scope. The role operates at the intersection of client architecture teams, offshore factory leads, and external SMEs, and is accountable for technical decision quality at every stage gate.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture across all platforms — ServiceNow, Blue Prism, Sisense, Task/Facade API, and Optimus — ensuring consistency of design decisions across workstreams
* Define and maintain the integration architecture: data flows, API contracts, middleware patterns, and event/trigger models between core banking systems and our platforms
* Produce and govern architecture artefacts — solution design documents, integration playbooks, and architectural decision records (ADRs)
* Lead technical design sessions with offshore factory leads (ServiceNow, RPA, API) and external SMEs; translate business requirements from functional specs into implementable technical designs
* Review and sign off on technical designs produced by workstream leads before build commences; enforce architecture standards and reject non\-conforming designs at gate

10\. **Release and post\-launch** Coordinate deployments and production releases. Track performance indicators after launch.

* Lead churn\-prevention and win\-back initiatives across email and push notifications as coordinated, signal\-driven programs rather than one\-off campaigns

title: Lead Product Designer, The Bump
description:
**ABOUT US**



In more than ten countries around the world, The Knot Worldwide champions the power of celebration. Our global family of brands provide best\-in\-class products, services and content to take celebration planning from inspiration to action. At the core of our business is our industry\-leading global online wedding Vendor Marketplace, connecting couples with local wedding professionals and a comprehensive suite of personalized wedding websites, planning tools, invitations, and registry services that make wedding planning easier for couples around the globe. Each year, we connect more than 4\.5 million users with around 900,000 global small businesses through our Vendor Marketplace.


**LIFE AT TKWW**



At The Knot Worldwide, we believe in doing work that matters. Each year, we help millions of couples around the world celebrate life's most meaningful moments, while also helping hundreds of thousands of global small business owners get discovered and scale. Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. We prioritize employee well\-being and development through meaningful opportunities for growth, and we celebrate milestones and wins in a big way. After all, celebrations are what we do best.


**ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:**



We are looking for an experienced Lead Product Designer to join our Design team in Barcelona to lead day\-to\-day product design for The Bump, while supporting strategic media initiatives across The Knot Worldwide (TKWW) brand portfolio.



This role is structured so you spend most of your time on The Bump, shaping core consumer product features, content tools, and user journeys across web, iOS, and Android. The remaining time will focus on Global Media Sales (GMS), creating sponsored features and scalable monetization solutions that serve all TKWW brands.



You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Editorial, and GMS stakeholders to understand customer needs, define opportunities, and shape product strategy. Sitting at the intersection of trusted content, digital product tools, and media monetization, this role requires a designer who can balance user value with business outcomes and move fluidly between strategy, systems thinking, and execution.



The Knot Worldwide Design team is a close group of Product Designers, Product Writers, and Researchers who value strong craft, open critique, thoughtful collaboration, and shared ownership of the overall customer experience.

  


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Lead end\-to\-end product design for The Bump across web, iOS, and Android, owning day\-to\-day feature execution while setting the UX/visual quality bar and shaping core product strategy.
* Partner with the Global Media Sales (GMS) team to design sponsored content integrations and monetization touchpoints across the full family of TKWW brands.
* Partner directly alongside our Engineering and Product Management teams to shape direction, align execution priorities, and accelerate delivery timelines.
* Connect content, product functionality, and pathways that help users discover relevant tools on The Bump, while ensuring ad\-tech integrations across TKWW brands maintain customer trust and high usability standards.
* Drive design from problem framing through rapid prototyping, iteration, UX/UI design, and delivery\-ready specs, helping teams validate solutions quickly and move into development with clarity.
* Create scalable, high\-quality design solutions and reusable component patterns, contributing to the broader evolution of TKWW's design systems across all brand properties.

* Leverage AI and modern tools to prototype, compress exploration loops, and elevate the speed and output quality of product development.

  


**SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATES HAVE:**


* 6\+ years of product design experience, with a proven track record of leading complex, high\-impact consumer product areas across strategy, UX, visual design, and execution.
* Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with a portfolio showing polished execution, clear UX architecture, and scalable system patterns.
* Versatility to switch fluidly between core app/web product design (The Bump) and cross\-brand ad\-tech/monetization solutions (GMS across TKWW).
* Advanced systems thinking, with the ability to connect experiences across multi\-brand platforms, dynamic journeys, and commercial touchpoints.
* Strong product judgment, with experience using research, usability testing, and behavioral analytics to inform design choices.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering closely with dev teams and Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Design leadership.
* A bias toward rapid prototyping and leveraging AI to make abstract ideas tangible, explore solutions quickly, and unblock engineering partners.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity, bringing structure to undefined problem spaces, and driving domain\-level alignment independently.
* Experience with consumer mobile apps, content\-rich platforms, ad\-tech, commerce, or multi\-brand ecosystems is a strong plus.

  


**WORK MODEL:**



This role is Together@TKWW\-eligible and based near one of our office hubs. You'll be expected to work in the office **two days a week** as part of our hybrid work model.



\#LI\-Hybrid

title: Domain Architect: Network & Platform
description:
**Description:**
----------------


**Company Description :**

**About Marlink**


Wherever our customers are in the world, we help them digitalise and optimise their remote business processes using advanced hybrid network solutions and digital technologies.


Our teams work together across the globe, using constant innovation, expertise and applied technology to bring systems and people together with a future focus. We push boundaries. We combine unrivalled resources and expertise in field engineering with advanced digital technologies such as cyber security, IT, and cloud enablement.


Today, we employ 1500 people in over 30 countries, with customers in the maritime, energy, and humanitarian sectors. We believe in creating a culture where you can develop and thrive. Our commitment to excellence drives our success.

 **About OmniAccess**


OmniAccess is a leading managed service provider of premium connectivity, networking and cyber solutions. From our headquarter in Palma de Mallorca we cater services for superyachts, boutique cruise and research vessels, with a very strong commitment to service quality \& availability. As part of our integral end\-to end solutions, we design, implement and support onboard IT networks, bandwidth management tools and cyber security services, all aimed at providing our clients with premium digital solutions and the best possible user experience.


In 2018, OmniAccess joined forces with the Marlink Group. Marlink is a managed service provider and global leader in remote ICT solutions with annual revenues surpassing $800 million and 1,500 employees operating in more than 30 countries.


Wherever our customers are in the world, we deliver them possibilities to work smarter and to operate more effectively, more safely, more sustainably \- without the limitations of technology.


With our possibility platform, we enable a comprehensive suite of end\-to\-end managed solutions (Connectivity, Network, Cyber Security, Cloud \& IT, IoT \& Apps), supported by professional services, unmatched global operations and delivery capabilities and local support teams.


As a global company with a local focus, we help make tomorrow’s possibilities today’s realities.


This strategic partnership has enabled us to expand our reach and capabilities, offering our clients an even broader range of innovative digital solutions and unparalleled support.


At OmniAccess, our vision is bold and clear: to deliver possibilities anywhere, empower innovation everywhere, and shape the future of maritime digital solutions.

 **Role Purpose:**


Marlink Group is seeking a dynamic Product Architect: Network \& Platform to shape and deliver the Network and Platform domains of the Possibility Portfolio. The scope spans Marlink's Edge infrastructure (CPE) and orchestration framework, and the network services that run on it — SD\-WAN, LAN/Wi\-Fi, bandwidth optimisation, QoS/QoE, and Network Access — across maritime and enterprise environments.


This is a hybrid role between product management and engineering. It is the bridge between business expectations and technical feasibility, and it works in both directions: shaping the products in the category into clear, sellable propositions, and driving their technical execution — requirements, coordination of teams, and proofs of concept.


The role is customer\-centric at its core. It starts from what customers need and how they buy and use our services, keeps that perspective present in every architecture and roadmap decision, and stays close to BUs and customers to make sure what we build is what the market values.

 **Key Responsibilities:**


1\. Commercial Productization

* Shape the products in the Network \& Platform category into clearly defined, sellable propositions — scope, tiers, packaging, and differentiation.
* Work with Pricing, Commercial and BU teams to turn cost and capability drivers into viable pricing and margin structures.
* Provide the technical substance behind go\-to\-market materials — value propositions, capability descriptions, and positioning.
* Support BU pre\-sales and solution reviews, and feed recurring customer requirements back into the roadmap.

  

2\. Requirements \& Feasibility

* Turn product requirements into precise technical specifications — the quality gate between product intent and engineering execution.
* Validate feasibility of roadmap commitments with Group Engineering before sign\-off.
* Translate engineering constraints and trade\-offs into product implications for the Head of Product and governance forums.

  

3\. Reference Architecture

* Own and maintain the Network \& Platform reference architecture — CPE, orchestration and service onboarding; SD\-WAN, LAN/Wi\-Fi, WAN optimisation, QoS/QoE and Network Access — co\-defined with Group Engineering.
* Define the integration requirements that let Connectivity, Cloud \& IT, Cyber and IoT services deploy consistently through the platform.
* Maintain architecture documentation, design standards and capability catalogues as shared Group standards.

  

4\. Technical Execution \& Team Coordination

* Drive product initiatives from requirement to release, coordinating across Group Engineering, IT, Cybersecurity and BU technical teams.
* Sequence dependencies between network and platform workstreams; surface conflicts and trade\-offs early.
* Act as the technical reference point during implementation, resolving ambiguity and arbitrating design decisions against product intent.
* Track delivery against roadmap commitments and report status and risks into governance.

  

5\. Governance \& BU Engagement

* Set architecture standards and ensure BU implementations conform to Possibility Portfolio guardrails.
* Engage BU product and technical teams regularly to capture local and customer requirements and feed them into the global roadmap.

  

6\. Innovation \& Proof of Concept

* Track emerging technologies — edge computing, virtualisation, AI\-driven operations and SD\-WAN, SASE, intent\-based networking — and market and customer trends relevant to the portfolio.
* Run proof\-of\-concept initiatives with Engineering to validate new capabilities, technically and commercially, before roadmap commitment.
* Define what each PoC must prove and convert the outcome into a clear recommendation: proceed, adapt, or stop.

 **Success Outcomes:**

* Products in the category are clearly defined, commercially coherent and ready to sell.
* Roadmap commitments are consistently feasibility\-validated before sign\-off.
* Engineering receives unambiguous, well\-structured requirements.
* Initiatives move from requirement to release with dependencies managed and without avoidable rework.
* The reference architecture is the recognised standard across Group Engineering and BU teams, with reduced variance across Business Units.
* New capabilities are validated through structured PoCs before commitment.

  


**Requirements:**
-----------------


**Skills \& Experience:**

**The Hybrid Profile**

* Track record at the boundary of product and engineering — a PM with deep architecture exposure, a Solutions Architect who moved into product, or a Network/Technical Lead with commercial instincts.
* Able to write a product requirement, review a design, and defend a commercial construct with equal rigour.
* Customer\-oriented: understands customer needs and translates them into product and architecture decisions.
* Comfortable engaging commercial, portfolio and engineering stakeholders in the same working day, and coordinating teams without direct authority.

 **Technical Depth**

* Solid understanding of SD\-WAN, LAN/Wi\-Fi, QoS/QoE, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) and multi\-access WAN architectures.
* Solid understanding of edge computing, CPE, virtualisation, container orchestration and service lifecycle automation.
* Knowledge of SASE, SSE and ZTNA as applied to managed network services and security at the edge.
* Familiarity with satellite communications (VSAT, LEO) and their network integration considerations.
* Working knowledge of TM Forum frameworks (eTOM, SID, Open APIs).
* Working knowledge of how AI/ML integrates into edge and network products — deployment patterns, inference at the edge vs. cloud, cost/latency trade\-offs, and observability.

 **Commercial Capability**

* Experience productizing technical capability into sellable managed services — scope, tiering, packaging, positioning.
* Understands the cost and margin drivers of managed services and works constructively with Pricing and Commercial functions.
* Articulates technical differentiation in terms customers and commercial audiences act on.

 **Industry \& Context**

* Background in MSP, telecommunications, network services, managed connectivity, cloud or digital infrastructure.
* Exposure to maritime, mobility, energy or remote enterprise operations is strongly preferred.
* Experience in matrix organisations, influencing BU and cross\-functional teams without direct authority.

 **Why join us:**

  

* Full\-time, permanent position with competitive salary
* Annual performance bonus based on individual and company achievements.
* Hybrid model: possibility of two days per week of teleworking.
* Flexible working hours
* Access to private health insurance from day one.
* Exclusive discounts at car rental companies, insurance companies, banks, travel agencies, and phone company.
* Be part of a 2025 Certified Great Place to Work®
* Benefits and perks at the office:
* + Breakfast, high\-quality daily lunch at a very low cost, fruit and snacks all day long.
	+ Every Thursday you will have a free lunch with your colleagues.
	+ Gym and game room at your disposal.
	+ 50% subsidized lunch tickets in some Parc Bit restaurants.
* Continuous training and growth opportunities as the company expands.
* Career Growth: An opportunity to work in a high\-growth area within a leading network solutions provider.
* Innovation\-Driven Environment: Be part of Marlink’s commitment to delivering next\-generation solutions in connectivity and digital transformation.
* Global Exposure: Work with diverse, talented teams across different regions and sectors.
* Professional Development: Access to training, conferences, and resources to enhance skills and knowledge.

 *OmniAccess is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are committed to ensuring that all individuals are treated with dignity and respect, and that everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other legally protected status, has fair and equal access to opportunities for growth, development, and success.*

*We expressly encourage applications from qualified persons with disabilities. As part of our commitment to full inclusion, OmniAccess will assess and provide reasonable accommodations or adjustments, where needed and appropriate, and in accordance with applicable law, to ensure equal participation in the recruitment process, including applications, interviews, assessments and onboarding, as well as, where applicable, the performance of the essential functions of the role.*

Any information shared will be voluntary, treated confidentially and used only to manage the requested accommodation or adjustment and/or to comply with applicable legal obligations.*

*We are also dedicated to upholding fairness and objectivity throughout our recruitment process. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, relevant experience, skills, merit and alignment with the requirements of the role, ensuring a transparent and merit\-based selection process for every candidate.*

description:
**Join Ferrovial: Where Innovation Meets Opportunity**
======================================================

Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in infrastructure solving complex problems and generating a positive outcome on people’s lives? At **Ferrovial** , we are not just a company; we are a community of innovators and trailblazers. Ferrovial is also leading the development of the New Terminal One at JFK International Airport. Ferrovial shares trade under the ticker symbol FER on two stock markets: Nasdaq in the U.S. (Nasdaq100 Index) and the Spanish Stock Exchanges (IBEX 35\). Ferrovial is included in globally recognized sustainability indices such as the Dow Jones Best\-in\-Class Index. We operate in more than 15 countries and have a workforce of over 22,000 professionals worldwide. Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy.  



  

**Cintra** is the highways business unit of Ferrovial, one of the world’s leading infrastructure operators committed to developing sustainable solutions. Today, its portfolio includes nearly 1,200 miles of managed highways globally, representing a total global investment in roadway improvements of over $24\.8 billion.
  

  

We provide the maximum value in each project, managing all phases of the life cycle of our state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure assets, such as the 407 ETR in Canada, the Managed Lanes LBJ and NTE in Texas, I\-77 in North Carolina, I\-66 in Virginia and our projects in Europe, South America, and India.  



  

**Why Ferrovial?**

* **Global presence, local impact** : Be part of a company that is shaping the future of infrastructure worldwide, with challenging roles and projects that make a real difference.
* **Collaborative excellence** : Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.
* **Inclusive Culture:** Thrive in an innovative and respectful workplace that values every voice, celebrates what makes us unique and turns differences into innovation.
* **Career growth** : Benefit from global and cross\-business unit mobility, with development processes designed to ensure your professional growth.
* **Compelling benefits and employee wellbeing** : Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that rewards your hard work and dedication and take advantage of initiatives designed to support your physical and psychological health.
* **Productivity tools** : Utilize cutting\-edge tools like Microsoft Copilot to enhance your productivity and efficiency.

  

**Job Description:**
====================

**About the role:**

An **Investment Analyst I** provides Cintra with financial analysis, which results key in the company’s decision\-making process. Its main working tool will be financial models that reflect how projects may potentially perform throughout the life of each project, revealing which investment opportunities are best for Cintra to pursue. An **Investment Analyst I** will be involved in both Cintra’s business development activities and portfolio management in Europe \& New Markets. To provide proper analysis, an Investment Analyst I will build the models, optimize them according to each project’s needs/requirements, structure the analysis and communicate its main conclusions and investment recommendations.  



  

**Key responsibilities:**

* Build, develop and work with financial models in Excel; financial models will be built and operated according to the operating, commercial and financial characteristics of each project.
* When analyzing new investment opportunities, it will result key to determine the optimal financial structure, analyzing the requirements of projects, developing financial objectives based on preliminary commercial structures, and analyzing sources of finance to develop an optimum financing mix.
* Prepare and interpret complex financial information and provide financial analysis in a variety of contexts, including project bids, concession transactions and M\&A activities.
* Participate, facilitate and interpret results for senior management financial according to Cintra´s investment goals in terms of feasibility, profitability, and detailed financing plans.
* Preparing in\-depth analysis and written documentation and presentations to senior management as part of Cintra’s investments approval process. This internal approval process, especially relevant in bid and M\&A projects, is run according to Cintra’s internal regulations and protocols.
* Preparing Project Information Memorandum to present the project to lenders, rating agencies, equity investors or any other third parties.
* Working closely with management of projects on portfolio on specific requests and assisting them on the preparation of materials to be discussed on their board of directors.
* Working closely with external advisors such us financial advisors, tax and accounting advisors, legal advisors and financial model auditors.
* Conduct sensitivity analyses, as well as develop various cases to test the robustness of financial structures under multiple scenarios and report the results to Cintra’s senior management, investment partners, and other relevant parties.
* Review and comment on procurement and financial documents, such as requests for proposal (RFPs) and project agreements, draft finance documents, etc. with high attention to detail in order to understand the unique requirements of each project.
* Participate in conducting major bid and project reviews, including pro forma preparation
* Manage several projects at a time, which are all at different stages of development.
* Working closely with senior members of its own team and other teams; as a flat structured team you will gain an enormous learning curve when stepping into this environment.

title: Senior CRM Lifecycle + Journeys Manager
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**



Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.



What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.


**OUR CULTURE**



Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.


* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**



The **Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle \+ Journeys** owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in\-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win\-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.



This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.



Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity\-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged\-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.



You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.


**Responsibilities**


* Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026\), DE (October 2026\), and FR (November 2026\): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post\-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win\-back, replenishment, care instructions.
* Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end\-to\-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept\-to\-deployment time within 90 days.
* Partner with the Data team to run the triggered\-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.
* Build channel\-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market.
* Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged\-in routing for non\-consenting users.
* Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN\-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.
* Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity\-resolution accuracy.


**Qualifications**


**Required:**

* 6\+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).
* Hands\-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.
* Hands\-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.
* Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.
* SQL proficient. Can self\-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.
* A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).
* Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.
* Detail\-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt\-in state, suppression rules).
* Strong cross\-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.


**Preferred:**


* Multi\-market lifecycle experience (UK \+ DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app\-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.

**WHY QUINCE?**



Joining Quince means being part of a mission\-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY \& HIRING INTEGRITY**



Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.



Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case\-by\-case basis.



Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.


*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*



At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit\-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Hardware Industrialization Specialist
description:
### **Position**

Being part of LOEWE means learning every day alongside passionate teams in a fast\-paced, ambitious and creative environment.


As **Hardware Industrialization Specialist** , you will drive the end\-to\-end industrialization of new hardware components from design validation through series production, ensuring optimal balance between aesthetic excellence, strict timelines, cost efficiency, and technical reliability.  



### **Job responsibilities**

* Drive time\-to\-production targets and manage launch schedules
* Review and validate aesthetics with Design in alignment with industrialization constraints
* Manage testing processes (request, follow\-up, and validation) alongside suppliers and quality teams
* Conduct price negotiations, capacity analysis, and tooling/mould investments for production
* Optimize manufacturing methods for each launch to drive cost improvements
* Oversee pre\-series control, final approvals, master management, and PLM documentation
* Ensure system price updates and manage production risk analysis
* Provide technical expertise for root cause analysis and quality issue resolution
* Define, improve, and deploy technical standards across projects
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and countertyping analysis
* Build and maintain relationships with industry experts, staying abreast of new technologies, laboratories, and manufacturing advancements
### **Profile**

* 3 to 4 years of experience in a similar role managing development and/or purchasing for leather goods accessories, jewelry, or trimmings
* Degree in Industrial Engineering or Materials Engineering
* Strong negotiation and communication skills
* Proficiency in 3D modeling, rendering, and animation is a plus
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel), familiarity with AI tools, and fluency in various ERP systems
* Knowledge of PLM (Centric) software is a plus
* English proficiency (C1 or C2\) is mandatory; French, Chinese, or Italian is a plus
* Flexibility to travel to Europe and Asia
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Senior Coordinator, PASS Housing
description:

This is achieved through our dedicated global team who provide comprehensive guidance, instruction, support and resources to maximize the benefit of our students’ time abroad.

With a footprint that spans 53 cities in 20 countries across Europe, Latin America and Australia our 450 strong global workforce deliver exceptional cultural experiences abroad to over 7,000 students per annum.

  

Position Summary  

The Senior Coordinator, Housing and Student Services plays a key operational role in the delivery of student housing and student services in Madrid. The role combines hands\-on student support with responsibility for coordinating the day\-to\-day work of the Housing team, organizing workflows and priorities, overseeing housing operations, and supporting the PASS Director with budget management and semester planning. The Senior Coordinator serves as a senior point of reference for housing\-related matters, helps ensure consistent service standards, and coordinates effectively with students, colleagues, landlords, residences, vendors, and other external partners.
The role supports students throughout their programs, from logistics to cultural integration, ensuring a seamless and enriching experience. It also involves administrative tasks such as managing program materials and handling student accommodation issues.  

Responsibilities  

* Serve as a senior point of contact for students, providing guidance, information, resources, and support throughout their program.

* Support, guide, and coordinate team members, ensuring clear allocation of responsibilities, effective communication, and consistent service delivery.

* Participate in regular staff and planning meetings and provide operational updates, risks, budget information, and recommendations to the PASS Director.
* Support the onboarding, training, and day\-to\-day development of Housing team members and contribute to maintaining clear procedures and shared working standards.
* Be part of the emergency phone rotation and support the response to urgent student and housing situations in accordance with CEA CAPA procedures.
* Provide operational coverage and decision\-making support in the Housing area when required, particularly during peak periods, arrivals, departures, and staff absences.

  

Person Specification* Resilient and adaptable.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate people, competing priorities, schedules, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated leadership and team coordination skills, with the ability to guide colleagues and promote accountability and collaboration.
* Strong budget management, financial tracking, forecasting, and cost\-control skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong relationship\-management and negotiation skills with internal and external stakeholders.
* Able to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and contribute effectively to a wider team.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and a practical, flexible, and creative approach to operational challenges.
* High attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records and follow through on complex operational matters.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and other digital tools.
  

Qualifications and Experience* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Fluency in English and Spanish.
* Significant experience working with students, particularly international students.
* Demonstrated experience in student housing, accommodation operations, property coordination, or a closely related area.
* Experience coordinating or supervising team members, workflows, or operational projects.
* Experience managing budgets, monitoring expenditure, and preparing forecasts or financial projections.
* Experience working with external vendors, landlords, service providers, and other operational partners.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse identities and backgrounds.
* Experience living or working abroad, with strong knowledge of the local culture, housing environment, business practices, and academic context.
* Knowledge of the U.S. higher education system is desirable.
* Authorization to work in the location of the role.

*

* **15\+ years of experience** in industrial Packaging Engineering, either within a manufacturing organization or packaging solutions provider.

* Experience working in a **global manufacturing, automotive, energy or similar industrial environment** .
* Strong experience working cross\-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Logistics and suppliers.
* Ability to combine **strategic thinking with hands\-on execution** — we are looking for someone who can define the strategy but is also comfortable getting into the technical details when needed.
* Strong change\-management and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to challenge existing approaches and drive implementation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Fluent English.
* **Based in Madrid, Spain** , with willingness to travel globally to suppliers, manufacturing locations and project sites as required.

  

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

The successful candidate will help us build a stronger, more scalable Global Packaging Engineering organization, moving Packaging further upstream into product development while improving standardization, returnable solutions, quality, sustainability, and total landed cost across NextPower's global operations.  



  

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to shape how Packaging Engineering supports NextPower's continued growth, new products and business verticals.


At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility\-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data\-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.

title: Video Producer
description:
**About Frontiers**


At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.


We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open\-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer\-reviewed and quality\-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real\-world impact of science without barriers.


Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission\-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

**About the role**


We're looking for a **Video Producer** to join our Visual Design team and work closely with the Senior Video Producer to expand and accelerate Frontiers' video storytelling. In this role, you'll take ownership of video productions from planning and filming through to post\-production, creating interviews, talking\-head content, b\-roll, and studio shoots for company\-wide communications and campaigns.


As a second videographer, you'll have the opportunity to lead independent shoots while also supporting larger productions led by the Senior Video Producer. You'll combine strong technical video skills with excellent organization, ensuring that shoots run smoothly, footage meets Frontiers' creative and technical standards, and media assets are efficiently managed throughout the production process.


You'll work closely with colleagues across Communications and Visual Design, as well as researchers, authors, employees, external contributors, and production partners. If you enjoy working both behind the camera and behind the scenes, solving problems on the go, and creating high\-quality visual content in a fast\-paced environment, you'll thrive in this role.


You'll also contribute to improving video production workflows by using technology, AI\-powered tools, and consistent production practices to streamline scheduling, media management, transcription, subtitling, and post\-production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate video shoots end\-to\-end, including scheduling interviews, talking\-head sessions, b\-roll, and studio productions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute call sheets, coordinate shoot logistics, and ensure crews and on\-camera participants have clear information about locations, timings, requirements, and expectations.
* Scout and book filming locations, studios, and meeting spaces, coordinating travel arrangements and equipment transportation for shoots outside Lausanne.
* Prepare, test, organize, and maintain camera, lighting, audio, and studio equipment, ensuring all production kits are ready for each assignment.
* Independently film interviews, talking\-heads, b\-roll, and studio content, operating professional camera, lighting, and audio equipment to a consistently high standard.
* Work as a second camera operator and provide technical support on larger and multi\-camera productions led by the Senior Video Producer.
* Welcome and brief on\-camera participants, helping guests feel comfortable and confident throughout the filming process while ensuring required release forms and consent documentation are completed.
* Ingest, back up, organize, and archive raw footage following established folder structures, file\-naming conventions, and media management practices.
* Support post\-production by cutting and editing footage, applying colour grading and established brand guidelines, creating and using motion graphics, and preparing subtitles and AI\-assisted transcriptions.
* Work with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and other relevant production tools to support high\-quality video delivery.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external production partners, including freelance crew, studios, equipment suppliers, editors, and post\-production specialists.
* Identify and resolve technical, logistical, and production challenges independently while maintaining quality, schedules, and production standards.
* Contribute to improving video production workflows, playbooks, and best practices, helping the team increase production capacity and deliver content efficiently.

  

**Requirements**  

* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in video production, videography, or a similar role, with experience taking video projects from production planning and filming through to post\-production.
* Strong technical video production skills, including professional camera operation, lighting, and audio recording, with the ability to independently deliver high\-quality footage.
* A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating relevant camera, lighting, sound, editing, and/or studio production experience.
* Proficiency in video editing and post\-production tools, particularly Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with experience in editing, colour grading, and Adobe After Effects/motion graphics.
* Strong production coordination and organizational skills, with experience managing shoot schedules, call sheets, locations, equipment, travel, production documentation, and digital media organization, including footage ingestion, file naming, folder structures, and backups.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 and project collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
* Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal teams, external production partners, and on\-camera participants.
* A proactive and solutions\-oriented approach, with the ability to troubleshoot technical and logistical challenges calmly and independently while maintaining production and brand standards.
* Familiarity with AI\-powered tools for transcription, subtitling, or production workflows is an advantage.
* Willingness and ability to travel for filming assignments and flexibility to accommodate changing production schedules.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Media Production, Film, Communications, or a related field is preferred, although relevant practical experience will also be considered.
* Experience in corporate communications, science communication, or event filming is an advantage.

  

**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in\-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal \& financial support)
* Learning \& development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

***Equal opportunity statement***

***Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.***

title: Client Director - Private Client & Wealth structures
description:
**Client Director – Private Client \& Wealth structures**

**Solance** is building a tech\-enabled payments company. We are here for businesses that operate across multiple entities, jurisdictions and currencies, and for sectors that traditional banks generally overlook. Think family offices, internationally operating companies, corporate service providers and the clients they serve. We are going through the authorisation process with the Central Bank of Ireland, one of the most respected financial jurisdictions in Europe, and we are only getting started.

**Solance Private Clients** is one of our niches, built specifically for family offices and the parties that work closely with them. We begin with where we are strongest: payments and cards, giving clients a reliable financial partner for their day\-to\-day business. But that’s only the start. From there, we become the single point of contact for everything else a private client and their advisers need, from borrowing solutions and estate planning to investment advisory and wealth management. We do not provide those services ourselves. But we do solve them, drawing on a vast network of (private) banks, wealth managers, tax advisors and trusted partners who can facilitate almost any request a client brings. For every client need we will find the right party to accommodate such need.


**Your role, in plain terms**


This is a pure sales/BD seat. As Client Director for Solance you open doors, build trust, and turn relationships into a real pipeline. You will work the market you already know: the CSPs, the fiduciaries, the (multi) family offices, the wealth managers and the advisers who orbit private wealth. You bring them to Solance, and you own the relationship from there. Think of it as your own shop within Solance. You own the niche, you shape the brand of the Private Client business, and you run it with the freedom of a founder and with a tech\-enabled licensed EMI behind you. Nobody hands you a script or confines you to a certain territory. You determine where the business is and you go and build it.

**Who we are looking for:**

* You are about eight to ten years into your career, you have spent most of it in the world that revolves around private wealth: CSPs, international tax advisory, fiduciary firms, private banking, or any position where your days were spent across the table from private clients and their advisors.
* Ideally you have worked at more than one firm, so you understand how the PC industry really works, and you have a network that runs across that industry.
* People with a background in PC advisory and corporate services know two things you cannot teach overnight: a network, and the lingo.
* You already know a lot of CSPs, the introducers and the advisers.
* You understand what it takes to work with private banks and wealth managers, how and why corporate structures are actually created, what substance really means in practice, and how to talk to clients who expect to be taken seriously. That head\-start is exactly what Solance is built on.
* You add value to your clients.
* You are credible, discreet, and easy to trust in a room full of advisers and/or principals.
* You have energy, you get things done.
* You know where the business is, and you go and get it.

We need a builder, not a maintainer. Someone who runs, who is genuinely hungry, who gets a kick out of chasing a deal and closing it.  
* 

  

  

**Requirements**  

* Eight to ten years’ experience in a Private Client environment (CSP, advisory, banking), ideally across more than one firm.
* A genuine specialisation in, or strong exposure to, private clients and wealth.
* An active network of CSPs, fiduciaries, introducers, advisers and bankers.
* Skilled in structuring, substance and how international private wealth is organised.
* A builder's mentality: hungry, self\-starting, eager to run your own shop.
* International, and preferably multilingual. (English is a must)

**What is in it for you**


You will work very close with the CEO of Solance, not three layers down. You get real ownership of your client book, room to grow a team as your sales justify it, and the freedom to build the Private Client business, and its brand, from the ground up as if it were your own company. This comes with a competitive package, bonuses tied to what you actually bring in, and the chance to become a recognised name in a market you already care about. It is a builder's seat above all.

**Where you come from**

* We already have a good network in Luxembourg, Switzerland and Malta, if that’s your world, we’d love to hear from you too. But we are mostly interested in someone who opens new ground: The Netherlands, Cyprus, Iberia, the Nordics, wherever your relationships run deepest.
* Languages and a genuinely international footprint are a real advantage.
* Where you are based does not matter to us. You will be on the road constantly, in front of clients and partners wherever the business is, so base yourself wherever suits you. What matters is your reach, your network and your appetite for travel. That said, we do want you in our Dublin office on a regular basis, to stay close to the team and to feed what you are hearing from clients back into the business.
* You will be our ears in the market, and the product gets better because of what you bring home.

**Let us talk**


If this reads like you, get in touch. And if it reads like someone you rate, send them our way, or send us the introduction.

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.



Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  

  

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Ready to be part of the experience?

At Fever's SEO team, we capture and influence demand when millions search for what to do next. We engineer visibility across the entire discovery ecosystem: traditional search engines, LLMs, local listings, third party integrations and beyond. Our diverse portfolio of ecosystems and operating companies gives us the scale and complexity to master every SEO specialization—from technical infrastructure and content architecture, to AI search optimization, local market dominance, and brand authority building. Join us to redefine how the world finds experiences, together.

By partnering with world\-class Product, Engineering, Data and Marketing teams, we leverage cutting\-edge tools and data\-driven insights to deliver exceptional performance and measurable impact across major search engines and dynamic digital ecosystems.



As an AI Search Innovation Lead, you will drive the evolution of our brand's authority in the next era of search, focusing entirely on impact over traditional acronyms.
