AI Project Manager
description:
At Sanoma Learning, we all share a deep\-rooted passion for education and are committed to support teachers to help all students to reach their potential, so they can be at their best in class. We are proud of the impact we make together across Europe, local as well as international. As our teams and the scope of our impact grows, so do the opportunities for us to learn from each other – across country borders and areas of expertise. With over 3\.000 colleagues, we work on seamlessly integrated print, digital and blended learning solutions to help teachers and schools develop the talents of every child. Our people are passionate and committed and always willing to go the extra mile for students, teachers, schools, our shareholders and each other.


We believe that Data and AI can uncover multiple opportunities for education, including both internal efficiencies and new product opportunities; currently AI is a priority theme for Sanoma Learning.  



**AI Project Manager**

The AI Project Manager is part of the AI Enablement team – the small central team that makes AI work at Sanoma Learning possible: setting direction, building the foundations, and connecting the many parties involved. The team works as a flexible unit: members take ownership of the initiatives that matter most at a given moment, and capacity is redirected as priorities shift.  



Within that team, this role carries a clear centre of gravity: it is the connection point between AI at Sanoma Learning and the outside world, and between the AI team and the functions that own communication and strategy. The role does not replace those functions. It makes sure they have the AI substance, the right experts and the right coordination to do their work well – and it turns what the AI teams do into something that colleagues, customers, partners and the wider education community can understand and engage with.  



Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Data and AI, the AI Project Manager works across operating companies and central functions – Communications, Strategy, M\&A, Legal and the product and experimentation teams – and represents the AI agenda in those forums. This role also assumes matrix reporting into the Competence Lead of Project Management.  



**Key Responsibilities**

**AI communication – internal and external**

Acting as the AI team’s counterpart to the Communications function: bringing the content, the context and the experts, and coordinating the AI side of delivery.


* **Own the editorial cycle of the AI update newsletter** – collect input from AI initiatives and opcos, shape the story, manage the calendar and the review loop with Communications.
* **Run the AI webinar and event series** – programme, speakers, preparation of presenters, logistics with the relevant functions, and follow\-up.
* **Curate and maintain the AI Hub** – keep it current and usable, agree the content structure with contributing teams, and chase the contributions that make it worth visiting.
* **Coordinate AI content for the external website and corporate channels** – gather and quality\-assure input from the AI teams, propose what should be told publicly, and work with Communications, who own publication.
* **Sync a shared communication calendar for AI with communications** – so that announcements, launches, webinars and external moments are sequenced rather than colliding.

**Thought leadership and external presence**

Working with the Strategy function, which owns Sanoma Learning’s thought leadership agenda, to ensure AI is represented with credible substance.


* **Build and manage a pipeline of external speaking opportunities** – identify the conferences and forums worth being at, manage submissions and deadlines, and match the right internal speaker to each.
* **Prepare speakers and material** – coordinate narrative, evidence and rehearsal so that colleagues representing Sanoma Learning externally are well equipped.
* **Drive the production of white papers and publications on AI in education** – coordinate authors, source the evidence from our own initiatives, and run the process to publication with Strategy and Communications.
* **Manage relationships with research institutions and academic partners** – keep the contacts warm, track joint work, and identify where research collaboration strengthens our position.
* **Track the external conversation on AI in education** – what peers, policymakers and researchers are saying – and feed that back into the AI agenda.

**AI partnership and M\&A funnel**

Owning the front end of the AI partnership pipeline, feeding the teams that own the decisions and the transactions.


* **Build and maintain the funnel of AI\-related partnership and acquisition opportunities** – sourcing, structured overview, status and next steps.
* **Run first\-pass screening of candidates** – what they do, how it relates to our AI direction, what a fit would look like – and prepare the material that lets leadership decide what to pursue.
* **Organise the AI\-side assessment** – pull in the technical, product, privacy and compliance expertise needed to evaluate an opportunity properly, and consolidate the view.
* **Coordinate with Strategy and M\&A** , and with the business owners who would take on the partnership.
* **Maintain the relationship layer with active AI partners and vendors** – cadence, follow\-up and internal visibility of what each partnership is delivering.

**Leading AI initiatives and projects**

As a member of a small, flexible team, taking direct ownership of initiatives where capacity and momentum are needed.


* **Lead assigned AI initiatives and projects end to end** – scope, plan, stakeholders, delivery and closure – across the full breadth of the AI agenda.
* **Step into initiatives that need to move** – taking over, unblocking or accelerating work as priorities shift, including topics outside the communication and partnership scope.
* **Bring structure to ambiguous work** – turn broad intentions into a plan with owners, milestones and a decision path.
* **Prepare and facilitate the forums that move decisions forward** – working sessions, steering updates and executive material.
* **Represent the AI Enablement team in cross\-functional programmes** where AI is one of several contributing tracks.

**How this role works with others**

Communication and thought leadership are owned by dedicated functions at Sanoma Learning, and this role does not duplicate them. Its value lies in being the AI team’s connection into those functions: supplying substance and expertise, coordinating the AI\-side contributors, keeping the AI agenda sequenced and visible, and making sure opportunities are not lost because no one on the AI side was joining the dots. The success measure is that Communications and Strategy are consistently well served by AI – not that AI does their work.  



  

**A successful candidate will have the following:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
* Project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) are a strong advantage.

Additional coursework or certification in AI/ML, communications, or digital transformation is a plus.  

* 

**Experience**

* 4\+ years of professional experience in project, programme or initiative management in a digital, technology or innovation context, with at least 2 years connected to AI, data or digital transformation topics.
* Demonstrated experience in corporate or B2B communication – for example newsletters, webinars, content platforms, website content or campaign coordination – working with or within a communications function.
* Experience preparing executive\-level and external\-facing material, and supporting senior colleagues in representing the organisation publicly.
* Exposure to partnership management, vendor evaluation, corporate development or M\&A support activities.
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and business units, preferably in multi\-country or federated environments.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and the current AI landscape, sufficient to translate technical work into language a business or public audience understands.
* Hands\-on experience with collaboration and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, SharePoint) and with content or intranet platforms.

Experience in education, publishing or EdTech, or with research institutions, is a plus.  

* 

**Skills**

* Excellent written communication in English – able to turn technical and strategic material into clear, engaging content for different audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management, comfortable working as a connector between a specialist team and central functions without owning either side.
* Solid project management skills, able to run several parallel tracks with clarity on ownership, deadlines and status.
* Sound understanding of AI and data concepts, and the curiosity to keep that understanding current.
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems, facilitate alignment and drive decisions across teams.
* Strong sense for what is worth telling externally, and the judgement to know what is not.
* Comfortable with documentation, editorial process and governance that keep recurring communication running reliably.

Collaborative and proactive mindset, with an ability to connect the dots across organisational silos.  

* 

**Personal Attributes**

* Proactive and positive “can\-do” attitude, demonstrating initiative and resilience.
* Comfortable operating without formal authority, building influence through reliability and usefulness to others.
* Strong organisational skills, adept at managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Flexible and pragmatic – willing to pick up what the team needs at a given moment.
* Data\-driven decision\-making approach.
* Self\-motivated, consistently seeking opportunities for improvement and innovation.

Passionate about the opportunities in the Data and AI space, and about education.  

* 

**About Sanoma Learning**

  

How do you prepare students for the world, engage their curiosity and inspire them to grow? That is the main question of teachers all around the world. At Sanoma Learning, it has always been our mission to help to find and develop best\-in\-class answers to this question. If you join us, it means that you embark on an exciting journey to help shape the future of learning for primary, secondary and vocational education. We believe that your journey is our success as a company.
  

  

Sanoma Learning is a leading K12 European learning company, operating in 12 countries. Our learning products and services enable and support teachers and schools to develop the talents of every child to reach their potential. By offering printed and digital learning content, as well as digital learning and teaching platforms for primary, secondary and vocational education, we want to grow our positive impact on learning across Europe. With over 3000 employees, we help shape the future of education for 25\+ million of students.
  

  

So, are you ready to start your journey to help shape the future of learning and help teachers to support all students to reach their potential?
  

  

*Sanoma Learning is an equal opportunity employer; we are committed to inclusion and diversity, ensure equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics.*

description:
**Lead, Product Management, ELL Institutional Courseware**

This role aligns to industry\-level titles such as Head of Product, Director of Product Management, Product Portfolio Director, or similar product leadership positions with responsibility for portfolio strategy, commercial performance, and team leadership.


**Role Overview**

The Lead, Product Management, ELL Institutional Courseware owns Pearson’s global portfolio of English language learning materials for schools, higher education and adult education. The portfolio spans print, blended and digital courseware, supplementary materials, teacher professional development, and partner\-created content.


This is an opportunity to shape the future of a major global education portfolio. The role will decide where Pearson invests, grows, localises, simplifies and exits, with accountability for creating products that teachers choose, improve student learning outcomes, and deliver sustainable revenue growth and strong returns.


A central part of the mandate is leading the evolution of a print\-heavy portfolio towards connected, digital and AI\-enabled learning experiences. Pearson intends to lead this transition while staying grounded in the needs and readiness of teachers and institutions.


The role owns the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery and portfolio strategy through development, launch, performance management and retirement. It owns investment cases for approval by the ELL Leadership Team, recommends pricing and packaging, and drives initiatives to improve revenue and profitability.


The role leads a global team of approximately 15 colleagues through managers and works across Content, Learning Science, Engineering, Assessment, UX and AI. It is a member of the ELL Product Leadership Team and ELL Content Leadership Team, acting as the senior product owner for institutional courseware and aligning Product, Content, Sales, Marketing, Customer Service and Finance around a clear portfolio direction.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Set the Portfolio Strategy**

* Define and execute the global strategy and roadmap for institutional courseware, based on customer needs, market opportunities, learning outcomes, and commercial performance.
* Manage portfolio investments, prioritisation, localisation, innovation, and product lifecycle decisions.
* Act as the senior product authority, providing strategic recommendations to the ELL Leadership Team.

**Understand Customers and Markets**

* Build deep understanding of learners, educators, institutions, ministries, and partners across priority markets.
* Use customer insight, market trends, learning evidence, and performance data to drive product and investment decisions.
* Support strategic customer and ministry engagements alongside Sales teams.

**Create Market\-Winning Courseware**

* Translate strategy into compelling value propositions, product roadmaps, and requirements.
* Lead cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-impact learning solutions that balance customer value, learning effectiveness, quality, speed, and commercial outcomes.
* Validate opportunities through customer research, pilots, and data\-driven decision\-making.

**Lead the AI and Digital Transition**

* Drive the evolution from print\-first products to digital, blended, and AI\-enabled learning experiences.
* Identify and scale responsible AI opportunities that enhance learning, teaching, accessibility, and product efficiency.
* Ensure AI\-enabled products meet standards for transparency, safety, privacy, accessibility, and intellectual property compliance.

**Drive Growth and Investment Return**

* Develop business cases, pricing strategies, and investment recommendations for new and existing products.
* Partner with Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations to achieve customer, learning, revenue, profitability, and ROI objectives.
* Take decisive action to optimise, reposition, or retire underperforming products.

**Measure Learning and Product Performance**

* Establish and monitor success metrics across learning outcomes, adoption, engagement, satisfaction, retention, revenue, and profitability.
* Use evidence and performance data to continuously improve portfolio effectiveness.

**Lead the Team and Organisation**

* Lead and develop a global team of approximately 15 product professionals.
* Foster excellence in product management, customer discovery, strategy, commercial thinking, and AI\-enabled product development.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and customer focus.

**Expected Results**

* A clear global portfolio strategy and roadmap, understood across ELL.
* Sustainable revenue growth, improved profitability and stronger returns from courseware investment.
* A simpler, more intentional portfolio with clear investment and retirement choices.
* Global products that combine scale with effective localisation.
* A credible transition towards digital and AI\-enabled courseware that customers can adopt successfully.
* Measurable improvements in student learning outcomes, teacher effectiveness and customer value.
* Trusted relationships with major institutions, ministries, distributors and partners.
* Strong alignment across Product, Content, Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Finance and Technology.
* A high\-performing global product management team with strong managers and clear accountability.

**Experience**

* Relevant experience in product management, portfolio leadership, general management or a related field, including experience leading multiple teams or managing managers.
* Proven success setting strategy and making investment choices across a complex portfolio of products, markets or customer segments.
* A track record of turning customer insight into differentiated products and successful commercial outcomes.
* Experience owning business cases and managing performance against revenue, profitability, customer and return expectations.
* Strong judgement across investment, prioritisation, pricing, packaging and portfolio rationalisation.
* Experience leading cross\-functional product development in a global, matrixed organisation.
* Experience building product teams and developing product leaders.
* Experience in education, publishing, courseware, EdTech or learning products is strongly preferred.
* Experience applying AI, data or emerging technology to products is preferred.
* No specific degree is required. Relevant experience and demonstrated outcomes are valued.

* Proven expertise in product strategy, portfolio management, customer discovery, roadmap development, and stakeholder engagement.

As aData Governance Strategy\& Operations Lead (Data Program\& Performance Excellence Lead), you will act as a high\-impact internal consultant and delivery lead—bridging the gap between digital strategy, advanced analytics, and operational reality.
  
In this role, you will lead transformation initiatives across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). Using our structured Breakthrough Methodology (Preparation, Diagnose, Design, Implement, and Sustain), you will combine data engineering, AI\-driven process optimization, and behavioral change management to replace legacy operational models with scalable, tech\-enabled capabilities. You are an empathetic, outcome\-obsessed advisor who challenges the status quo and delivers measurable business value.
  
  

Your Main Responsibilities
  
  

* End\-to\-End Program Leadership Support: Co\-own the scoping, delivery, and value realization of high\-impact digital initiatives, ensuring strategic alignment with executive stakeholders, site leaders, and enterprise roadmaps.
* Data Product Delivery: Co\-lead the technical scoping and end\-to\-end deployment of data products, operational AI/ML models, and shop\-floor automation into daily manufacturing routines.
* Value Realization\& Diagnostics: Utilize hypothesis\-driven diagnostics and quantitative metrics (e.g., yield, cycle time, data integrity) to build compelling business cases and track real\-world value acceleration.

Partner with dedicated Principal OCM and Program Leads to ensure technical iterations align with user analytics and overarching governance roadmaps.
* Quality\& Regulatory Compliance: Facilitate and strictly adhere all digital and data interventions to GxP, Data Integrity standards, and emerging global regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, Annex 11\).
* Scale\& Industrialization: Facilitate and help drive digital initiatives out of the "pilot phase" into fully scalable enterprise data products integrated across the global operational network.
* Local Support\& Capability Building: Support site process owners and local teams in Agile, Lean, and Design Thinking to build repeatable, long\-term internal digital capabilities.


Who You Are
  
  

You are an accomplished transformation leader who thrives at the intersection of complex digital and data technology, human behavior, and large\-scale operational environments. You combine deep technical literacy with strategic foresight, empathy, and a proven track record of driving change across matrixed organizations. Experience in Change Management and Stakeholder Coaching is as critical as your technical program management expertise. You possess the ability to drive and facilitate execution through cross\-functional influence and matrixed leadership, rather than through direct\-report management.
  
  

**Qualifications\& Expertise:**  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Life Sciences, or a related field (Master’s or equivalent preferred).
* Professional Experience: Minimum of6\+ years of experience leading digital, data, or operational excellence transformations within complex, matrixed environments.Minimum of3\+ years of experience within pharmaceutical operations, biotechnology, healthcare IT, or highly regulated GxP process industries.
* Consulting Background: Strong consultancy track record, ideally with 5\+ years of experience in top\-tier firms ("MBB" or "Big 4").
* Technical\& Digital Literacy: Solid grasp of enterprise data architecture, AI/ML operational applications, digital adoption platforms (e.g., WalkMe, Pendo), and shop\-floor automation.
* Methodology Mastery: Proven expertise combining Lean/Six Sigma principles with Agile, SAFe, Design Thinking, and Organizational Change Management (e.g., Prosci) frameworks.
* Stakeholder Influence\& Matrix Leadership: Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to challenge senior leadership, navigate cross\-functional resistance, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business cases.
* Location: Madrid.


What is Here for You
  
  

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research\-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity.
  
  

* Impact for Patients: Direct contribution to optimizing the global manufacturing and supply chain operations that bring life\-saving therapies to millions of patients.
* High\-Visibility Scope: Broad strategic influence across the global Pharma Technical Operations network.
* Growth\& Culture: An empowering environment that values psychological safety, flexible hybrid working models, continuous learning, and personal development.


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.

description:
TomTom is a global leader in navigation, mapping, and traffic information. Join our dynamic team and vibrant culture to contribute to shaping the future of location technology.  


We are looking for an Applied Scientist to shape how AI understands and uses TomTom's location data. You'll develop machine learning models and design the systems that let LLMs reason accurately over maps, traffic, points of interest and routing. You'll turn open\-ended product questions into well\-defined scientific problems, validate solutions with rigorous evaluation, and work with AI and software engineers to bring them to production.
### **What you'll do:**

* **LLM–data interfaces:** Research and design how LLMs access and reason over TomTom's data. This covers retrieval strategies for structured and geospatial data, tool and API designs that LLMs can use reliably, text\-to\-query approaches, and grounding techniques.
* **Data representation:** Develop representations that make location data usable by AI, such as embeddings for geospatial entities, knowledge graphs and structured context formats.
* **Evaluation science:** Define how we measure whether LLM\-powered systems are right. Build benchmarks, factuality and hallucination metrics, and evaluation datasets for location\-grounded tasks, and work with engineers to automate them.
* **Model research and development:** Design, train and fine\-tune ML and deep learning models, including LLMs, computer vision, time\-series and graph\-based methods, using large\-scale, multi\-modal data.
* **Problem framing:** Work with product managers and stakeholders to identify high\-impact opportunities and turn them into well\-defined scientific problems with clear success metrics.
* **Research to production:** Write production\-quality code and work with AI and software engineers to take solutions from prototype to production, balancing accuracy, latency, cost and scalability.
* **State of the art:** Keep up with the latest research in LLMs, retrieval and agentic systems, and adapt promising techniques to TomTom's problems.
* **Knowledge sharing:** Communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, and help build a strong scientific culture. External publications and patents are encouraged.
### **What you'll need:**


* Bachelor’s, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics or a related quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong foundations in machine learning, deep learning, statistics and optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX, and with the Python scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn).
* Experience with one or more of: LLMs and generative AI, computer vision, time\-series forecasting, graph neural networks, or reinforcement learning.
* Proven ability to design experiments, define meaningful metrics and draw sound conclusions from data.
* Experience working with large\-scale datasets and distributed computing (e.g., Spark, Databricks, or cloud ML platforms on Azure, AWS or GCP).
* Ability to write clean, maintainable code and to work with engineers toward production deployment.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas to diverse audiences.
* A track record of publications at top\-tier venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, KDD) is a plus.
* Experience with geospatial, mapping, mobility or sensor data is a plus, but not required.
**What we offer**  

A competitive compensation package, of course.  

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e\-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.  

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.  

  

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.  

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance.  

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.  

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday.  

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.  

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom!  

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. **Meet your team**  

We're the Navigation SDK team. We work on complex code to develop TomTom's Navigation Software Development Kit, integrating technologies provided by other Product Units and enabling our customers to easily build competitive navigation applications. Your code will also be at the heart of TomTom's navigation products like AmiGO, helping millions of people find their way in the world. **At TomTom...**  

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first\-ever real\-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.  

Work with a team of 3,300\+ unique, curious and passionate problem\-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them. **After you apply**

**Cabinet D\-JP.A** is conducting a search for a client operating in the **stock images and digital visual\-content industry**. **Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Define and execute the company’s strategic roadmap in close collaboration with the consortium founders and shareholders.
* Translate the strategic vision into clear operational priorities and measurable objectives.
* Establish key milestones, performance indicators and management reporting.

**Commercial Development**

* Define and execute the company’s commercial and go\-to\-market strategy.

* Build a strong, performance\-driven commercial culture across the organisation.

**Financial Management \& Fundraising**

* Take overall responsibility for financial performance, budgeting, forecasting and cash management.

* Prepare and regularly update the company’s business plan and financial projections.
* Lead fundraising initiatives in collaboration with founders and shareholders.
* Build credible relationships with investors, financial partners and other stakeholders.
* Prepare the company for future financing rounds and investor due diligence.
* Ensure capital is allocated efficiently and in line with strategic priorities.

**Technology \& Innovation**

* Work closely with technology leadership to define the product and technology roadmap.
* Translate commercial and strategic requirements into clear technology priorities.
* Maintain a strong understanding of developments in artificial intelligence, digital platforms and emerging technologies.
* Identify technologies capable of improving scalability, efficiency and customer experience.
* Ensure technology investments support the company’s long\-term competitive positioning.
* Encourage innovation while maintaining clear commercial and operational objectives.

**Building the Organisation**

* Build and lead a high\-performing, multidisciplinary organisation.
* Recruit key executives, managers and specialist talent as the company develops.
* Define clear roles, responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Establish effective management processes and appropriate corporate governance.
* Develop a culture combining entrepreneurial agility with professional execution.
* Create an organisation capable of scaling internationally without unnecessary bureaucracy.

**Strategic Partnerships**

* Develop senior\-level relationships across the digital media, technology, creative and cultural ecosystems.
* Identify and negotiate strategic commercial and technology partnerships.
* Explore opportunities for distribution, content, licensing and international collaboration.
* Build relationships capable of accelerating market access and business development.
* Represent the company with strategic partners and key industry stakeholders.

**What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate should have the ability to transform an ambitious strategic vision into a scalable international business :

* Significant experience as a **CEO, Managing Director, General Manager, Founder, senior COO** or comparable executive leader.
* Ideally **7\+ years of senior management or leadership experience**.
* Demonstrated responsibility for business strategy, financial performance and operational execution.
* Experience developing and implementing business plans and growth strategies.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cash management and financial reporting.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building organisations through periods of growth.
* Demonstrated commercial and business\-development capabilities.
* Experience working with founders, shareholders, boards and/or investors.
* Exposure to fundraising, financing rounds or investor relations would be particularly valuable.
* Experience with digital platforms, technology\-enabled businesses or international expansion.
* Professional fluency in **French and English**; additional languages would be an advantage.

Relevant industry backgrounds may include **digital media, technology, AI, SaaS, marketplaces, creative industries, photography, digital commerce, licensing, fintech or platform businesses**.

Experience in the visual\-content or stock\-image industry would be valuable, but it is **not a prerequisite**.

**Location \& International Scope**

The position is based in Lisbon, Portugal, with an international scope. The CEO will work with shareholders, partners and stakeholders across different markets and should be comfortable with international travel when required.

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial conversation with the recruitment team at Cabinet D\-JP.A.
* Executive interviews with the consortium founding members.
* Strategic discussion around the business plan and CEO mandate.
* Final offer and appointment.

Candidates may be asked to provide a perspective on how they would approach the first 12–18 months of execution for the round A shareholders. The identity of the client will be progressively disclosed to candidates who have been qualified and selected to advance in the process. If this opportunity corresponds to your experience and ambitions, please submit your CV together with a short executive introduction to Cabinet D\-JP.A. All enquiries will be handled confidentially.

As an integral member of the Strategic Marketing and Communications shared services team, the Email Marketing Specialist supports email communications that advance the priorities of ASU Health and its academic units. Email is a critical communications channel across the organization, reaching prospective and current students, faculty, staff, alumni, partners and other key audiences.  



The position supports a broad portfolio of communications, including newsletters, leadership communications, internal communications, recruitment and enrollment campaigns, student retention communications, event communications, alumni engagement, advancement initiatives and institutional announcements. The specialist works collaboratively with communications, enrollment marketing, alumni engagement, events, social media, creative services, web and unit partners to ensure email communications are coordinated, audience\-focused, accessible, measurable and aligned with ASU brand standards.  



The Email Marketing Specialist serves as the team’s technical expert for email marketing and communications, with hands\-on responsibility for Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HTML email development, audience segmentation, list management, automated journeys, dynamic content, quality assurance, testing, analytics and reporting. The specialist uses data and industry best practices to continuously strengthen email performance and the audience experience across the shared services model.  



The position reports to the Assistant Director of Communications for ASU Health.  



**Essential Duties:**

* Use Salesforce Marketing Cloud to design, build, test, schedule and deploy mass and targeted email communications for ASU Health and the four health academic units, including newsletters, leadership and internal communications, institutional announcements and campaigns supporting events, advancement, recruitment, yield, student retention and alumni engagement.
* Partner with communications, enrollment marketing, alumni engagement, events, creative services, social media, web and other subject matter experts to establish email objectives and develop integrated strategies related to content, audiences, frequency, timing, personalization and segmentation that advance recruitment, engagement, retention, reputation and institutional priorities.
* Manage email communications supporting enrollment and yield objectives for academic programs, including campaigns for prospective, applicant and admitted student audiences.
* Support leadership and internal communications by building and deploying messages on behalf of deans and executive leaders to faculty, staff and other key audiences.
* Incorporate copy, graphics and other content developed independently or in collaboration with writers, designers and other members of the Strategic Marketing and Communications shared services team.
* Maintain, update and segment recipient lists and develop audience strategies that ensure data accuracy, improve relevance and personalization, reach intended audiences, and help manage communication frequency and duplication across units.
* Design emails and test communications across email clients, browsers and devices to ensure optimal functionality, accessibility and user experience while adhering to ASU brand standards and applicable university guidelines.
* Develop and manage automated email journeys and workflows using dynamic content, custom fields, segmentation and personalization to create relevant audience experiences.
* Manage the email quality assurance process before deployment, including reviewing links, subject lines, preheaders, sender profiles, personalization, dynamic content, audience selection, rendering, accessibility and mobile responsiveness.
* Coordinate email calendars across ASU Health and the four academic units to identify overlapping communications, manage timing and support a thoughtful audience experience.
* Establish, monitor and report key performance indicators for email communications, including delivery, engagement, click\-through and conversion metrics, and translate results into actionable recommendations for communications, marketing and academic unit partners.
* Monitor email deliverability and emerging industry practices, technologies and trends, including AI integration, responsive design, personalization and automation, to identify opportunities to improve sender reputation, inbox placement, performance and the overall email program.

Within our fastgrowing network, there’s plenty of opportunity to develop your skillset through market\-leading training schemes, including our proprietary Dentsu University courses. You’ll be encouraged to be curious, to share new ideas and to be innovative and bold – we believe great ideas should come from everyone in the team. To that end we’re also actively engaged in ensuring DEI is at the heart of what we think, say and do. We work as part of the many pillars within our global and local DEI group \- and strongly encourage all of our teams to be actively involved here too.  



  

In exchange for your contribution to our award\-winning company, we make sure you’ll find the right work\-life balance \- mental wellness is incredibly important to us so we ensure everyone takes advantage of their generous holiday allowance as well as several additional Wellness Days each year \- additional days off which are enjoyed by everyone within the Dentsu group. We know right now that the ability to work remotely is as important as the ability to come together f2f as a team and agency, so we have enabled each team to build bespoke charters to identify the rhythm and cadence of when it will add value to be in the office collaborating round a table and when it’s useful to work from where suits you – all with the goal of driving success for our clients, our teams and our agency in the smartest ways possible. The AE will work at pace across a number of simultaneous projects either within one account or more likely across multiple accounts. They will develop their experience of account management as well as starting to understand the planning process across both the brand and demand gen sides of the business. Further they will work closely with other channel teams, strategists and external agencies to ensure the smooth delivery, activation, reporting and optimisation of campaigns for clients.

The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801\. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse.


Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever\-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must\-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi\-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next.


We’re looking for a **Director of Engineering** to join our technology team and lead the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands\-on engineering role with core responsibilities around infrastructure services, data pipelines, personalization systems, consumer AI, internal AI tooling, and custom APIs across AWS and GCP projects.

* 5\+ years experience leading engineering teams.

* Strong troubleshooting skills

 Harley\-Davidson Motor Company, founded in a humble Milwaukee backyard shed in 1903, still calls the city home. Today, its Corporate Campus includes a 4\.8\-acre public park—a welcoming greenspace open to all. Join our team as a Director Brand Marketing.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Director of Brand \& Campaign is responsible for defining and leading Harley\-Davidson’s North America brand strategy, integrated campaign planning, and go\-to\-market execution. This role serves as the connective engine between brand, product, and commercial outcomes \- translating strategy into culturally relevant, consumer\-led campaigns that drive demand, strengthen brand equity, and deliver measurable business results.
   

  

 This leader owns annual planning and key launch moments across motorcycles, Parts \& Accessories (P\&A), Apparel \& Licensing (A\&L), Service, and strategic partnerships, ensuring a cohesive narrative and consistent execution across all channels and touchpoints. The role requires a balance of long\-term brand stewardship and near\-term commercial impact, with a relentless focus on integration, clarity, and performance.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Own enterprise\-level brand and campaign strategy, leading annual planning, seasonal storytelling, and high\-impact go\-to\-market execution that connects brand positioning to product, retail, and cultural moments.
* Define and lead the “middle layer” of marketing \- translating brand strategy into integrated, consumer\-led campaigns across paid, owned, earned, and experiential channels.
* Lead annual marketing calendar development and orchestration of key launch moments, balancing tentpole launches with always\-on storytelling to drive sustained demand and business performance.
* Oversee product and innovation marketing, partnering with Product, Engineering, Commercial, and GTM teams to translate features into compelling consumer value and retail impact.
* Set marketing strategy for Apparel \& Licensing, Parts \& Accessories, and Service, driving full\-funnel growth while reinforcing the brand as a lifestyle leader beyond core products.
* Lead strategic partnerships to expand reach, unlock new audiences, and strengthen cultural relevance while ensuring brand integrity and executional excellence.
* Serve as the central cross\-functional leader, aligning Brand, Media, PR, Experiential, Retail, and Dealer teams around clear priorities, toolkits, and execution standards.

* High School Diploma or Equivalent required.


**Required**
**Experience Requirements**

description:
**About the Company**


The next generation of independent cardiology is being built here. CardioOne is a physician\-led, technology\-driven cardiology platform built to empower independent practices to compete, and win, in a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape. Our mission is to provide cardiologists with the tools, infrastructure, and expertise they need to thrive while maintaining full clinical independence. We believe the best care is delivered by physicians who are empowered \- not constrained \- by the systems around them. We combine a deep bench of healthcare operators with purpose\-built technology and AI\-enabled solutions across operations, revenue cycle, imaging, and practice development. From real estate and advanced imaging to clinical workflows and data infrastructure, CardioOne delivers a fully integrated platform designed to drive growth, efficiency, and superior patient outcomes.


Backed by WindRose Health Investors and leading healthcare executives, CardioOne is building one of the most sophisticated and scalable cardiology MSOs in the country \- designed to reimagine what is possible for independent cardiology.

**About the Job**


As Director of Engineering, you will lead the engineering organization behind scalable, secure, AI\-enabled healthcare technology that improves clinical and operational outcomes. This role is ideal for a hands\-on strategic leader who wants to build modern platforms, develop high\-performing teams, and shape the future of healthcare delivery through thoughtful technology, data, and AI and will include all aspects of technology build including Infrastructure/Hosting, Security/Compliance, Product/Tool integrations, Data Warehousing/Business Intelligence and supporting existing vendor product stack, etc. You will report directly to the Chief Product Officer and work remotely.

**What you’ll do:**

* **Technology strategy and architecture**


	+ Provide strategic leadership for the healthcare engineering team by setting the technical vision and direction for scalable, secure, AI\-enabled healthcare IT solutions that address evolving customer needs, improve clinical and operational workflows, and create measurable business impact.
	+ Stay abreast of emerging technologies and trends in the healthcare industry, including applied AI, automation, interoperability standards, cloud\-native architectures, cybersecurity, and data platforms, and assess their potential impact on the organization.
	+ Set the technical vision and lead technical decisions to ensure the team builds simple, reliable, secure, scalable, and high\-performing products using modern engineering practices.

Collaborate with security, compliance, clinical, and legal stakeholders to ensure healthcare systems adhere to applicable industry standards, data protection requirements, and responsible AI practices.

title: EVP, Media
description:
**Executive Vice President of Media**
=====================================

**Location:** Remote — United States  

**Department:** Executive Leadership  

**Reports to:** Chief Operating Officer  

**Position Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt

**Compensation**
----------------


We offer a **competitive total executive compensation package** that includes a base salary, a target annual bonus equal to **20% of base salary based on EBITDA performance**, and an **equity participation opportunity**, subject to MountainGate approval. The package is designed to reflect the scope, scale, leadership expectations, and enterprise impact of this role.

**About Ignite Visibility**
---------------------------


Ignite Visibility is an award\-winning, premier full\-service digital marketing agency helping enterprise, franchise, and multi\-location brands accelerate growth through data\-driven strategy, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.


Our integrated capabilities span **Paid Media, Earned Media, Digital Experience, Creative, Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing, and AI\-enabled technology solutions**.


Following a period of significant growth and strategic acquisitions, Ignite is entering its next phase: building a more integrated, scalable, technology\-enabled performance marketing organization. We are bringing together complementary capabilities, operating models, talent, and technology platforms to create a more seamless experience for our clients and greater opportunities for growth across the organization.


Our investments in **AI, automation, analytics, and operational excellence** are designed to help us deliver smarter, more scalable solutions while maintaining the high\-touch client partnerships that have helped define Ignite.


This is an opportunity to join the executive team at an important point in that evolution.

**The Executive Opportunity**
-----------------------------


Ignite Visibility is seeking a **commercially driven, growth\-oriented, and people\-centered Executive Vice President of Media** to lead and scale our integrated Media organization across **Paid Media and Earned Media**.


The Media organization represents approximately **$30M in revenue** and is one of the largest and most strategically important areas of the business.


Reporting directly to the COO and serving as a key member of the executive leadership team, the EVP of Media will operate as the **General Manager across Paid Media and Earned Media**, with accountability for the combined organization's financial performance, growth, client retention, operating effectiveness, service evolution, leadership development, and long\-term value creation.


This is **not a traditional Media leadership role**. We are looking for an executive who can take an established, high\-performing Media organization to its next level — strengthening operational excellence, accelerating growth, developing exceptional leaders, improving profitability and predictability, and leveraging **AI, automation, analytics, and technology** to build a more intelligent and scalable organization.


The EVP will lead the SVPs of Paid Media and Earned Media, who will retain ownership of strategy, operations, client outcomes, talent, and financial delivery within their respective businesses. The EVP will establish the shared direction, operating framework, investment priorities, and cross\-capability commercial model while maintaining the specialized expertise and delivery models that make each function successful.


This leader will also play a meaningful role in **enterprise strategy, acquisition integration, executive client relationships, and the continued evolution of Ignite's broader agency platform**.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Executive Leadership, Integration \& P\&L**

* Own the combined **$30M Media P\&L**, including revenue growth, Net Revenue Retention, gross margin, forecasting, investment priorities, and operating performance.
* Lead and develop the SVPs of Paid Media and Earned Media, establishing clear accountability and decision rights across the organization.
* Establish a shared Media operating framework spanning governance, performance management, financial discipline, quality standards, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Serve as a strategic partner to the COO, CEO, and executive leadership team on company strategy, board priorities, acquisition integration, and long\-term enterprise value creation.
* Act as executive sponsor for strategic enterprise and multi\-location client relationships, including major renewals, expansions, and high\-stakes commercial opportunities.

### **Growth, Retention \& Commercial Strategy**

* Own Media\-wide **Net Revenue Retention, gross retention, expansion revenue, and portfolio health**.
* Develop repeatable growth and cross\-sell strategies connecting Paid Media, Earned Media, Digital Experience, Creative, CRO, Analytics, and Ignite's technology platforms.
* Partner with Sales and Client Success to shape enterprise solutions, pricing, staffing models, commercial terms, and delivery feasibility.
* Establish disciplined standards around deal quality, scope, margin, performance assumptions, and portfolio economics.
* Identify opportunities to expand relationships across Ignite's existing and acquired client portfolio.

### **Integrated Media Strategy \& Innovation**

* Define the strategic direction for an integrated Media organization connecting paid investment, organic discovery, brand authority, Creative, CRO, Analytics, and client business outcomes.
* Modernize and evolve Ignite's Media service portfolio, including integrated packaging, enterprise solutions, franchise offerings, pricing principles, and service lifecycle decisions.
* Partner across Digital Experience, Product \& Technology, Client Success, PMO, Analytics, and Rallio AI to establish and execute a Media innovation roadmap.
* Accelerate adoption of **AI, automation, advanced analytics, measurement, and emerging search capabilities** to improve client outcomes, differentiation, scalability, and financial performance.
* Ensure innovation translates into commercially viable, measurable solutions rather than technology for technology's sake.

### **Enterprise, Franchise \& Multi\-Location Growth**

* Define Ignite's integrated Media strategy for enterprise, franchise, and multi\-location clients.
* Connect national brand priorities with measurable regional, franchisee, and location\-level outcomes.
* Establish scalable governance, reporting, service architecture, and delivery models across Paid Media, Earned Media, Digital Experience, Analytics, and technology platforms.
* Strengthen Ignite's ability to deliver integrated solutions across complex, distributed client organizations.

### **Financial Performance \& Operational Excellence**

* Drive sustainable improvement in Media gross margin through pricing, packaging, staffing mix, scope discipline, resource allocation, workflow modernization, and technology adoption.
* Establish standards for client\- and service\-level profitability, cost\-to\-serve, investment decisions, and portfolio optimization.
* Improve forecasting accuracy, delivery predictability, operating discipline, and financial visibility across Media.
* Establish Media\-wide quality, delivery, risk, and governance standards while maintaining accountability within each functional business.
* Make disciplined decisions around the restructuring, investment, or exit of structurally unattractive work.

### **Leadership, Organization \& Culture**

* Build and develop a high\-performing leadership organization through the SVPs of Paid Media and Earned Media.
* Strengthen the broader VP and Director leadership bench and establish a deep pipeline of future Media leaders.
* Assess organizational structure, spans of control, role clarity, succession, and talent requirements as the business scales.
* Build a culture of transparency, collaboration, accountability, and sustainable high performance.
* Address leadership and performance gaps through coaching, organizational redesign, role clarification, or talent decisions when necessary.
* Reduce key\-person dependency and build organizational resilience through clear succession planning and leadership development.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**
--------------------------------------------------

**A more integrated Media organization.** Paid Media and Earned Media operate within a shared leadership and operating framework with clear decision rights, coordinated commercial strategies, common performance standards, and preserved functional expertise.

**Accelerated growth and stronger client retention.** The combined Media organization meets or exceeds growth and retention objectives through stronger client outcomes, integrated service adoption, and expansion across existing and acquired client portfolios.

**Improved profitability and predictability.** Media delivers sustainable gross\-margin improvement through stronger pricing, packaging, portfolio economics, delivery discipline, resource optimization, and technology adoption.

**A stronger leadership organization.** The Media leadership structure is clear, the SVPs and broader leadership bench are operating effectively, succession plans are established, and leaders are equipped to scale the business.

**A differentiated Media innovation roadmap.** Ignite establishes and begins executing a forward\-looking roadmap spanning AI search, performance media, attribution, analytics, automation, and Rallio AI\-enabled capabilities.

**Stronger enterprise integration.** Media operates as a strategic partner across Ignite's broader platform, creating new opportunities for cross\-capability growth and delivering a more integrated experience for enterprise, franchise, and multi\-location clients.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Executive Agency Leadership**

* 12\+ years of progressive experience within a digital marketing, performance marketing, or related agency environment, including significant executive leadership experience.
* Experience leading a scaled, multidisciplinary organization through senior leaders, including SVPs, VPs, and Directors.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a business leader and General Manager, not solely as a functional or channel leader.

### **P\&L \& Commercial Leadership**

* Proven ownership of a significant agency or business\-unit P\&L, including revenue growth, retention, gross margin, forecasting, investment allocation, and operating performance.
* Strong commercial orientation with experience driving expansion, improving client retention, shaping enterprise solutions, and managing portfolio economics.
* Ability to balance growth, client outcomes, profitability, and long\-term organizational health.

### **Integrated Media Leadership**

* Deep expertise in either **Paid Media AND Earned Media**, with sufficient strategic fluency across both disciplines to evaluate leaders, challenge strategy, allocate investment, and establish an integrated commercial model.
* Experience leading complex, multi\-channel Media organizations and translating channel expertise into broader business outcomes.
* Understanding of the evolving intersection of performance media, organic discovery, brand authority, Creative, CRO, Analytics, and technology.

### **Transformation \& Integration**

* Demonstrated success integrating acquired, legacy, or previously separate teams into a shared operating framework with aligned systems, metrics, governance, and culture.
* Experience leading organizations through significant growth, transformation, or operating\-model evolution.
* Ability to create structure and accountability without compromising the specialized expertise that drives functional performance.

### **Enterprise \& Multi\-Location Experience**

* Experience developing and scaling strategies for enterprise, franchise, multi\-location, national, regional, or other complex distributed client organizations.
* Ability to connect enterprise\-level strategy with measurable local and location\-level business outcomes.

### **Data, Technology \& Innovation**

* Strong analytical fluency across attribution, incrementality, customer economics, business intelligence, and performance measurement.
* Demonstrated interest and practical experience applying **AI, automation, analytics, and technology** to improve agency delivery, client outcomes, and organizational scalability.
* Ability to distinguish meaningful innovation from technology that does not create measurable business value.

### **Executive Presence**

* Highly credible with C\-suite clients, senior executives, and internal stakeholders.
* Strong communicator who can translate complex Media strategies into clear business priorities, financial implications, and measurable outcomes.
* Comfortable operating with significant autonomy, making difficult trade\-offs, and holding senior leaders accountable.
* Collaborative, commercially minded, and capable of building trust across a highly cross\-functional organization.

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience required.
* Master's degree or MBA preferred.

**Why This Role, Why Now**
--------------------------


Ignite Visibility is at an inflection point in its growth. We have established Media capabilities, significant client relationships, experienced functional leadership, and a growing technology platform. The opportunity now is to **bring those strengths together and build what comes next**.


The EVP of Media will have the scope, autonomy, and executive visibility to shape that next chapter — leading a **$30M Media organization**, influencing enterprise strategy, developing the next generation of Media leadership, and helping define how a modern performance marketing agency operates in an increasingly AI\-driven landscape.


This is an opportunity for a proven agency executive who wants to move beyond managing a function and **help build an enterprise\-scale Media organization for the next phase of growth**.

  

Ignite Visibility is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, disability, sex, age, ethnic or national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or presentation, pregnancy, genetics, veteran status or any other status protected by state or federal law.

title: Account Executive - Private Equity
description:
**About Qualitate**
===================


Qualitate is building the AI\-native primary intelligence platform for enterprises, investment firms, and asset managers. We automate the entire primary research workflow, from study design and expert recruitment through AI\-moderated interviews and insight synthesis – replacing weeks of manual research with hours of high\-signal output.


Expert research is a broken industry dominated by legacy incumbents with expensive, manual, and slow services. Investment and corporate strategy teams spend hundreds of hours coordinating intermediaries, scheduling expert calls, and synthesizing insights across fragmented providers. The process takes weeks to produce short\-lived intelligence.


Qualitate transforms this workflow by autonomously conducting expert discussions at scale using AI. Qualitate’s AI Moderator interviews thousands of experts simultaneously each month, capturing forward\-looking purchasing plans, competitive displacement, and real\-time ROI signals. The platform turns these interviews into quantified, time\-series outputs tracking over 10,000 public and private companies – queryable instantly in natural language.


Our customers include some of the world’s largest enterprises, hedge funds, PE firms, credit investors, and venture capital firms. We’re growing fast, and need account executives to help scale our GTM organization.

**The Role**
============


Sell into one of Qualitate's largest customer markets, the private equity and growth equity vertical. You'll be selling AI\-powered primary intelligence in a full\-cycle closing role — you build your own pipeline, run your own demos, and close your own deals. The right person understands the private equity asset class and can show how Qualitate accelerates diligence and improves analytical rigor.


Private equity funds use Qualitate to run industry expert diligence on new deals, map competitive landscapes, build value\-add portfolio programs, and monitor portfolio companies. As part of our founding GTM team, you'll develop the messaging, case studies, and sales process for this vertical from scratch.

**What the day\-to\-day looks like:**
-------------------------------------

* Prospect into and close private equity firms and growth equity firms. You own the full cycle.
* Build pipeline through your own network, outbound prospecting, modern AI tooling, industry events, and creative approaches.
* Run demos tailored to private equity workflows
* Navigate institutional buying processes, including GPs, managing directors, heads of research, CIOs, investment committee members, compliance, and procurement.
* Manage trials and proof\-of\-concepts through to conversion, driving adoption and purchasing in target accounts.
* Feed product insights back to engineering. Your market signal directly shapes what we build.
* Help build the sales playbook. As part of our founding go\-to\-market team, you’ll develop the messaging, case studies, competitive positioning, and sales process for this vertical from scratch.

**Who This Role Is For**
------------------------

* **3–8 years of quota\-carrying closing experience** selling software, data, or research products into PE firms.
* **You have a network in the private equity ecosystem.** You can get meetings with deal team leads, heads of research, GPs, and managing directors without waiting for inbound.
* **You understand and are curious about private markets.** How funds evaluate industries, assess management teams, model scenarios, and build conviction on new investments. You can map Qualitate’s capabilities to that process.
* **You’ve sold to skeptical, analytically rigorous buyers.** You know how to earn credibility, demonstrate concrete value, and let the product speak.
* **You’re comfortable with consultative selling motions** where the deal often starts with proving value on a live underwriting project before expanding into a platform commitment.
* **You’ve built.** Early\-stage or high\-growth experience where the sales process wasn’t handed to you.

**What Sets You Apart**
-----------------------

* Direct experience selling research tools, data products, or workflow software to private equity
* Familiarity with expert networks and how PE teams currently use (or underuse) them for industry diligence and management references.
* You’ve been part of an early sales team where you helped build the GTM function.
* Prior experience in finance before moving into sales.

**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------

* **OTE:** Competitive base \+ uncapped commissions with accelerators above quota. Early\-stage equity stake.
* **Benefits:** Health coverage, flexible PTO, paid holidays.
* **Location:** NYC hybrid (3 days in\-office, 2 days remote).
