title: Chief Desing Officer
description:
Estamos en búsqueda de un/a **Chief Design Officer** para sumarse al equipo de nuestro cliente, una agencia creativa de marketing y comunicación de servicio integral, con posicionamiento premium.

Buscamos un perfil que combine visión estratégica con capacidad de ejecución, para consolidar a la agencia como un referente de diseño en el mercado y elevar el nivel del equipo creativo.

**OBJETIVO DEL PUESTO**

* Elevar el estándar de calidad visual de la agencia y consolidarla como un referente de diseño en el mercado.
* Liderar la dirección de arte de proyectos clave y de new business de alto valor.
* Fortalecer el liderazgo y el criterio del equipo creativo.

**RESPONSABILIDADES**

* Innovación y referente. Definir los estándares de calidad visual de la agencia y liderar la innovación en diseño, branding y comunicación visual, con análisis de mejores prácticas y benchmarks internacionales.
* New business y proyectos clave. Liderar la dirección de arte de prospectos y proyectos estratégicos para asegurar propuestas competitivas y de alto nivel, siendo el principal responsable de su ejecución directa.
* Liderazgo y desarrollo del equipo creativo. Fortalecer el criterio y el liderazgo del equipo, definir procesos y herramientas de tecnología que eficienten su forma de trabajar y ayudar a cumplir las entregas en tiempo y forma.
* Operación y satisfacción de cuentas existentes. Supervisar la calidad del trabajo entregado e intervenir en cuentas y momentos clave para asegurar la satisfacción del cliente.
* Materiales internos de la agencia. Definir, ejecutar y supervisar los estándares visuales de los materiales internos y de marca para garantizar consistencia y calidad.

**UN DÍA EN EL ROL**

* Dar seguimiento a los proyectos de new business y a las cuentas activas que requieran su intervención.
* Monitorear la calidad de los entregables de diseño audiovisual de las cuentas en operación.
* Sostener un touch point semanal con la Head de Diseño y su equipo para dar seguimiento y

feedback.

* Coordinarse con Estrategia, Content e Innovación desde las etapas tempranas del brief en proyectos clave.
* Tomar decisiones de diseño siempre que se cumplan los deadlines, y escalar cuando un deadline con cliente se vea afectado.
* Reportar a la Dirección General el estado de las cuentas, la operación y el desarrollo del equipo creativo.

**EXPERIENCIA Y SKILLS**

* 10\+ años de experiencia en diseño con enfoque digital, en agencias creativas, de publicidad o de marketing.
* Trayectoria comprobada hasta posiciones de liderazgo creativo (Director/a de Arte Senior o equivalente).
* Experiencia liderando proyectos de alto impacto, new business y equipos creativos, manteniendo altos estándares de calidad.
* Dominio de Adobe Creative Suite, Figma y After Effects, y uso cotidiano de herramientas de IA aplicadas al diseño.
* Liderazgo y mentoría: desarrolla talento, eleva el nivel del equipo y promueve una cultura de colaboración, aprendizaje y mejora continua.
* Perfil que combina visión estratégica con capacidad de ejecución, criterio creativo y orientación a resultados.

**PERFIL IDEAL**

* Referente en tendencias de diseño y entusiasta de la IA.
* Conocimiento profundo de marketing digital y redes sociales.

**EQUIPO Y REPORTE**

* Reporta a la Dirección General de la agencia.
* Trabaja de la mano con la Head de Diseño, quien tiene a cargo un equipo de 5 diseñadores.
* Interactúa con las áreas de Innovación, Estrategia, Cuentas y Content.

**CONDICIONES**

* Modalidad híbrida (3 oficina \+ 2 HO)
* Salario competitivo \+ beneficios coorporativos.

Sueldo: $50,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 al mes

Lugar de trabajo: remoto híbrido en Ciudad de México, CDMX

title: Country Manager, Argentina
location: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
description:
**Company Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
 Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Where and how you can work**
 Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Argentina, this role is fully remote—giving you the flexibility to do your best work from wherever you thrive.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Strategy. Act as the main leadership point of contact with responsibility for overall user and revenue growth in Argentina. You'll bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, product, content and finance to create and execute a cohesive multi\-year growth strategy, and own the KPIs including MAUs and ARR.
* Localisation. Work closely with the regional team to optimise our product, content, pricing and packaging to meet the needs of local users, informed by a deep understanding of local market dynamics and cultural nuances across a range of audiences, including knowledge workers, SMBs, students, startup ecosystems, NGOs, and other emerging sectors.
* Leadership. Hire, inspire, drive and in some cases coach the in\-market team, ensuring a high quality bar for impact and working closely with local speciality leads on performance management.
* Budget. Partner closely with the regional team and marketing lead to shape the marketing strategy and deployment of budget.
* Sponsorship. Build and support high value relationships by acting as a local sponsor for enterprise sales, education, government, partnerships, etc.
* Public face. Represent Canva as a local figurehead across press, PR, events and community.


**You're probably a match if**
* You are strongly entrepreneurial. Founder\-style appetite for growing something big from a small start and working across everything from education to press.
* You possess experience growing a market. For example, as the regional GM or brand lead for a global SaaS company, or as a proven founder or growth lead in a startup in a high growth environment.
* You are a proven leader. Ability to grow, inspire, and coach high\-performing teams. You have high emotional intelligence and empathy, and are a deeply collaborative teammate.
* You are a strong communicator. Fully proficient in spoken and written English, and with the interpersonal skills to influence global and local stakeholders.
* You are keenly analytical. Deeply focused on KPIs and obsessive about driving actionable insights from disparate datasets and able to think about a market’s performance holistically.
* you are product oriented. Passion for improving the experience of users and the ability to translate local insights into product requirements with experience localising a global product for a particular market.
* You are values aligned. Genuinely excited by Canva’s mission and deeply aligned with our values, and with exceptional references to prove it.
* You are publicity savvy. Experience doing public speaking and acting as a public face to the press and other stakeholders.
* You are well networked. Ideally with routes into some combination of government departments, corporates, influencers, journalists and local talent


**About The Team**
 Canva’s International supergroup is a diverse, distributed team of marketers, strategists, and growth leaders focused on expanding Canva's presence in key global markets. Our team partners with functions across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, Partnerships, Content, Finance, and Strategy to drive sustainable user and revenue growth in international markets.
   

  

 As the Country Manager for Argentina, you will be the main point of contact and the driving force behind Canva’s success in the country. You will own and implement a multi\-year strategic roadmap, leading cross\-functional efforts to grow the user base and scale revenue.
   

  

 This role requires deep market knowledge, a growth mindset, and strong leadership capabilities to bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, and product in a cohesive strategy.
   

  

**What's in it for you?**
 Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard \- and we do \- but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
   

  

**Here's a Taste Of What's On Offer**
* Equity packages \- we want our success to be yours too
* Inclusive parental leave policy
* An annual Vibe \& Thrive package to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup \& more
* Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally


 Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.
   

  

**Other Stuff To Know**
 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
   

  

 We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above \- we still want to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

title: Lead Visual Designer
location: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
description:
**As our hiring team is international, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English to ensure it can be reviewed by all stakeholders.**



**Work where work matters.**

 We are a global technology group built for what's next, offering high calibre professionals the platform for high stakes work, the kind of work that defines an entire career. When you join us, you're not just taking on projects, you're solving problems that don't even have answers yet.
   

  





 You will join an exclusive roster of talent that global leaders, including Google, Snap, Diageo, PayPal, and Jaguar Land Rover call when deadlines seem impossible, when others have already tried and failed, and when the solution absolutely has to work.
   

  





 Forget routine consultancy. You will operate where technology, design, and human behaviour meet to deliver tangible outcomes, fast. This is work that leaves a mark, work you'll be proud to tell your friends about.
   

  





 We are looking for a Lead Visual Designer to join our delivery center in Buenos Aires. 
   

  





 We look for people who embody:
 



**Innovation** 
 to solve the hardest problems.
 



 ‍
 **Accountability** 
 for every result.
 



 ‍
 **Integrity** 
 always.
   

  




**About The Role**
****Role Overview****

 We're looking for a Lead Visual Designer who loves pushing their thinking and taking it through to production. You'll flex in your role from pitching ideas to crafting web experiences to ensuring successful delivery. You know how to make people fall in love with an idea, and have the technical craft to turn that vision into world\-class designs that resonate across surfaces \- from marketing platforms and digital products to next\-generation, multimodal AI experiences.
   

  





 While this is primarily a maker role that will see you heavily involved in the work, you'll have regular opportunities to partner closely with CDs and ACDs, be a leading voice in the day\-to\-day of projects, and gain skills and experience that will set you up the next step in your creative career.
   

  





 Above all, you're an awesome human who loves being surrounded by \- and collaborating with \- smart, talented folks in a fun, fast\-paced environment.
   

  




**As a Lead Designer at Beyond, you will**
* Deliver exceptional creative for high\-impact web platforms, seamlessly connecting product utility with powerful brand storytelling and market positioning.
* Translate bold, differentiated ideas into world\-class client\-facing deliverables, focusing on UI design, responsive frameworks, visual design systems, and interactive prototypes.
* Create compelling presentation decks and prototypes, communicating the strategic thought and "why" behind your creative choices to C\-suite clients and cross\-functional teams.
* Work fluidly with UX designers, product strategists, engineers, data scientists, and copywriters to ensure conceptual ideas are grounded in technical reality and seamless UX.
* Operate as a skilled discipline lead, championing great design amongst project teams \- and guiding more junior members of staff towards it where necessary.


**What Success Looks Like**
* 8\+ years of experience in digital/interactive design (agency or in\-house).
* A proven track record of award\-winning design, possessing the rare ability to see the "big picture" creative hook without losing sight of product execution.
* Exceptional client\-facing presentation skills. You can visualize an idea rapidly, build an inspiring narrative around it, and pitch it with conviction.
* Deep mastery of Figma, visual hierarchy, typography, layout, and responsive frameworks. You build scalable design systems, not just one\-off pages.
* Confident designing for intelligent, adaptive, and context\-aware systems. Enthusiastic about using AI creative tools to accelerate rapid concepting and prototyping.
* Able to bring experiences to life and communicate interaction models through motion tools or code.


**Benefits**

 We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. Here's how we invest in you:
   




* Work from Home Allowance
* Private Medical Insurance for family group
* Birthday leave
* 10 paid learning days per year
* Bonusly 100 points per month to recognise colleagues


****Diversity and Inclusion****

 At Beyond we champion diversity and inclusion. We believe that a career in IT should be open to everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability or neurotype. We value the unique talents and perspectives that each individual brings to our team, and we strive to create a fair and accessible hiring process for all.

title: Sr Brand Design Manager
location: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
description:
**About CookUnity**
 Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first\-of\-its\-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready\-to\-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.
   

  

 Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever\-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission:
 **empower Chefs to nourish the world.**
 If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At CookUnity, the Brand Marketing team is responsible for developing and executing world\-class marketing activations and experiences that drive brand awareness and earn loyalty beyond reason. This team sets the vision and strategy for the brand and brings it to life with strategic rigor, creative excellence, and cultural relevance. Through insight\-inspired, data\-informed brand storytelling and experiences, CookUnity’s Brand Marketing team will build a category\-defining brand loved by an entire generation of foodies.
   

  

**The Role**
 CookUnity is seeking a seasoned brand design manager to take our creative function to the next level — elevating design craft, modernizing design operations, and boldly differentiating the CookUnity brand. In this role you will oversee the development and expression of the brand visual identity across all consumer touch points, both online and offline, while managing and actively leveling up a team of talented, ambitious designers.
   

  

 Through your leadership and vision, you will build and scale a world\-class brand design function with customer obsession and creative excellence at its core. The ideal candidate brings not only a mastery of design craft honed at best\-in\-class consumer brands, but also the operational rigor to implement new standards of design process and team performance — and the forward\-thinking mindset to leverage AI tools as a high\-impact lever for quality and efficiency.
   

  

 This is a role for a leader who sets the bar high, builds the systems to meet it, and brings a team along for the journey. Reporting to the VP of Brand Marketing, this role is uniquely positioned to create an impact that helps CookUnity resonate emotionally and grow commercially in unprecedented ways.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Creative Vision \& Brand Stewardship**
* Develop and evangelize an inspiring creative vision for the future of CookUnity and help the organization make progress towards achieving its full potential
* Lead the Brand Design team to bring the essence of CookUnity to life through a differentiated design system and visual storytelling across website, app, social media, advertising, CRM, and a growing ecosystem of packaging
* Own, refine, and continue to build on the CookUnity brand identity and visual system as a living resource that evolves with new learnings and insights to better support the needs of the customer and company
* Bring the standards and instincts of best\-in\-class consumer brands to CookUnity — championing unwavering expectations for design craft, quality, and executional consistency


**Design Process \& Operational Excellence**
* Design and manage an ambitious, end\-to\-end creative process — including intake, internal creative reviews, stakeholder feedback cycles, and approval workflows — that ensures consistently on\-time delivery of high\-quality assets
* Lead regular creative reviews of all ongoing design work to provide timely feedback and coaching, and ensure pixel\-perfect execution across all design deliverables
* Lead the routing, feedback, and approval process for brand design deliverables to executive staff and Founder as needed for high\-visibility, high\-impact initiatives


**AI Integration \& Design Innovation**
* Champion the integration of AI\-based tools into the team's design workflows, identifying high\-impact opportunities to automate repeatable tasks, accelerate production, and free the team to focus on higher\-order creative work
* Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and serve as an internal resource for best practices, responsible use, and practical application within a brand design context
* Foster a team culture that embraces experimentation with emerging tools while maintaining the quality standards and creative integrity the brand demands


**Team Leadership \& Talent Development**
* Mentor and motivate a small but mighty team of talented designers, actively leveling up individual skills through structured feedback, coaching, and growth\-oriented development conversations
* Build a culture of trust, openness, accountability, and a relentless pursuit of design excellence — where high standards are a shared value, not just a directive
* Lead by doing: maintain mastery of the tools the team uses daily (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Claude Design, and relevant AI design tools) and be willing to roll up your sleeves alongside the team when needed


**Cross\-Functional Partnership**
* Partner with teammates, peers, and key stakeholders to proactively identify opportunities or challenges, and take a leadership role in bringing tangible design solutions forward
* Partner directly with brand copy team to define visual storytelling approach, ensuring consistency and deep integration between these teams to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of all creative output
* Assume a strong company presence as an internal standard\-bearer of category\-defining creativity, building trust, alignment, and influence across the organization
* Bring principles of design thinking, a solution\-oriented mindset, and an entrepreneurial spirit to achieving impactful results without depending on significant resources


**Minimum Requirements**
* 8\+ years experience in brand design; experience in top consumer brands and/or agencies is a plus
* 4\+ years managing other designers
* A respected brand design leader with a track record of shipping excellent work and a portfolio demonstrating a mastery of design craft across multiple disciplines of design
* Proficiency in video and how to leverage design in this format is a plus
* Passion for insights and performance data in shaping creative work and a commitment to building a culture that embraces these essential inputs
* Experience operating in a fast\-paced growth environment, including dealing with ambiguity, shifting priorities \& rapid iteration
* Very detail oriented, well organized, and a proven ability to effectively manage multiple projects, work streams, or initiatives simultaneously
* Highly collaborative in nature with ability to partner across various functions throughout a company and demonstrate flexible decision\-making based on new insight or feedback
* A genuine passion for design and a love of the creative process
* Proficiency in English at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field is a plus


**Learn More About CookUnity**
 We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.
   

  

 We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!
   

  

**Benefits**
 💸 Get paid in USD
   

  

 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.
   

  

 ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date.
   

  

 🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.
   

  

 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3\-5 days each time the need arises.
   

  

 🐣 Family leave of 12 weeks for primary caregiver and 6 weeks for secondary caregiver, fully paid.
   

  

 🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more.
   

  

 🤖 AI\-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.
   

  

 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you.
 **Thank you for your time!**
***CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer** 
 . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.*
***A quick note for all candidates***
 We’ve Recently Seen An Increase In Recruitment Scams Across The Industry, And We Want To Make Sure You (and Your Data) Stay Safe While Applying To CookUnity. We Also Want You To Know That We Take This Seriously — Sometimes, As Part Of Our Process, We May Ask For a Brief “proof Of Humanity” To Confirm That We’re Connecting With a Real Person, Not An Impersonator. Here Are a Few Tips To Help You Protect Yourself And Know What To Expect From Us
   

  

* Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com
* Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
* We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
* We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.


*If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double\-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and
 **we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.***

title: Senior Marketing and Communication Manager
description:
**Additional Information**  

**Job Number**26123855  

**Job Category**Sales \& Marketing  

**Location**One Marriott Drive, Need Address, Dubai, United Arab Emirates  

**Schedule**Full Time  

**Located Remotely?**N  

**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

  



The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property\-level communications to our customers. Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on\-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel. This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness. This role focuses on showcasing Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons. As part of the Marketing and Communication team, this role is fully connected into resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization. This role also gets to do a little bit of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel. Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and communications campaigns.

  



**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  



**Education and Experience**

  



**Required:**


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred


OR


* 4\-year bachelor's degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred.

  



**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

  



**Hotel Marketing and Advertising**


* Executes annual marketing plan to budget, in consultation with the GM, Food and Beverage leader, Operations leaders, Director of Marketing Communications, and cluster marketing and ecommerce teams.


* Partners with Operations, Food \& Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in\-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.


* Acts as the liaison between the marketing department and advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns' creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions.


* Manages F\&B media schedules and verifies prompt settlement of accounts.


* Partners with property Revenue Management to verify correct offer loading, verifying advertisement targeting is correctly directed at relevant consumer groups


* Executes email marketing, and display advertising.


* Maintains frequent, active engagement with Cluster eCommerce manager to verify alignment, pull\-through, and 2\-way communication about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.


* Verifies all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice.

  



**Social Media Content Management**


* Facilitates social media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (e.g., hotel website, travel sites).


* Develops and executes promotions campaign in F\&B, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels.


* Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly.

  



**Public Relations and Visual Asset Management**


* Develops a comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency and and executes post sign\-off from GM.


* Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers.


* Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system.


* Writes and distributes all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets.


* Manages the execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities.


* Supports pull through of impactful PR strategy \& activities to drive quality press coverage through media engagement, in alignment with communications objectives.


* Verifies the news clippings and other online, print, and social media mention report is completed on a monthly basis for property distribution.


* Manages external vendors and media agencies; works with agency partners and continent PR leader to identify strategic media buys for their hotel(s).


* Surfaces and vets PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel.


* Supports the co\-ordination of photography for F\&B advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams.


* Manages photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team.


* Acts as central point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery; coordinates with area or cluster marketing to verify all photography adheres to brand voice.

  



**Direct Marketing and Collateral Development**


* Coordinates and executes Hotel and F\&B printed materials.


* Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.


* Assists in the production of all property, F\&B display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.


* Promotes collection of competitors collateral and publicity on a monthly basis.


* Manages the execution of F\&B direct marketing activities.


* Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA).

  



**General**


* Assists and manages the development, co\-ordination and execution of all communications activities with a strong emphasis on property F\&B promotions and campaigns.


* Helps with the publication of hotel’s newsletter(s).


* Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary.


* Assists in the liaison and execution of joint F\&B promotions.


* Works with eCommerce to verify the Hotel’s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis.


* Partners with Director of Marketing to create marketing plan aligned to hotel sales and revenue strategy.


* Provides training and marketing leadership and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders.


* Coordinates with property and above property eCommerce and Revenue Management teams to report success of property marketing and eCommerce performance.


* Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends.
  

*At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non\-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.*


At Renaissance Hotels, we believe in helping our guests experience the DNA of the neighborhoods they are visiting. Our guests come to discover and uncover the unexpected, to dive into a new culture, or simply to make the most of a free evening. They see business travel as an adventure because they see all travel as an adventure. Where others may settle for the usual, our guests see a chance to bring home a great story. And so do we. We’re looking for fellow spontaneous explorers to join our team to bring the spirit of the neighborhood to our guests. If this sounds like you, we invite you to discover career opportunities with Renaissance Hotels. In joining Renaissance Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.

title: Interior Designer
description:

If you notice the 2 mm gap nobody else sees, let’s talk.

\- Company\-provided apartment in a great Dubai neighbourhood, with pool, gym and padel courts;  
\- Work equipment provided;

* Prepare FF\&E selections and material specifications
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, suppliers, contractors and internal teams throughout all project phases
* Ensure designs comply with UAE regulations, authority requirements and project specifications
* Conduct site visits to monitor progress and ensure design intent is achieved
* Review shop drawings, material submissions and mock\-ups

title: Senior Director, AP Assessment Design and Insights
description:
**Senior Director, AP Assessment Design and Insights**

**College Board –** AP\&I

**Location:** This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

**Role Type**: This is a full\-time position

 **About the Team**


The College Board’s Advanced Placement and Instruction division (300\+ staff) develops and administers coursework taken by more than 3 million students worldwide each school year, and the related subject\-matter exams utilized by more than 4,000 colleges and universities for course placement and awarding of college credit. These include credit and placement examination programs like CLEP and ACCUplacer; Advanced Placement (AP) and Pre\-AP courses in 40\+ disciplines; and associated teacher professional learning programs.

  

To support the continued growth and evolution of the program, the AP Program Enablement team is designed to oversee the end\-to\-end management of the AP Course Roadmap, as well as the assessment design and systems requirements, processes and production functions that underpin all new and existing AP courses and exams. This team plays a central role in ensuring alignment, quality, and efficiency across the full lifecycle of course and assessment production.

  

Within AP Program Enablement, the AP Assessment Design \& Systems team functions as the cross\-cutting backbone accountable for the assessment design, systems, and requirements making “build to score and report” possible across all AP courses and exams. Assessment Design \& Systems governs the end\-to\-end integration across the full platform ecosystem, assessment design and requirements, the integrity and certification layer, and the knowledge and data governance, serving as the connective tissue other Program Enablement functions rely on to operate as one coherent system. This scope spans all 40\+ existing AP courses and new courses in active development and underpins the program’s digital transformation and strategic priorities.

 **About the Opportunity**


As Senior Director, AP Assessment Design and Insights, you will serve as a senior strategic leader and analytical engine within the AP Assessment Design \& Systems team within AP Program Enablement, driving the assessment design infrastructure, systems strategy, and knowledge architecture that underpin AP’s assessment work across existing courses and a growing portfolio of new course development. This role sits at the intersection of assessment design, data\-informed strategy, and cross\-functional leadership, and is essential to ensuring that AP’s assessment design, systems, and resources are coherent, current, and positioned for the program’s long\-term evolution.

  

You will lead and advance AP's assessment design infrastructure, from intake frameworks for new and revised courses to the team's assessment resources, knowledge base, and systems roadmap, working in close partnership with the Executive Director, who sets the strategic direction for the team. You will serve as an authoritative voice on assessment design standards and requirements across the AP ecosystem, a trusted partner to technology and product teams, and the primary driver of the divisional AP Assessment Community of Practice. This is an ideal role for a senior assessment leader who combines deep expertise in educational assessment with the strategic and analytical capabilities to advance a complex, high\-stakes program at scale.

 **In this Role, You Will:**

**Lead Assessment Systems Strategy and Resources (40%)**

* Lead execution of AP's assessment systems roadmap strategy in close partnership with the Executive Director, ensuring it accurately reflects assessment requirements and priorities across current and new course portfolios and advances AP's broader digital transformation goals.
* Drive annual execution and maintenance of the AP digital assessment inventory, scoping exam requirements across systems for upcoming administration years and ensuring alignment with the AP digital assessment roadmap and College Board strategic priorities.
* Lead the design and architecture of the AP Assessment Design \& Systems SharePoint environment, ensuring assessment resources, tools, and documentation are organized in a manner that is intuitive, navigable, and current.
* Serve as a primary voice in systems and digital roadmap discussions with AP product and technology teams, ensuring assessment strategic priorities, requirements and dependencies are accurately represented and tracked across the ecosystem.
* Translate complex assessment systems data into clear, actionable insights for the Executive Director and senior leadership through data visualizations, executive reporting, and strategic presentation materials.
* Apply knowledge of assessment industry standards, interoperability protocols, accessibility requirements, and generative AI tools to strengthen AP assessment systems requirements and position the program for continued digital evolution.

 **Lead Assessment Design Strategy and Resources (40%)**

* Develop and own the assessment design intake framework for new and revised AP courses, establishing a structured process and assets that guide course teams through the full arc of assessment development from inception through exam production.
* Own the development and stewardship of AP’s assessment design knowledge base, including assessment principles and best practices, item design guidance, item and form development, form assembly standards, psychometric and validity standards, fairness frameworks, and resources that support both current and new course teams and that apply throughout the item and form development lifecycle.
* Partner with the Executive Director and Psychometrics to guide and implement multi\-year test form planning, ensuring AP’s form strategy supports validity, equity, and psychometric soundness across all subjects.
* Serve as a strategic thought partner to the Executive Director on assessment design priorities, flagging risks and dependencies across new and existing course pipelines and recommending solutions.
* Support the integration of innovative item design elements and emerging assessment practices into AP’s assessment resource infrastructure, ensuring the program remains at the leading edge of educational assessment design and digital assessment.

 **Lead the Divisional AP Assessment Community of Practice (20%)**

* Lead the AP Assessment community of practice at a divisional level, setting the strategic agenda for sessions and ensuring the community functions as a high\-value, cross\-collaborative professional learning forum.
* Own speaker outreach and engagement, identifying, cultivating, and coordinating internal and external subject matter experts whose expertise aligns with strategic priorities.
* Collaborate with the Executive Director to ensure Community of Practice sessions address timely, relevant, and high\-impact assessment topics, including psychometrics, fairness, digital assessment, innovative design, assessment systems, and generative AI.
* Serve as the primary logistics and execution partner for the AP Assessment Community of Practice, including end\-to\-end event logistics, session asset quality, and an ongoing archive of sessions and resources to support the community’s growth as a division\-wide, cross\-collaborative forum.

 **About You**

* 8\+ years of progressive leadership experience in assessment design, test development, or assessment systems.
* Deep expertise in educational assessment design, including how assessments are built, validated, and delivered at scale, and fluency in the psychometric, fairness, and design principles that underpin high\-quality, large\-scale exams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead strategic initiatives across assessment design, systems, and knowledge management, and to translate complex assessment and technical requirements into clear, actionable direction for diverse partners.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional conversations and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders, including product, technology, psychometrics, and curriculum and assessment teams, with the intelligence, nuance, and persuasion to move complex, multi\-party work forward without direct authority.
* Strong analytical and communication skills, with experience synthesizing complex data and assessment information into executive\-level insights, visualizations, and presentations.
* Fluency in industry\-standard assessment design conventions and data structures, including blueprints, test and form constraints, item pools, and scoring specifications, with the ability to engage substantively in requirements discussions with technology and product partners.
* Knowledge of assessment content standards and interoperability protocols, such as QTI, APIP, HTML, WCAG, and metadata schemas, sufficient to inform AP assessment systems requirements and evaluate technical options; familiarity with item data protocols including JSON, programming languages such as Python or SAS, and accessibility frameworks is a plus.
* Strong proficiency in SharePoint, Smartsheet, and PowerPoint, with demonstrated experience building data visualizations and executive\-level reporting artifacts.
* Proficiency with the Microsoft 365 suite and familiarity with collaboration and work management platforms such as Productboard, Jira, and Confluence.

 **All Roles at College Board Require:**

* A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission\-driven work.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI\-driven solutions.
* Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal.
* A learner’s mindset and commitment to growth through feedback and collaboration.
* A drive for impact and excellence through data\-informed decisions and continuous improvement.
* A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
* Authorization to work in the United States

 **About Our Process**

* Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.  
* 

**What We Offer**


At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck, we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self\-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

 **A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation**
